films.title: Rashomon
films.engine: A man lies dead in a wood and every person who was there gives an account in which they behaved with honour — including the one who admits to the killing, and including the passer-by who found the body. What the film is actually about is the three men sheltering under the gate who have to listen to all of it: whether you can keep living among people once you have heard how easily they arrange the past around themselves, and what small thing it would take to be able to.

predicaments.situation: each teller shapes the past to spare themselves
predicaments.basis: The bandit, the wife, the dead husband speaking through a medium, and the woodcutter each describe the same killing in a wood, and in each version the teller is dignified and the others are contemptible.

roles.telling: Tajōmaru, the wife, the dead samurai, the woodcutter
roles.listening: the monk, the commoner, the court

predicaments.situation: a woman is shamed for her own violation
predicaments.basis: After the bandit rapes her, the wife is freed to face a husband who looks at her only with loathing and who will not risk his life for what he calls a ruined woman.

predicaments.situation: a bystander conceals his own small theft
predicaments.basis: The woodcutter claims he only found the body, and the commoner works out that he lied because he pocketed the pearl-inlaid dagger and could not let it appear in his evidence.

predicaments.situation: a stranger takes in someone abandoned
predicaments.basis: A baby is left at the gate with a kimono and an amulet; the commoner strips it, and the woodcutter carries the child off to raise alongside his own six, which is what returns the monk's faith.

relatives.title: The Last Duel
relatives.shares: one assault recounted three times, each teller emerging creditable

relatives.title: Anatomy of a Fall
relatives.shares: a death reassembled from accounts that never resolve into one truth

relatives.title: The Sweet Hereafter
relatives.shares: a witness lies in testimony to cover something of her own

relatives.title: Hero
relatives.shares: a killing retold in successive versions that serve whoever is speaking

relatives.title: 3 Godfathers
relatives.shares: men of doubtful character take on an abandoned infant

films.title: Seven Samurai
films.engine: Farmers with nothing but rice hire masterless fighters with nothing but skill to defend them from a gang that will come at harvest. What the film turns on is what the two groups owe each other once they are inside the same stockade: the villagers have been murdering wounded warriors for their armour, the warriors have burned villages like this one, and neither can say it aloud until the one man born a farmer and passing as a fighter says it for both.

predicaments.situation: the threatened hire strangers to fight for them
predicaments.basis: On the elder Gisaku's advice the villagers go to town to find hungry samurai who will defend them for nothing but food, and Kambei assembles six others.

roles.hired: Kambei, Gorobei, Shichirōji, Heihachi, Kyūzō, Kikuchiyo, Katsushirō

predicaments.situation: the rescued despise their rescuers
predicaments.basis: The villagers greet their defenders coldly, hide their daughters, and turn out to have stockpiled armour and weapons taken from wounded and fleeing samurai they killed themselves.

predicaments.situation: a man mediates between two hostile groups
predicaments.basis: Kikuchiyo, who forced his way into the band, answers the samurai's outrage over the looted armour by telling them that warriors made the farmers what they are, and reveals he was born one.

predicaments.situation: a victory leaves the winners with nothing
predicaments.basis: Four of the seven are buried on the hill above the village, and Kambei tells Shichirōji that they lost again and it is the farmers, singing as they plant, who won.

predicaments.situation: lovers are kept apart by unequal birth
predicaments.basis: Katsushirō and Shino know from the start that a samurai's son and a farmer's daughter cannot marry; her father beats her when he learns of it, and after the battle she walks past Katsushirō to join the planting.

predicaments.situation: a woman is shamed for her own violation
predicaments.basis: Rikichi's wife, taken by the bandits in an earlier raid, sees her husband across the burning barracks and walks back into the fire rather than be seen by him.

relatives.title: Sholay
relatives.shares: a village under raiders hires outsiders who have nowhere else to be

relatives.title: Shane
relatives.shares: a fighting man protects settlers who need him and cannot live with him

relatives.title: 13 Assassins
relatives.shares: a scratch band of fighters, including one peasant-born outsider, holds a prepared ground

relatives.title: The Magnificent Seven
relatives.shares: farmers pay in food for defenders who gain nothing by winning

relatives.title: Titanic
relatives.shares: two people who cannot be together because of the class they were born into

films.title: Metropolis
films.engine: The son of the man who owns the city goes down to see who keeps the machines running, and cannot go back to being his father's son afterwards. Meanwhile an inventor who lost the woman he loved to that same father has built a mechanical copy of a person and sends it out wearing a stolen face to wreck what the father built — so the son spends the film trying to get his father to shake the hand of a man he has never once looked at.

predicaments.situation: the comfortable ignore the suffering beneath them
predicaments.basis: Freder plays in a pleasure garden above ground while workers die at the machines, and when he runs to tell his father about the explosion Joh Fredersen's only concern is that the news reached him late.

predicaments.situation: a son turns against his father's world
predicaments.basis: After the accident Freder takes a collapsed worker's place at a machine, enlists his father's dismissed assistant Josaphat, and works in secret against the city his father rules.

predicaments.situation: a false double replaces a trusted person
predicaments.basis: Fredersen has Rotwang give the robot Maria's likeness so that it can discredit her before the workers; it preaches destruction in her voice until the crowd burns it and the real Maria is found alive.

predicaments.situation: a man remakes a woman into someone lost
predicaments.basis: Rotwang built his machine to resurrect Hel, who left him for Fredersen and died bearing Freder, and at the end he chases the living Maria across the cathedral roof believing she is Hel.

predicaments.situation: a rival takes revenge for a lost love
predicaments.basis: Rotwang appears to serve Fredersen while intending to destroy Metropolis and kill Fredersen's son, in payment for the woman Fredersen took from him.

predicaments.situation: a man mediates between two hostile groups
predicaments.basis: Maria prophesies a mediator who will join the two halves of the city, Freder claims the role, and after the flood he puts his father's hand into Grot's.

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man manufactures a substitute for the woman he lost

relatives.title: The Stepford Wives
relatives.shares: a manufactured double wearing a real woman's face fools the people who know her

relatives.title: Snowpiercer
relatives.shares: those riding in comfort never look at the people who power them

relatives.title: Parasite
relatives.shares: a household above ground that cannot see the lives sustaining it below

relatives.title: Bride of Frankenstein
relatives.shares: an inventor builds a woman to answer his own loss

films.title: Vertigo
films.engine: A retired detective is hired to follow a friend's wife, falls in love with her, and then stands frozen on a bell-tower staircase while she falls to her death. Months later he finds a shopgirl who faintly resembles her and sets about dyeing and dressing her back into the dead woman — not knowing she is that woman, hired to play the part in a murder, who has stayed within his reach because she loves him.

predicaments.situation: a false double replaces a trusted person
predicaments.basis: Judy Barton was paid by Gavin Elster to impersonate his wife as a woman possessed, so that Scottie would witness a suicide that was in fact the real Madeleine's body being dropped from the tower.

predicaments.situation: a man remakes a woman into someone lost
predicaments.basis: Scottie makes Judy buy the grey suit, dye her hair blonde and pin it up until she matches the woman he watched die.

predicaments.situation: a woman is loved only as another woman
predicaments.basis: Judy writes a confession and tears it up, choosing to be looked at as Madeleine rather than lose him, and is undone when she wears Carlotta's necklace as herself.

predicaments.situation: a woman is claimed then cast aside
predicaments.basis: Carlotta Valdes bore a rich married man a child, who kept the child and discarded her; Judy was Gavin Elster's mistress, used for the scheme and dropped afterwards.

predicaments.situation: a man's fear costs another person's life
predicaments.basis: A policeman falls from a roof trying to pull Scottie up, and his acrophobia halts him on the tower stairs while the woman he loves apparently plunges past him.

roles.paying: the policeman, the real Madeleine, Judy

relatives.title: Phoenix
relatives.shares: a woman is coached into impersonating the woman she actually is

relatives.title: Solaris
relatives.shares: a man is given a copy of the dead woman and prefers the copy to letting go

relatives.title: Eyes Without a Face
relatives.shares: living women are remade to restore a face that is gone

relatives.title: Laura
relatives.shares: a man falls in love with a dead woman's image and then meets her alive

relatives.title: Mulholland Drive
relatives.shares: a woman's hair and clothes are altered until she becomes someone else's lost figure

films.title: La Strada
films.engine: A woman sells her simple-minded daughter to a travelling strongman for ten thousand lire, the second daughter she has sold to him — the first one died on the road. He feeds her, beats her, forces himself on her and eventually leaves her asleep by a roadside when grief has made her useless to the act. The film is about him hearing, years later, that she died alone, and only then discovering that she was the one attachment he had.

predicaments.situation: a child is sold to feed the others
predicaments.basis: Gelsomina's mother, with more mouths than food, takes Zampanò's ten thousand lire and sends her off the same day to replace her dead sister Rosa.

predicaments.situation: a woman is claimed then cast aside
predicaments.basis: Zampanò presents her to audiences as his wife, refuses her when she actually offers marriage, and abandons her asleep with some clothes, some money and his trumpet.

predicaments.situation: a person stays with someone cruel to them
predicaments.basis: She is intimidated, forced and left standing in the street while he goes off with another woman, and still develops a tenderness for him, returning to the road after her one attempt to leave.

predicaments.situation: a weaker man goads a stronger one fatally
predicaments.basis: Il Matto needles the strongman at every chance without being able to say why, douses him with a pail of water, and dies from a few punches to the head beside a flat tyre.

predicaments.situation: a stranger gives what those closest could not
predicaments.basis: Il Matto tells her that everything has a purpose, even a pebble, even her, and a nun tells her that her life resembles her own — neither being anything Zampanò will say.

predicaments.situation: a man grieves someone only after abandoning her
predicaments.basis: Years later Zampanò hears a woman humming Gelsomina's tune, learns she was taken in on a beach and wasted away, and ends the night drunk and weeping on the sand.

relatives.title: Sansho the Bailiff
relatives.shares: children handed over into servitude and worn down by an owner

relatives.title: Nights of Cabiria
relatives.shares: a woman's unguarded tenderness repaid by the man she gives it to

relatives.title: The Elephant Man
relatives.shares: a helpless person kept and exhibited as a showman's property

relatives.title: Vagabond
relatives.shares: a drifting woman dies alone and is pieced together afterwards by those who met her

relatives.title: Of Mice and Men
relatives.shares: a powerful man destroys the one creature attached to him

films.title: Cléo from 5 to 7
films.engine: A singer spends the two hours before a hospital result walks around Paris trying to say aloud that she thinks she is dying, and finds that her assistant, her lover and the men who write her songs will each change the subject, pet her, or joke it away. She takes off the performed version of herself, gives a stranger in a park her real name, and it is he — a soldier with hours left before his train back to the war — who is willing to be afraid alongside her.

predicaments.situation: those closest refuse to take a fear seriously
predicaments.basis: Angèle scolds her about superstitions, José talks lovingly for five minutes and dismisses the biopsy, and Bob and Maurice put on white coats and play doctors to cheer her up.

predicaments.situation: a woman is looked at rather than heard
predicaments.basis: Her own song plays on a café jukebox to a room that ignores it, she buys a black fur hat in summer to be admired in, and her friend Dorothée poses naked for a room of sculptors; she gives Antoine the name Florence instead.

predicaments.situation: a stranger gives what those closest could not
predicaments.basis: A café owner hands her a free coffee after hearing her out, a projectionist sits her down for a comedy about a death that turns out to be a trick of dark glasses, and Antoine, met minutes earlier in the park, walks her to the hospital.

predicaments.situation: two strangers share the same fear of dying
predicaments.basis: Antoine is on the last day of his leave from Algeria and expects to be killed there; they trade their fears by the waterfall, and after the doctor says two months of treatment she tells him her fear is gone.

relatives.title: Ikiru
relatives.shares: a person given a likely death sentence finds nobody near them will discuss it

relatives.title: Before Sunrise
relatives.shares: two strangers in a fixed window of hours give each other what intimates withhold

relatives.title: The Death of Mr. Lăzărescu
relatives.shares: a person's own account of being ill is waved away by everyone attending them

relatives.title: Sunset Boulevard
relatives.shares: a woman valued as an image long after anyone listens to her

relatives.title: Wild Strawberries
relatives.shares: a single day's wandering with near-strangers rearranges what a life has been

films.title: Hiroshima mon amour
films.engine: A French actress and a Japanese architect, both married, spend a night and a day together in a city she has come to make a film about, and his questions pull out of her the one thing she has never told anyone: as a girl she loved an enemy soldier, watched him die, and was shaved and shut in a cellar by her own town for it. What torments her is not that he died but that she is losing him — and by the last morning she is already losing the man beside her too. The film is a woman deciding whether to speak a buried thing aloud, knowing that speaking it is also the beginning of forgetting it.

predicaments.situation: a stranger hears what a spouse never heard
predicaments.basis: She tells the architect about her German lover in a tea room, and he is elated to learn her husband was never told.

predicaments.situation: a love is punished by the whole town
predicaments.basis: On the day Nevers was liberated her German soldier was shot, the villagers shaved her head, and her parents locked her in her room and the cellar until her hair grew back.

roles.punished: the woman and the German soldier

predicaments.situation: a mourner is ashamed of beginning to forget
predicaments.basis: She says the pain is that the German and their love are fading from her, and in the final scene she shouts at the architect that she is already starting to forget him.

predicaments.situation: an affair must end at a fixed hour
predicaments.basis: She is flying to Paris the next day, refuses to arrange another meeting, then cannot leave the city, going back to the closed tea room and being found there.

predicaments.situation: one insists the other cannot understand
predicaments.basis: His voice-over repeats that she has seen nothing of Hiroshima and does not know what it is to forget; his family died in the bombing while he was away at the front.

relatives.title: Brief Encounter
relatives.shares: two married people whose whole attachment is bounded by a departure neither will cancel

relatives.title: In the Mood for Love
relatives.shares: two people give each other what their marriages never received, and then part on it

relatives.title: Black Book
relatives.shares: a woman punished by her own community for having loved a man on the occupier's side

relatives.title: Sophie's Choice
relatives.shares: a wartime shame spoken aloud for the first time to a new lover, and the cost of speaking it

relatives.title: Certified Copy
relatives.shares: a single day's talk between near-strangers turns into the excavation of one person's buried history

films.title: The Passion of Joan of Arc
films.engine: A young woman who says God sent her to drive out an occupying army is put in front of a court of clergy who need her to take it back; they cannot argue her out of it, so they try a forged letter, then the sight of the torture room, then the fire itself. She signs, and is jailed for life anyway — and when her head is shaved she understands what she has traded, calls the judges back, and unsays it. The film is one person against a room of men who have already decided, and the small crowd outside that watches what the decision costs.

predicaments.situation: one is pressed to disown what she believes
predicaments.basis: The clerical court interrogates Joan for hours, trying to trap her into words that would discredit her claim to a mission from God.

predicaments.situation: the verdict is settled before the hearing begins
predicaments.basis: The judges are clergy loyal to the Burgundian-English coalition and against the King of France; the questioning exists to produce a condemnation, not to test one.

predicaments.situation: deception replaces argument when argument fails
predicaments.basis: A priest reads the illiterate Joan a false letter in her cell, supposedly from Charles VII, telling her to trust the man who brought it.

predicaments.situation: consent is extracted by the threat of pain
predicaments.basis: Shown the torture chamber and then threatened with the stake, Joan lets a priest guide her hand as she signs a confession.

predicaments.situation: one dies rather than take back a word
predicaments.basis: After the jailer shaves her head she recognises her unfaithfulness to God, demands the judges return, recants the confession, and helps the executioner tie her bonds.

predicaments.situation: one death turns the onlookers against the powerful
predicaments.basis: As the flames rise a man cries that a saint has been burned, the women weep, and the troops fight the crowd.

relatives.title: A Man for All Seasons
relatives.shares: an authority that needs one spoken assent from a person who will not give it

relatives.title: The Battle of Algiers
relatives.shares: pain and its threat used as a method for getting words out of a believer

relatives.title: Breaking the Waves
relatives.shares: a woman's direct, literal dealings with God are judged as madness by the devout around her

relatives.title: Ordet
relatives.shares: one who claims to speak with God is managed as ill by the people who share the faith

relatives.title: Battleship Potemkin
relatives.shares: a single public death that flips a watching crowd against the power that caused it

films.title: Ordet
films.engine: Two farming households keep a boy and a girl from marrying because each father is certain the other's way of believing God is the wrong one, and the quarrel is still running when a young wife in one of the houses dies giving birth. The dead woman's brother-in-law, who has spent the film wandering the farm convinced he is Christ and being humoured as ill, stands at her coffin and says she can be raised if anyone will actually ask. It takes her small daughter, who simply wants her mother back, to ask.

predicaments.situation: two families forbid the marriage their children want
predicaments.basis: Morten Borgen and Peter, leader of the local Inner Mission sect, each refuse the match between Anders and Anne over their doctrinal difference.

predicaments.situation: one is humored as mad and proves right
predicaments.basis: Johannes, who believes himself Jesus after reading Kierkegaard, is treated as an affliction by his father, his brothers and the new pastor — until Inger breathes in the coffin.

roles.disbelieving: the Borgen household and the pastor

predicaments.situation: one wishes death on another's family
predicaments.basis: When the call comes that Inger is in difficult labour, Peter says he hopes she dies, so that Morten might see his error and join Peter's church; Morten strikes him.

predicaments.situation: a death in one house shames the quarrel
predicaments.basis: Preparing for the funeral, Peter realises how badly he wronged Morten and reconciles with him over Inger's open coffin, consenting to the marriage.

predicaments.situation: the child asks plainly what adults will not
predicaments.basis: Inger's daughter takes Johannes's hand and impatiently tells him to raise her mother, supplying the belief none of the grown believers can manage.

relatives.title: Romeo + Juliet
relatives.shares: two households that will not permit the marriage their children have already decided on

relatives.title: Fiddler on the Roof
relatives.shares: a father's faith set directly against his children's choice of whom to marry

relatives.title: Breaking the Waves
relatives.shares: a literal, childlike faith that the surrounding believers call insanity, answered by something inexplicable

relatives.title: Babette's Feast
relatives.shares: an old sectarian bitterness in a small pious community dissolved in a single gathering

relatives.title: The Passion of Joan of Arc
relatives.shares: one who says God speaks to them directly, managed as ill or dangerous by the devout

films.title: Battleship Potemkin
films.engine: Sailors are served meat crawling with maggots, told by the ship's doctor that it is fine, and then told that saying otherwise is insubordination punishable by death. When the men are put under a canvas in front of a firing squad, the squad will not shoot their own — and that single refusal spreads outward: to a city that gathers around the dead sailor's body, and finally to the fleet sent to sink them, which lets them through.

predicaments.situation: one denies what everyone else can see
predicaments.basis: Doctor Smirnov inspects the meat and pronounces the maggots washable insects and the meat edible, ending the discussion; the cook and the crew can see otherwise.

predicaments.situation: complaint is answered as disobedience
predicaments.basis: The men who refuse the borscht are judged guilty of insubordination and brought to the fore-deck for last rites.

predicaments.situation: one is punished to make the others obey
predicaments.basis: The refusers are made to kneel under a canvas before a firing squad, in front of the assembled crew, as an example.

predicaments.situation: those ordered to kill refuse the order
predicaments.basis: The firing squad lowers its rifles at Vakulinchuk's plea and the mutiny begins; at the end the Tsarist squadron will not open fire and cheers the Potemkin through.

roles.ordering: the officers and the loyalist command
roles.refusing: the firing squad and the Tsarist crews

predicaments.situation: one death turns the onlookers against the powerful
predicaments.basis: Vakulinchuk's body is laid out on the Odessa quay under a sign reading "for a spoonful of borscht", and the city gathers to it and turns on the Tsar's government.

roles.killing: the ship's officers and the state

predicaments.situation: the armed advance on the unarmed in ranks
predicaments.basis: Cossacks form lines at the top of the Odessa steps and descend into a crowd of women and children, halting to fire volleys, while cavalry cut down those who reach the bottom.

relatives.title: Paths of Glory
relatives.shares: men condemned as an example by their own command, and the impossible position of those told to execute them

relatives.title: Bloody Sunday
relatives.shares: armed ranks advancing in formation on an unarmed civilian crowd that cannot get away

relatives.title: Z
relatives.shares: a single killing at a public gathering becomes the thing that turns a population against the state

relatives.title: The Battle of Algiers
relatives.shares: a shared grievance passing from a handful of men to a whole quarter of a city

relatives.title: The Passion of Joan of Arc
relatives.shares: a death staged in public to cow the watchers, which instead sets them against the authority

films.title: Street of Shame
films.engine: Five women work at a licensed brothel while the legislature argues about banning the trade, and each of them is holding up somebody outside the walls — a father in jail, a husband who wants to kill himself, a grown son, a man promising marriage. One by one those ties give way: the son renounces his mother, the father is thrown out, the suitor turns out to want free labour, the lover who cleared a debt nearly strangles the woman he was buying. The law fails too, and the house puts a new girl out front to call men in.

predicaments.situation: one pays another's debts expecting to be loved
predicaments.basis: Aoki, a married businessman, embezzles to clear all of Yasumi's debts in the belief she will elope with him, and nearly kills her when he learns she never meant to.

predicaments.situation: a parent asks the child to come home
predicaments.basis: Mickey's father comes from Kobe with news of her mother's death and asks her to quit for the family's sake; she throws him out, telling him he lived for himself while her mother was alive.

predicaments.situation: a parent is disowned for how she earns
predicaments.basis: Yumeko has stayed away from her grown son out of shame; when they finally meet he denounces her work and casts her off, and she loses her mind and is taken away.

predicaments.situation: a debt keeps a woman where she is
predicaments.basis: Yorie cannot leave to marry the man who wants her until a court rules that what she owes the Taya family is void.

predicaments.situation: a rescue proves to be another use
predicaments.basis: The man Yorie leaves the brothel to marry wanted her only for unpaid household labour, and she comes back to Dreamland.

predicaments.situation: the one who leaves is replaced immediately
predicaments.basis: The anti-prostitution bill fails, Yasumi sets herself up in business next door with the brothel as her first customer, and the young maid Shizuko is put out front to beckon men in.

relatives.title: Nights of Cabiria
relatives.shares: a promise of marriage used as the instrument for taking everything a woman has saved

relatives.title: Mamma Roma
relatives.shares: a grown child who cannot forgive the trade that paid for him and cuts the mother off

relatives.title: Vivre sa vie
relatives.shares: a woman kept in the work by what she owes the people who arrange it

relatives.title: Working Girls
relatives.shares: a house full of women each supporting somebody outside it, seen as ordinary daily labour

relatives.title: Rosetta
relatives.shares: a person whose whole existence is the maintenance of a dependent who gives nothing back

films.title: Harakiri
films.engine: A starving young man asks a great house for the courtyard in which to kill himself, hoping to be sent away with alms; the retainers, sick of such bluffs, make him do it slowly with his own bamboo sword and never ask why he begged for two days' delay — his wife and child were dying. Months later the man who raised him walks in with the same request, and holds the whole household still with a story until they have to hear what their code cost one family and that the three men who enforced it are at home pretending to be ill. They kill him, then write every death down as sickness.

predicaments.situation: no one asks why the request was made
predicaments.basis: Motome begged for a couple of days' delay before his seppuku; the Iyi samurai took it for a stalling trick, when he needed to see his dying wife and son and settle his affairs.

roles.refusing: Saitō and the three senior retainers

predicaments.situation: one is punished to make the others obey
predicaments.basis: Enraged that Motome's blades were bamboo, the House of Iyi forced him to disembowel himself with them — slow, agonising and humiliating — to put a stop to the rōnin suicide bluffs.

predicaments.situation: a man comes to collect for his dead
predicaments.basis: Hanshirō enters the estate claiming he wants to die there, having already taken the topknots of the three men responsible, in order to make Saitō account for Motome, Miho and Kingo.

roles.owing: Saitō and the House of Iyi

predicaments.situation: the verdict is settled before the hearing begins
predicaments.basis: Asked for a single word of regret to carry to the dead, Saitō refuses and calls Motome an extortionist who deserved what he got.

predicaments.situation: those who demanded courage will not appear
predicaments.basis: Summoned to behead Hanshirō, Hayato, Umenosuke and Hikokuro each plead illness rather than admit their topknots were taken; one has already killed himself.

predicaments.situation: what happened is denied to save face
predicaments.basis: Saitō orders that the retainers Hanshirō killed, and the two he has forced to disembowel themselves, all be recorded as deaths by illness; the armour is re-erected and the blood scrubbed off the ground.

relatives.title: Paths of Glory
relatives.shares: an institution that destroys the men beneath it and then writes the affair up as a credit to itself

relatives.title: Rashomon
relatives.shares: a killing whose official account has nothing to do with what the survivors know happened

relatives.title: The Ballad of Narayama
relatives.shares: a code of conduct held above the plain fact that a family is starving

relatives.title: Winter's Bone
relatives.shares: one person walks into the house of those who killed a relative and refuses to leave without an accounting

relatives.title: The Passion of Joan of Arc
relatives.shares: a proceeding whose outcome is fixed in advance, endured by someone who makes the room hear them anyway

films.title: Diary of a Country Priest
films.engine: A young priest arrives in a parish where nobody wants him and where his own body is quietly killing him, and he cannot reach a single person until one afternoon he talks a mother out of years of refusal. The daughter listening at the door tells a lie about that conversation, and he lets the lie stand rather than produce the letter that would clear him. He dies among people the church has already given up on, asking one of them for the rites.

predicaments.situation: one sent to help is not wanted there
predicaments.basis: The new priest of Ambricourt draws a single parishioner to daily mass and his plan for a youth club dies against the Count's indifference and the village's suspicion.

predicaments.situation: a stranger reaches someone no one else could
predicaments.basis: He persuades the Countess, who renounced God after her son's death, that God is not a torturer, and she writes him a letter of thanks hours before her heart gives out.

predicaments.situation: an accusation is believed over the accused
predicaments.basis: Chantal, who overheard everything, tells her father the priest drove her mother to despair, and the Count sets a church investigator on him and moves to have him removed.

predicaments.situation: a man refuses to clear his own name
predicaments.basis: He holds back the Countess's letter at the interrogation, treating what passed between them as sealed by confession.

predicaments.situation: a third person is admitted into a marriage
predicaments.basis: The Count keeps his daughter's governess Louise as his mistress with the Countess's tacit consent, and expects the priest to look away as well.

predicaments.situation: contempt drives a person to take their life
predicaments.basis: Dr. Delbende, emptied of faith and held in low regard as a doctor by the village, kills himself; Chantal is stopped from the same only by being frightened into surrendering her note.

relatives.title: Winter Light
relatives.shares: a clergyman with no faith left is asked for consolation by someone he cannot reach

relatives.title: Silence
relatives.shares: one sent to help is not wanted there, and his body gives out before the mission does

relatives.title: Doubt
relatives.shares: an accusation is believed over the accused, who will not defend himself with what he knows

relatives.title: Ikiru
relatives.shares: a man given a terminal diagnosis spends what is left trying to complete one good act

relatives.title: Ordet
relatives.shares: a stranger reaches someone no one else could, in a household that had settled into refusal

films.title: Jules and Jim
films.engine: Two friends love the same woman and decide that keeping each other matters more than having her, so the husband hands his wife to his friend rather than lose sight of her. She treats what they give her as permission and neither man ever turns out to be enough; when the friend finally chooses an ordinary life instead, she settles the arrangement by driving off a bridge with him beside her and the husband watching from the bank.

predicaments.situation: a third person is admitted into a marriage
predicaments.basis: Jules, afraid Catherine will leave him for good, gives Jim his blessing to marry her so that the three of them can go on living in the Black Forest chalet with the child.

predicaments.situation: two friends want the same person
predicaments.basis: Jules and Jim are both taken with Catherine from the moment she reminds them of the statue they crossed a sea to see, and both spend twenty years arranging their lives around her.

predicaments.situation: one tries to kill the person they love
predicaments.basis: Catherine pulls a gun on Jim after he refuses her, and later asks him into her car, asks Jules to watch, and drives off a ruined bridge into the river.

predicaments.situation: a man must choose between two women
predicaments.basis: Jim keeps Gilberte in Paris throughout the years with Catherine, and finally tells Catherine he is going to marry her.

predicaments.situation: no child comes to bind them together
predicaments.basis: Jim and Catherine cannot conceive, which breaks up the chalet, and the pregnancy that would have reunited them ends in miscarriage.

predicaments.situation: friends are made enemies by forces above them
predicaments.basis: Jules and Jim serve on opposite sides of the war, each spending it afraid of meeting the other or of learning he had killed him.

relatives.title: Design for Living
relatives.shares: a third person is admitted into a marriage by open agreement rather than deceit

relatives.title: Le Bonheur
relatives.shares: a man keeps wife and lover both with everyone's consent, and a body is pulled from the water

relatives.title: Odd Obsession
relatives.shares: a husband deliberately puts another man in his wife's path and cannot control what follows

relatives.title: Y tu mamá también
relatives.shares: two friends want the same person, and what she does with that ends the friendship

relatives.title: Vicky Cristina Barcelona
relatives.shares: an arrangement held open by consent, ruined by the one person in it who cannot be satisfied

films.title: Mother Joan of the Angels
films.engine: A priest is sent to a convent to drive the demons out of its abbess and discovers that what passes between them is not exorcism but love, which he can neither act on nor give up. Unable to free her, he asks for her affliction to come into him instead, then murders two harmless men in the belief that damning himself is the one gift left to give her. Outside the walls a village follows the whole business nightly, as a story they are entitled to.

predicaments.situation: an outsider is sent after repeated failures
predicaments.basis: Father Suryn arrives at the Smolensk convent after four priests failed to exorcise Mother Joan and after the local priest was burnt at the stake for tempting the nuns.

predicaments.situation: the one sent to heal becomes the harm
predicaments.basis: Suryn briefly succeeds, then takes Mother Joan's eight demons into himself through his love for her and kills the stablemen Kaziuk and Juraj with an axe.

predicaments.situation: one accepts damnation to save another
predicaments.basis: Reasoning that only doing Satan's bidding can save her, he commits the murders and sends word to the abbess that it was done for her salvation in the name of love.

predicaments.situation: a private torment becomes a public entertainment
predicaments.basis: The villagers at the inn track the convent's possession as an unfolding story, having Kaziuk lead the priest about and pressing Sister Małgorzata for the latest on her nightly visits.

predicaments.situation: a promise of escape is offered then withdrawn
predicaments.basis: Sister Małgorzata leaves the convent for the squire Chrząszczewski and by the next morning has been abandoned by him.

relatives.title: The Devils
relatives.shares: an outsider is sent after repeated failures into a convent where possession, desire and public appetite are the same thing

relatives.title: The Exorcist
relatives.shares: the one sent to heal takes the affliction into himself and destroys himself with it

relatives.title: Breaking the Waves
relatives.shares: one accepts damnation to save another, on a private logic nobody else can follow

relatives.title: Black Narcissus
relatives.shares: a religious house comes apart under desire while the country around it watches

relatives.title: The Crucible
relatives.shares: a private torment becomes a public entertainment, with authorities arriving to certify it

films.title: Strike
films.engine: A factory's workers stop work after one of them, accused of a theft, hangs himself; the owners read the demands aloud for laughs and use the paper to mop a spill. What follows is a study in what people with power do when people with none ask them for something: informers inside the plant, hired provocateurs outside it, hunger allowed to do its work in the tenements, and finally the army in a field.

predicaments.situation: an accusation is believed over the accused
predicaments.basis: Yakov is named as the thief of a micrometer worth three weeks' pay and hangs himself, which is what actually starts the strike.

predicaments.situation: a demand from below is answered with force
predicaments.basis: The eight-hour day, thirty percent raise, six-hour day for minors and decent treatment are dismissed over cigars and drinks; then come the police raids, then the governor's soldiers, then a field.

predicaments.situation: a person is used as another's hands
predicaments.basis: A tsarist police agent pays the King of Thieves to supply men from the buried barrels to burn and loot a liquor depot so the strikers will be blamed.

predicaments.situation: watchers are planted among the people they watch
predicaments.basis: The administration keeps a roster of coded agents inside the plant, and the spy "Owl" photographs a strike leader with a camera hidden in a pocket watch, after which the man is beaten and seized.

predicaments.situation: hunger turns a household against itself
predicaments.basis: With the strike dragging on, the factory store is shut and a baby goes unfed, a man and a woman fight until she walks out, and another man strips his home of goods to sell at the flea market.

relatives.title: Germinal
relatives.shares: a demand from below is answered with force, after hunger has been given its chance first

relatives.title: Peterloo
relatives.shares: an orderly demand from below is answered by cavalry sent from above

relatives.title: The Battle of Algiers
relatives.shares: watchers planted among the watched, and provocation used to justify what was already planned

relatives.title: Salt of the Earth
relatives.shares: hunger turns a household against itself while the strike outside holds

relatives.title: Matewan
relatives.shares: hired men sent among workers to manufacture the violence that licenses the crackdown

films.title: Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans
films.engine: A farmer's summer lover tells him to drown his wife and sell the farm, and he takes his wife out on the lake meaning to do it. He cannot, and the rest is him following the terrified woman through a strange city, begging her to stop being afraid of him — which, over the course of one day, she does. Then the storm on the way home nearly kills her anyway, without any help from him.

predicaments.situation: a lover proposes the removal of a spouse
predicaments.basis: The woman from the city, who has lingered in the lakeside town for weeks, mimes drowning the wife and gathers the bundles of reeds that will keep him afloat when the boat goes over.

predicaments.situation: a man must choose between two women
predicaments.basis: He is pulled between the whistle at the fence after dark and the wife and child asleep in the farmhouse.

predicaments.situation: one tries to kill the person they love
predicaments.basis: He rows his unsuspecting wife out across the lake and rises over her to throw her in, then cannot, and rows frantically for shore while she cowers.

predicaments.situation: a betrayal is forgiven by the one betrayed
predicaments.basis: She flees him through the city until he breaks down watching a stranger's wedding and asks her forgiveness; they spend the day at a photographer's and a funfair and take the trolley home together.

predicaments.situation: a person given up for dead returns alive
predicaments.basis: After the storm the search turns up only a broken bundle of reeds, and he is choking the woman from the city in his grief when the maid calls out that his wife is alive.

relatives.title: A Place in the Sun
relatives.shares: a man takes a woman out on a lake intending to drown her, for the sake of another woman

relatives.title: Ossessione
relatives.shares: a lover proposes the removal of a spouse as the price of the new life

relatives.title: Double Indemnity
relatives.shares: the plan is the lover's, and the one who carries it out is the one it destroys

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: a man leaves his wife for an enchanting stranger and comes home to find out what it cost

relatives.title: Ordet
relatives.shares: a person given up for dead returns alive to a household already mourning

films.title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
films.engine: A man tells how a showman at a fair kept a sleepwalker in a box and sent him out at night to knife the people who had crossed him, and how he chased the showman to an asylum and found him running it. Then the telling stops and he is an inmate, the woman he called his fiancée believes she is a queen, and the man he called Caligari is the doctor now promising he can cure him. What the film turns on is one man having total control of another's body and another's account of reality.

predicaments.situation: the one sent to heal becomes the harm
predicaments.basis: The asylum's director, obsessed with an eighteenth-century mystic, experiments on a sleepwalker admitted to his care until he can send him out to kill, screaming "I must become Caligari!"

predicaments.situation: a person is used as another's hands
predicaments.basis: Cesare sleeps in a coffin-like box, and stabs the town clerk and Alan and carries Jane off through her window on his keeper's orders, while a dummy lies in the box in his place.

predicaments.situation: the one naming the danger is called mad
predicaments.basis: Franzis's whole account of the murders ends with him seized, straitjacketed and put in the same cell he described for Caligari, while the director explains he now understands the delusion and can cure it.

predicaments.situation: a private torment becomes a public entertainment
predicaments.basis: Cesare's box is opened at the fair and he is woken to take questions from a paying audience about how long they have to live.

predicaments.situation: a foretold death is then brought about
predicaments.basis: Asked how long he will live, Cesare tells Alan "until dawn tomorrow," and that night a figure enters Alan's room and stabs him in his bed.

predicaments.situation: two friends want the same person
predicaments.basis: Franzis and Alan are good-naturedly competing for Jane's affections on the way to the fair, hours before Alan asks the question that kills him.

relatives.title: Shutter Island
relatives.shares: the man telling the story turns out to be the patient, and the doctors were staging the telling

relatives.title: The Manchurian Candidate
relatives.shares: a person is used as another's hands, made to kill on command with no memory of it

relatives.title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
relatives.shares: the one naming the danger is called mad by the person with the authority to define madness

relatives.title: The Elephant Man
relatives.shares: a private torment becomes a public entertainment, then passes to a doctor who takes charge of the body

relatives.title: Nightmare Alley
relatives.shares: a sideshow act built on another person's condition, and a controller who ends up inside the exhibit

films.title: Pandora's Box
films.engine: A woman whose only means is that people want her is passed hand to hand between the men who take her up, and each of them is wrecked at the moment he finally claims her. The old man who first kept her, the son of the man she marries, the woman who adores her — all of them treat her as something to be spent, and she goes along because nothing else has ever been offered her. It ends with her giving herself freely, for the first time, to the one person who will kill her for it.

predicaments.situation: a man is ruined by his own desire
predicaments.basis: Dr. Schön breaks off a respectable engagement to a minister's daughter after Lulu seduces him in a storage room, marries her in disgust at himself, and dies in the struggle when he tries to force her to shoot herself.

predicaments.situation: a protector sells the person he protects
predicaments.basis: Schigolch, who calls himself her first patron, delivers Lulu to the strongman Quast and later to the London street, while Casti-Piani, having blackmailed her on the train, sells her outright to an Egyptian brothel-keeper.

predicaments.situation: a son wants what his father has
predicaments.basis: Alwa confesses his love for Lulu during his father's own wedding reception, is ordered out of the room, and after Schön's death flees the country with her and sinks with her into a London garret.

predicaments.situation: mercy is shown to the wrong person
predicaments.basis: Penniless on Christmas Eve, Lulu likes the stranger who admits he cannot pay and brings him home anyway; he throws away his knife in gratitude and then finds another one on her table.

predicaments.situation: one uses the love one cannot return
predicaments.basis: Countess Geschwitz gives Lulu her own passport to escape and is talked into luring Quast to a stateroom and killing him, and gets nothing back for either.

predicaments.situation: a lie is told to protect another
predicaments.basis: With a pistol pointed at the two men found in her bedchamber, Lulu calls out that Schigolch is her father, and both of them are let go.

relatives.title: The Blue Angel
relatives.shares: a settled respectable man destroys himself the moment he acts on wanting a performer

relatives.title: Sisters of the Gion
relatives.shares: a woman handled and traded by the men who claim to be looking after her

relatives.title: Nights of Cabiria
relatives.shares: a woman gives herself freely to the one man who takes everything from her

relatives.title: The Bitter Tears of Petra von Kant
relatives.shares: one person's devotion is accepted, used, and never returned

relatives.title: Belle de Jour
relatives.shares: a woman's worth to everyone around her is only in being wanted

films.title: The General
films.engine: A man is turned away when he tries to enlist and is never told the reason is that he is worth more where he already is; the woman he loves reads his walking away as cowardice and refuses to speak to him until he is in uniform. The whole film is him doing alone, by pursuit and accident, the thing that would have made him acceptable to her — and getting the uniform at the end as an afterthought.

predicaments.situation: a man is thought a coward wrongly
predicaments.basis: Johnnie is rejected at the recruiting desk without being told he is more valuable as an engineer, and Annabelle's father and brother see only that he turned and walked out of the line.

predicaments.situation: worth must be proved to be loved
predicaments.basis: Annabelle announces she will not speak to Johnnie again until he is in uniform, and only takes him back after he has warned the army, burned the bridge and been commissioned.

predicaments.situation: what is stolen must be taken back
predicaments.basis: Spies take the locomotive with Annabelle aboard it, and Johnnie chases on foot, handcar, bicycle and a second engine until he has both of them back.

predicaments.situation: one man does alone what many should
predicaments.basis: The flatcars are never coupled to the Texas, so the detachment is left standing at the station and Johnnie discovers too late that he is pursuing an army by himself.

relatives.title: The Four Feathers
relatives.shares: a man marked a coward by the people closest to him and left to disprove it alone

relatives.title: Paths of Glory
relatives.shares: men condemned for cowardice over something that was never cowardice

relatives.title: The Searchers
relatives.shares: a long pursuit to take back a woman carried off by the enemy

relatives.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
relatives.shares: the whole film is one chase to recover what was taken

films.title: Modern Times
films.engine: A man cannot hold any place the working world gives him — the line breaks him, every job after ends in an accident or an arrest — and he works out that the one institution that reliably feeds and houses him is jail, so he starts trying to get himself locked up. Then he attaches himself to a girl who is as unplaceable as he is, and the film becomes the two of them being pulled apart by the law and putting themselves back together.

predicaments.situation: a man cannot keep the work he finds
predicaments.basis: The assembly line gives him a breakdown, the shipyard job ends in a launched ship, the night watchman job ends in arrest, and the reopened factory job ends in a strike.

predicaments.situation: shelter is found only in confinement
predicaments.basis: Told he is to be released for foiling a jailbreak, he argues to be kept in, and afterwards eats a huge cafeteria meal without paying purely to be arrested again.

predicaments.situation: two with nothing keep each other alive
predicaments.basis: He and Ellen, one unemployable and one an orphan on the run, set up in a run-down shack, she finds him work at her café, and when the police come for her they leave together.

predicaments.situation: a lie is told to protect another
predicaments.basis: Seeing Ellen fleeing after stealing a loaf, he tells the police he is the thief, until a witness contradicts him and he is let go while she is taken.

predicaments.situation: a man is mistaken for another
predicaments.basis: Walking in front of a demonstration with a fallen flag in his hand, he is taken for its leader and arrested.

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a man who cannot hold onto the work that would keep him, with one companion at his side

relatives.title: Shoplifters
relatives.shares: people with nothing keeping each other alive outside the law until the law separates them

relatives.title: Rosetta
relatives.shares: someone unemployable cycling through jobs she loses almost as fast as she gets them

relatives.title: Sullivan's Travels
relatives.shares: a man who deliberately gets himself jailed and finds out what jail is

relatives.title: Umberto D.
relatives.shares: a man with no footing left, kept going by the one creature attached to him

films.title: Safety Last!
films.engine: A young man leaves home promising to send for the girl he loves as soon as he has made good, does not make good, and hides it by mailing her gifts he cannot afford — so she arrives in the city believing he is somebody. The rest of the film is him holding the story upright in front of her, until the only way to pay for it is to do himself the dangerous stunt he had hired a friend to do.

predicaments.situation: worth must be proved to be loved
predicaments.basis: Harold tells Mildred at the station he will send for her to marry once he has made good in the city, and she comes only when the presents convince her he can support a family.

predicaments.situation: a lie must be maintained by more lies
predicaments.basis: The unaffordable gifts bring Mildred to the store, so he has to pass himself off as the general manager in front of her and the floorwalker Stubbs, then find a thousand dollars to make it true.

predicaments.situation: one takes on what another was to do
predicaments.basis: Bill was to climb the building for five hundred dollars, but with the policeman waiting he sends Harold up the first storey to swap clothes, and then never manages the swap on any floor.

predicaments.situation: an old wrong keeps the helper away
predicaments.basis: Bill once knocked the wrong policeman over on Harold's bad advice, and that policeman recognises him from the newspaper story and chases him up through the building floor by floor.

relatives.title: Death of a Salesman
relatives.shares: a man sustaining a story of his own success that the people who love him have believed

relatives.title: The Great Gatsby
relatives.shares: a man builds a false show of arrival to be worthy of the woman he left behind

relatives.title: Tokyo Chorus
relatives.shares: failure at work concealed from the family who are counting on it

relatives.title: The Prisoner of Zenda
relatives.shares: a man stands in for another for one hour and cannot get out of the role

films.title: The Crowd
films.engine: A man raised on his father's promise that he would be somebody ends up one desk among hundreds, and his wife's patience with his big talk wears through as the years pass with no advancement and a friend of theirs rises instead. A death in the family knocks out what was left of him, and the marriage survives in the end not because he rises but because she cannot quite make herself walk out the door.

predicaments.situation: a man cannot become what he expected
predicaments.basis: John arrives in New York at twenty-one certain he will stand out, and is still at a numbered desk at Atlas Insurance years later on an eight-dollar raise.

predicaments.situation: worth must be proved to be loved
predicaments.basis: Mary's dissatisfaction is specifically with his lack of advancement measured against Bert's, and against the prospects he had talked up to her.

predicaments.situation: a child is lost through a parent's haste
predicaments.basis: John and Mary call their children to hurry across the road to see the presents bought with his slogan prize, and their daughter is hit by a truck.

predicaments.situation: a man cannot keep the work he finds
predicaments.basis: Unable to function after his daughter's death, he is reprimanded and quits, then takes and loses one job after another until he is carrying a sandwich board.

predicaments.situation: help offered is refused as humiliation
predicaments.basis: Mary's brothers reluctantly offer him a position and he turns it down as a charity job, which is what brings her to slap him.

predicaments.situation: one partner stays after deciding to go
predicaments.basis: Mary is packed and leaving with her brothers when John comes home with his new work, and she steps out of the house and no further.

relatives.title: Ikiru
relatives.shares: a man discovers he has been one interchangeable desk in a large office for his whole life

relatives.title: Death of a Salesman
relatives.shares: a man promised greatness who stays ordinary, and a family that has to keep hearing about the prospects

relatives.title: Ordinary People
relatives.shares: a child's death that a marriage cannot absorb

relatives.title: Don't Look Now
relatives.shares: a child lost in an instant of a parent's inattention, and the couple afterwards

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a man's standing in his own household collapsing along with his ability to earn

films.title: The Red Shoes
films.engine: A young woman tells the man who runs a company that dancing matters more to her than anything else, and he takes her at her word and makes it a condition — no marriage, no life outside the work. When she marries the composer anyway, the two men each demand, on the same night, that she give up the other, and she is left with no way to be both the dancer one made and the wife the other wants.

predicaments.situation: love must be given up for a calling
predicaments.basis: Lermontov's company requires dancers to leave on marrying, and Vicky, having married Julian and let her career stall, is persuaded to put on the red shoes again.

predicaments.situation: two people demand the same person entirely
predicaments.basis: Julian abandons his own opening night in London to appear in Monaco and insists Vicky cancel and leave with him, while Lermontov argues the opposite in the same room minutes before her performance.

predicaments.situation: one person forbids another to love
predicaments.basis: Lermontov dismisses the principal dancer Boronskaya for marrying and later gives Julian the choice of ending the relationship or leaving the company.

predicaments.situation: one owns the person one has made
predicaments.basis: Not attracted to Vicky himself, Lermontov is possessive of the star he built out of her, tries to break the marriage by telling them their work is suffering, and cannot let go of her even after replacing her.

predicaments.situation: another takes credit for one's work
predicaments.basis: Julian walks out of a performance on recognising that his professor has scored it with his own plagiarised compositions, and writes to Lermontov about it.

relatives.title: Whiplash
relatives.shares: a maker who insists the art be the only thing in the pupil's life

relatives.title: Black Swan
relatives.shares: a dancer possessed by the man who cast her, dissolving into the role she is dancing

relatives.title: Anna Karenina
relatives.shares: a woman claimed by two men at once, ending under a train

relatives.title: The Wife
relatives.shares: one person's work carried publicly under another person's name

relatives.title: Sunset Boulevard
relatives.shares: someone kept as the property of the person who made their career

films.title: Rebel Without a Cause
films.engine: A boy keeps asking his father to take a stand for him, and the father keeps declining, so the boy goes looking for the test of nerve his home won't give him. In one night he acquires a girl whose father calls her names, a younger boy whose father left years ago, and a death he can't get anyone to let him confess to. The three of them play at being a family in an empty house, and the youngest is killed for believing in it.

predicaments.situation: a parent refuses to stand for his child
predicaments.basis: Jim repeatedly presses Frank to defend him against Carol and against the trouble he is in, and Frank counsels avoiding all confrontation until Jim attacks him.

predicaments.situation: a contest of nerve between rivals turns fatal
predicaments.basis: Buzz, humiliated in a knife fight, proposes the cliff-edge chickie run to keep his standing, and dies when his sleeve catches on the door latch.

predicaments.situation: a confession finds no one willing to hear
predicaments.basis: Jim goes to the police station to admit his part in Buzz's death and is turned away by the desk sergeant.

predicaments.situation: strangers improvise the family they lack
predicaments.basis: Jim, Judy and Plato take over the deserted mansion and act out being father, mother and child for one night.

predicaments.situation: one is left behind by the person adored
predicaments.basis: Plato, who has idolized Jim since his first day at school, wakes alone in the mansion while Jim and Judy are off kissing, and flees accusing Jim of deserting him.

predicaments.situation: a parent's absence unmakes the one left waiting
predicaments.basis: Plato's father walked out when he was a toddler and his mother is rarely home, leaving him with a housekeeper and a stolen gun; Judy, ignored since she stopped being a little girl, dresses to force her father's notice and is called a tramp for it.

relatives.title: The 400 Blows
relatives.shares: a boy whose home offers him nothing goes looking for trouble, and his attempts to be heard by adults land nowhere

relatives.title: Shoplifters
relatives.shares: people with no working families assemble a substitute one and it cannot hold

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a son watches his father fail to stand up and has to absorb what that costs

relatives.title: Fish Tank
relatives.shares: a girl provokes and dresses to force a parent figure to see her

relatives.title: Boyz n the Hood
relatives.shares: a dare among boys with something to prove ends in a death nobody can undo

films.title: The Idiot
films.engine: A man so guileless that everyone calls him an idiot meets a woman who has been owned, bought and passed between men since childhood, and offers her the first kindness she has been shown; she loves him and therefore decides she must not have him. His friend, who wants her too and cannot bring himself to hate the man who is better than he is, ends the impasse by killing her. Everyone around them mistakes goodness for stupidity until it is too late to say so.

predicaments.situation: a woman is traded between men as property
predicaments.basis: Taeko was Tohata's mistress from childhood, is offered with a Y600,000 dowry to Kayama to get her off Tohata's hands, is counter-bid at Y1,000,000 by Akama, and is finally 'given' by Akama to Kameda.

predicaments.situation: a person is remade into what others need
predicaments.basis: Tohata's long abuse has twisted Taeko's psyche and made her a social pariah, so that she can no longer believe herself worth the one kindness offered her.

predicaments.situation: two friends want the same person
predicaments.basis: Akama and Kameda become friends on the boat over Akama's account of Taeko, and remain unable to dislike each other face to face even as her love for Kameda destroys Akama.

predicaments.situation: one refuses love to spare the beloved ruin
predicaments.basis: Taeko, believing her reputation would wreck Kameda's life, pushes him toward Ayako and writes urging Ayako to take him.

predicaments.situation: a jealous man kills what he cannot possess
predicaments.basis: Akama, knowing Taeko's feelings run to Kameda, stabs her and then sits out the night beside her body with Kameda.

predicaments.situation: goodness is taken for foolishness by everyone
predicaments.basis: Kameda's illness and his incapacity for hatred are read as idiocy by the household around him, until Ayako says at the end that she was the idiot for being unable to love without hatred.

relatives.title: Nazarín
relatives.shares: a man incapable of self-protection is destroyed by a world that reads his goodness as simplicity

relatives.title: Vivre sa vie
relatives.shares: a woman is passed between men who each price her, until the last transaction kills her

relatives.title: Jules and Jim
relatives.shares: two friends who cannot stop loving each other want the same woman, and she cannot survive the arrangement

relatives.title: Ordet
relatives.shares: the household treats the one who sees clearly as mad, and understands only after a death

relatives.title: Mouchette
relatives.shares: a person already marked as disgraced refuses the kindness that might save her

films.title: Late Chrysanthemums
films.engine: Four women who once made their living by being wanted now meet almost entirely over money — one of them has become the lender, and the other three owe her. Over four days their children leave for jobs and marriages, and the man the lender has been quietly waiting years for finally comes back, wanting a loan. She refuses him, burns his photograph, and goes to look at land.

predicaments.situation: money is owed between old friends
predicaments.basis: Kin lends to and hounds her former geisha sisters Tamae, Tomi and Nobu for repayment, while Tomi's gambling keeps her permanently behind.

predicaments.situation: a former lover returns wanting only money
predicaments.basis: Kin is elated to hear that Tabe, her old patron, is coming back, and finds he has come to borrow; Seki, who once tried to kill her, also turns up asking and is sent away.

predicaments.situation: the young depart leaving the old behind
predicaments.basis: Kiyoshi goes to Hokkaido for work and Sachiko moves in with her fiancé, leaving Tamae and Tomi alone together in the house.

predicaments.situation: a parent objects to a child's chosen partner
predicaments.basis: Tomi tries to talk Sachiko out of marrying an older man, and Tamae is unhappy that Kiyoshi is being kept and paid by an older mistress.

relatives.title: Tokyo Story
relatives.shares: the young move on with their own lives and the old are left with each other

relatives.title: Umberto D.
relatives.shares: an old person's whole remaining life narrows to a debt that cannot be settled

relatives.title: Make Way for Tomorrow
relatives.shares: children's departures leave the parents holding nothing but each other

relatives.title: The Life of Oharu
relatives.shares: a woman who once lived by being desired finds the market for her closed and the accounting merciless

films.title: The Burmese Harp
films.engine: A soldier is sent to talk a group of holdouts into surrendering; they beat him and choose to die, and he alone survives the shelling. Walking back to his unit he finds the country strewn with unburied Japanese dead, and decides that the duty he owes them outranks the one he owes the living friends waiting for him. They send word begging him to come home with them, and he answers no.

predicaments.situation: one sent to make peace is beaten
predicaments.basis: Mizushima climbs to the cave to tell the holdout unit the war is over, and when he raises a white flag to buy more time from the British they take it as surrender on their behalf and knock him unconscious.

roles.refusing: the cave commander and his men

predicaments.situation: men choose death over living with defeat
predicaments.basis: The soldiers in the cave confer and unanimously decide to fight to the end rather than surrender; the bombardment leaves only Mizushima alive.

predicaments.situation: a duty to the dead outweighs the living
predicaments.basis: Finding Japanese corpses unburied all along his route, Mizushima takes a stolen monk's robe and stays in Burma to bury them rather than rejoin his unit.

predicaments.situation: one offered a way out refuses it
predicaments.basis: Inouye's men train a parrot to say 'Mizushima, let's go back to Japan together' and send it with an old villager; the answer comes back on a second parrot — 'No, I cannot go back' — with a letter explaining why.

predicaments.situation: enemies recognize each other through a shared song
predicaments.basis: Inouye's men sing to fake ignorance of the encircling British and Indian troops, and the British sing 'Home! Sweet Home!' back at them instead of opening fire.

relatives.title: Joyeux Noël
relatives.shares: two sides discover the same song and stop being able to shoot at each other

relatives.title: Antigone
relatives.shares: one person decides the unburied dead have a claim that outweighs every obligation to the living

relatives.title: The Deer Hunter
relatives.shares: comrades travel and plead to bring back the one who stayed, and he will not be brought

relatives.title: Fires on the Plain
relatives.shares: a soldier walks through a defeated country among the unburied and is remade by what he sees

relatives.title: Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter... and Spring
relatives.shares: a man withdraws into monastic discipline as the only adequate answer to what he has done and seen

films.title: A Page of Madness
films.engine: A man who spent years at sea, leaving his wife and daughter alone until his wife broke and tried to kill herself and the child, has taken a menial job at the asylum where she is held so he can watch over her. She does not know him, nobody at the hospital knows who he is, and his grown daughter — about to be married — is disgusted to find him there and cannot forgive him for what his absences did. As his daughter's engagement wobbles and his access to his wife is taken away, he retreats into fantasies of breaking her out, of killing the doctor, of handing everyone a mask with a happy face.

predicaments.situation: one secretly serves the person he harmed
predicaments.basis: The old man works as the asylum's custodian, mopping its floors and watching over the wife his long absences drove mad, without the doctors or staff knowing she is his wife.

predicaments.situation: one is not recognized by the person nearest
predicaments.basis: He stares into her cell night after night and her condition leaves her unable to know him; even her own daughter finds her unresponsive and leaves.

predicaments.situation: a child cannot forgive a parent's old absence
predicaments.basis: The daughter comes to announce her marriage, is shocked and angry to find her father employed at the hospital, and leaves blaming him for driving her mother crazy; later he asks her for forgiveness.

predicaments.situation: a past is hidden to protect a marriage
predicaments.basis: When the daughter says her marriage is in trouble, he begins imagining spiriting his wife out of the asylum so that her existence can be concealed, and dreams of a chest of drawers won in a lottery to serve as a dowry.

predicaments.situation: a parent's absence unmakes the one left waiting
predicaments.basis: His long voyages left his wife and small daughter alone until she became unstable and attempted to kill herself and the child, which is what put her in the hospital.

relatives.title: Amour
relatives.shares: one spouse attends daily on another who is no longer reachable, and shuts the world out of it

relatives.title: Wild Strawberries
relatives.shares: an old man's dreams keep staging the harm his coldness did to his family and asking to be forgiven

relatives.title: The Snake Pit
relatives.shares: a woman inside an institution and the relative outside it who cannot reach across

relatives.title: Shutter Island
relatives.shares: a man's fantasy life grows over the truth of what happened to his wife and children

films.title: Devi
films.engine: An old landowner dreams that his son's young wife is the goddess he worships, wakes her, and falls at her feet; the household follows, and she is installed in a room to be prayed to. Her husband, away at his studies, comes back to argue his father out of it and offers to take her away by boat — but she has begun to half-believe it herself, and asks to be taken home. When a sick child is brought to her instead of to the doctor and dies in her arms, there is nothing left of her to rescue.

predicaments.situation: an elder's belief is imposed on the family
predicaments.basis: Kalikinkar's dream of Kali's eyes merging with Doyamoyee's is enough to make the whole household worship her; Taraprasad complies at once, Harasundari's skepticism counts for nothing, and the doctor is overruled.

predicaments.situation: a person is remade into what others need
predicaments.basis: Doyamoyee, the daughter-in-law who tended the old man's rituals and mothered her nephew, is seated as an idol and by degrees begins to wonder whether she really is the goddess.

predicaments.situation: being adored cuts one off from everyone
predicaments.basis: As supplicants arrive from far away to worship her, Doyamoyee sits stoically through the ceremonies while her isolation deepens and even Khoka, the child she was close to, begins to avoid her.

predicaments.situation: one offered a way out refuses it
predicaments.basis: Umaprasad smuggles her at night to a boat waiting at the riverbank, and she panics and asks to be taken back to the house.

predicaments.situation: belief kills the child it meant to save
predicaments.basis: When Khoka's fever worsens, Kalikinkar stops the doctor's medicine and has the boy given the water from Doyamoyee's feet and left in her arms overnight; he is dead by morning.

relatives.title: Ordet
relatives.shares: a household's faith overrides medicine at the bedside of someone who then dies

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a woman is dressed and installed as someone else's vision of her until she cannot get back out

relatives.title: The Song of Bernadette
relatives.shares: a young woman becomes the vessel of everyone else's belief and loses any private life to it

relatives.title: Rosemary's Baby
relatives.shares: a family decides what a young wife is for, and her doubts are managed rather than heard

relatives.title: Sansho the Bailiff
relatives.shares: a father's conviction sets the terms of everyone else's life and the family is destroyed carrying it

films.title: Mother India
films.engine: A woman marries into a debt she never agreed to and spends her whole life paying it — with her husband's body, her children, and her own standing in the village. Years later her surviving son comes back armed to settle the account she could never settle, and because she has already given the village her word that he will not harm the lender's family, she is the one who has to stop him.

predicaments.situation: a debt binds a family for generations
predicaments.basis: Radha's mother-in-law borrows ₹500 from Sukhilala for the wedding, the elders rule the disputed terms in the lender's favour, and three-quarters of every harvest goes to interest for the rest of Radha's life.

predicaments.situation: one must pass judgment on one's own child
predicaments.basis: Radha, having promised Sukhilala she would not let Birju harm his family, shoots her own son as he rides off with Rupa.

predicaments.situation: a vow to the community outweighs a child
predicaments.basis: Radha's standing as the village's mother, and the promise she made in that capacity, is what makes her fire on Birju rather than let him go.

predicaments.situation: a man unable to provide abandons his family
predicaments.basis: After a boulder crushes his arms and Sukhilala taunts him for living off his wife's work, Shamu walks out of the village toward likely starvation rather than be kept.

predicaments.situation: survival is offered in exchange for her body
predicaments.basis: After the flood ruins the harvest, Sukhilala offers Radha food for herself and her sons if she gives herself to him; she refuses and her infant dies.

predicaments.situation: a wronged child grows up to take revenge
predicaments.basis: Birju, embittered from childhood by Sukhilala's demands, becomes a bandit, returns on Rupa's wedding day, kills the lender and takes his daughter.

relatives.title: Sansho the Bailiff
relatives.shares: a family broken apart and held in servitude by an obligation it cannot pay off

relatives.title: The Grapes of Wrath
relatives.shares: land and lenders destroying a family while the mother is the only thing holding it together

relatives.title: Medea (1969)
relatives.shares: a mother who kills her own child to keep faith with something larger than the child

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a father unmanned in front of his family by his inability to provide

relatives.title: Rocco and His Brothers
relatives.shares: a mother watching one son turn violent against everything the family owes

films.title: Awaara
films.engine: A judge who believes character is inherited convicts a criminal's son on thin evidence, and is repaid when that man frightens his pregnant wife into disgrace; the judge then throws her out, so his own son is born on the street and grows into exactly the thief the judge would have predicted. Father and son meet again in a courtroom, the judge presiding, neither knowing what he is looking at.

predicaments.situation: a child is judged by his father's name
predicaments.basis: Raghunath convicts Jagga on thin evidence because Jagga is a criminal's son, and later refuses Raj for not knowing who his father is.

predicaments.situation: a man expels his wife from the house
predicaments.basis: When Leela returns after four days in Jagga's hands and is suspected of adultery, Raghunath throws her out and rejects her insistence that the child is his.

predicaments.situation: a man revenges himself through his enemy's child
predicaments.basis: Jagga releases Leela once he learns she is pregnant, then years later finds the boy shining shoes and teaches him to steal, so the judge's son becomes the thief the judge said he would be.

predicaments.situation: a lover hides what he really is
predicaments.basis: Raj lets Rita believe his talk of thieving is finance, tries factory work to become worthy of her, and is exposed when his gift necklace matches the case Raghunath was robbed of.

predicaments.situation: one must pass judgment on one's own child
predicaments.basis: Raghunath sits as judge at the trial of Raj, the son he cast out before birth, and only learns the relation when Raj says it aloud in court.

predicaments.situation: a wronged child grows up to take revenge
predicaments.basis: Told by his dying-lit mother who his father is, Raj breaks jail and goes to kill Raghunath, and is stopped only by Rita.

relatives.title: Oliver Twist (1948)
relatives.shares: a fatherless boy drawn into a gang and taught theft as the price of eating

relatives.title: Los Olvidados
relatives.shares: children pushed into crime by the conditions the respectable classes decline to look at

relatives.title: Pickpocket
relatives.shares: a thief who believes himself unfit for the woman who insists on loving him anyway

relatives.title: A Place in the Sun
relatives.shares: a poor man concealing his origins from the woman whose world he wants into

relatives.title: Billy Budd
relatives.shares: a man on the bench forced to sentence someone his own principles created

films.title: Secrets of Women
films.engine: Three wives, waiting at a summer house for husbands who are brothers, pass the time by telling each other the hour their own marriage nearly ended — a confessed affair, a pregnancy never mentioned, a night stuck between floors.
