When she marries someone else, the way he keeps his own footing is to take her husband in and do for him what was done for him — including standing between the man and the people trying to kill him.

predicaments.situation: a man ruined by drink is taken in
predicaments.basis: Charley Dolan, an ex-alcoholic, gives the fired and homeless Lew Marsh a room and a construction job; Lew later gives Boyd Copeland the same room.

predicaments.situation: a rescued man becomes the rescuer of another
predicaments.basis: Months sober and useful to other drinkers, Lew is asked by his employer Ives to do for his nephew Boyd what Charley did for Lew.

predicaments.situation: a man loves a woman married to another
predicaments.basis: Lew lost Paula Arnold while drinking and she married Boyd; he brings her back to the paper secretly hoping she will love him again.

predicaments.situation: a man rescues his own replacement in love
predicaments.basis: Lew houses Boyd, covers his affair with the singer Maria, and fights off the gangster Garr beside him, then hands Paula back to him.

predicaments.situation: a bystander dies in another man's place
predicaments.basis: Garr rigs a car to kill Boyd and kills Charley by mistake, and Boyd is left holding the death as his own doing.

relatives.title: Drunken Angel
relatives.shares: a man who knows the illness from inside takes charge of another man's ruin and cannot control what it costs

relatives.title: The Lost Weekend
relatives.shares: a writer's drinking dismantles the work and the woman, and someone else has to hold the line

relatives.title: Days of Wine and Roses
relatives.shares: one of a pair gets sober and the other keeps drinking, and the marriage hangs on it

relatives.title: The Apartment
relatives.shares: a man ends up caring for the woman his rival is treating badly, and has to decide what to do about it

relatives.title: Ikiru
relatives.shares: a man who has wasted his time spends what remains being useful to people in the same condition

films.title: Close to My Heart
films.engine: A childless couple move toward taking in an abandoned baby, and the husband — unwilling to love a child whose people he cannot account for — goes looking for where the boy came from. His digging turns up exactly the parentage that makes officials refuse the boy, and he has to talk his way back past the case he himself built.

predicaments.situation: a childless couple seeks a child to raise
predicaments.basis: Brad and Midge Sheridan cannot have children and pursue Danny, a foundling left at a police station and made a ward of the juvenile court.

predicaments.situation: a child's future hangs on strangers' judgement
predicaments.basis: Mrs. Morrow's agency and the juvenile court decide whether Danny goes to the Sheridans, warn them off, and finally take him away from them.

predicaments.situation: a man digs into a past best unknown
predicaments.basis: Brad traces Danny's mother Martha through Arlene, a boarding house and a ring, and publishes a photograph of the man who fathered him.

predicaments.situation: a child is judged by his parentage
predicaments.basis: Danny goes unwanted as a foundling, and once Mrs. Morrow recognises Hewitt as a man imprisoned for murder the adoption is stopped outright.

predicaments.situation: a parent refuses the child he never met
predicaments.basis: Told at San Quentin that he has a son and that Martha died bearing him, Hewitt answers bitterly that there was no place in his life for a child.

relatives.title: Like Father, Like Son
relatives.shares: whether a child belongs to the people raising him or to the blood he came from, decided by adults arguing over him

relatives.title: Shoplifters
relatives.shares: a child's future settled by officials weighing background against the people who actually want him

relatives.title: Philomena
relatives.shares: a journalist digs up the origins of a child and the digging becomes the story he is writing

relatives.title: Secrets & Lies
relatives.shares: a search into who bore a child forces the truth on people who arranged their lives around not knowing

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: an abandoned child whose existence sits outside every official record

films.title: Mara Maru
films.engine: A salvage diver, suspected of murdering his own partner, is handed the chance to bring up a fortune he himself lost during the war, and keeps choosing it over the woman begging him to go home and live an ordinary life. What he raises turns out to be an object other men will die to see put back rather than sold, and the last person who wants it from him is the one who helped him find it.

predicaments.situation: a man is suspected of a friend's murder
predicaments.basis: Mason is arrested for Callahan's killing after their public quarrel and is only cleared when Ranier claims to have witnessed it.

predicaments.situation: a woman loves the man her husband envied
predicaments.basis: Stella married Callahan but stayed in love with Mason, and Callahan's jealousy over their earlier relationship is what set the killing in motion.

predicaments.situation: a chosen prize is weighed against a person
predicaments.basis: Stella twice begs Mason to abandon the sunken diamonds and return with her to a normal life, and he twice picks the treasure.

predicaments.situation: a man refuses the easier life offered him
predicaments.basis: Even after learning Benedict means to kill him once the box is up, Mason stays with the expedition rather than take Stella's offer of the United States.

predicaments.situation: a friendship is built on a hidden purpose
predicaments.basis: Ranier is hired by Mason as protection while working with Benedict all along, and Stella first appears to be playing both sides.

predicaments.situation: what one man sells another holds sacred
predicaments.basis: The salvaged box holds a jewelled crucifix from a Manila cathedral; Manuelo and Ortega want it returned to the church and Mason beats Manuelo over it.

relatives.title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
relatives.shares: partners in a hunt for buried wealth turn on each other as the prize comes up

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: a man's pursuit of gain set against the woman asking him to come home, and the answer arriving too late

relatives.title: The Maltese Falcon
relatives.shares: a partner's murder, a coveted object, and every ally secretly working for someone else

relatives.title: Aguirre, the Wrath of God
relatives.shares: greed carried through jungle at the cost of everyone who came along

relatives.title: The Mission
relatives.shares: a man's violence measured against what other people hold sacred, and paid for by giving the thing back

films.title: Cops and Robbers
films.engine: A small-time swindler and the policeman who must catch him within three months or lose his job end up eating at each other's tables, each concealing his disgrace from his own family. When they finally recognise each other, the friendship has gone far enough that the thief decides to walk himself to prison to save the man hunting him — and the policeman ends up looking after the thief's family in his absence.

predicaments.situation: a pursuer becomes the friend of his quarry
predicaments.basis: Sergeant Bottoni, hunting Esposito in plain clothes, is drawn into the Esposito household, the two families become friends and a romance starts between their relatives.

predicaments.situation: a friendship is built on a hidden purpose
predicaments.basis: Bottoni conceals that he is a policeman, courting Esposito's family with favours and food only so that Esposito will eventually walk in.

predicaments.situation: a man hides his ruin from his family
predicaments.basis: Bottoni keeps his suspension and the threat to his job from his own household, while Esposito's family does not know what he really does for money.

predicaments.situation: one man accepts punishment to save another
predicaments.basis: Once he understands that Bottoni will lose his job otherwise, Esposito insists on being taken in, over the sergeant's own reluctance.

predicaments.situation: one man keeps another's family in his absence
predicaments.basis: With the arrest disguised as a business trip and a send-off at the station, Bottoni takes on the care of the Esposito family while Esposito is inside.

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a man stealing to keep a family fed, and the man on the other side of it seeing the family

relatives.title: Les Misérables
relatives.shares: a pursuer and his quarry bound to each other until the hunt turns into something neither can carry out

relatives.title: Catch Me If You Can
relatives.shares: the man chasing and the man running become the only company each has

relatives.title: The Bicycle Thief of Rome's cousin, Big Deal on Madonna Street
relatives.shares: petty crooks whose schemes are really an argument with poverty, played for comedy

relatives.title: Tokyo Story's neighbour, Good Morning
relatives.shares: two households whose small deceptions of each other decide what the families think they share

films.title: I Know Where I'm Going!
films.engine: A young woman travelling to marry a very rich man much older than she is gets stopped by weather one island short of the wedding, among people who think nothing of what she is marrying for. The delay puts her beside a man who owns the island her fiancé is only renting, and she spends the storm trying to get across the water rather than admit what has happened to her.

predicaments.situation: a promise of marriage collides with new love
predicaments.basis: Joan is on her way to marry Sir Robert Bellinger when the gale strands her with Torquil MacNeil and she is torn between her plans and him.

predicaments.situation: a traveller is stranded among unfamiliar people
predicaments.basis: Weather holds Joan on Mull among boatmen, a falconer and impoverished gentry whose values are nothing like the ones she arrived with.

predicaments.situation: a chosen prize is weighed against a person
predicaments.basis: Joan has arranged her life around marrying one of the wealthiest men in England, and the islanders' talk plus the ceilidh put that beside Torquil, who has an island and no money.

predicaments.situation: a person flees the one they want
predicaments.basis: Joan pays Kenny twenty pounds to run the crossing in a full gale, and Catriona tells Torquil plainly that she is running from him.

predicaments.situation: an ancestor's crime binds a living descendant
predicaments.basis: Torquil will not enter Moy Castle because a woman his forebear drowned with her lover cursed every laird of Kiloran to be chained to a woman for life.

relatives.title: Local Hero
relatives.shares: a visitor arrives on a coast to complete a rich man's transaction and is undone by the delay and the people in it

relatives.title: It Happened One Night
relatives.shares: a woman travelling toward a wealthy fiancé falls for the man she is stuck with on the way

relatives.title: Brief Encounter
relatives.shares: an attachment formed inside a delay, weighed against a life already arranged

relatives.title: Late Spring
relatives.shares: a marriage arranged for good practical reasons set against what the person actually wants

relatives.title: The Quiet Man
relatives.shares: an outsider held by a community whose customs and old grievances decide what love is allowed

films.title: Foundry Town
films.engine: A girl in her last year of junior high wants to go on to full-time high school, and watches the household stop being able to afford her: her father is hurt, then laid off, then too proud and too old-handed to hold the work he is offered, and her mother goes to work in a bar. The film is about what she does with the future that has been quietly withdrawn — hiding the family's state from the classmates who know, walking away from school entirely, and finally deciding which kind of adult she is going to become instead.

predicaments.situation: a child carries the household the parent cannot
predicaments.basis: Jun takes shifts at a pachinko parlour for living money and school fees while her father Tatsugoro drinks and gambles away the benefits won for him, and her younger brother Takayuki tries to raise pigeons to sell.

predicaments.situation: help is refused as humiliation
predicaments.basis: Katsumi wins Tatsugoro several months of injury benefit through the union, and Tatsugoro, ashamed of being "indebted to the Reds", spends every yen of it on alcohol and motorcycle racing.

predicaments.situation: a child hides home from friends
predicaments.basis: Jun skips the school-trip meeting point rather than face Nobuko, whose father found her father the foundry job he has just secretly quit, and spends the day alone on the riverbank and at the gates of the high school she wanted.

predicaments.situation: a child sees a parent unmasked
predicaments.basis: Jun looks into the pub where her mother Tomi now works and sees her flirting with the male customers, after which she stops going to school altogether.

predicaments.situation: someone returns home to find it gone
predicaments.basis: Sankichi gets off the repatriation train at Omiya and comes back to Kawaguchi for his Japanese mother, only to find her diner shut and herself gone to marry someone else.

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a child watching a parent's competence and authority come apart under want

relatives.title: Rosetta
relatives.shares: a girl holding a household together on scraps of work while a parent drinks

relatives.title: The 400 Blows
relatives.shares: a child sees a parent unmasked and stops going to school

relatives.title: Tokyo Chorus
relatives.shares: a father's lost job silently reorganizes what his children are allowed to want

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: children keeping the true state of home hidden from everyone outside it

films.title: Pardon My Past
films.engine: A discharged soldier on his way to start a mink farm is grabbed off the street because he has another man's face, and is dropped into that man's family — the wife he walked out on, the daughter he is suing to keep from her, the uncle steering the whole quarrel. Playing the man, he turns out to be better at the man's life than the man is, and the mess he tidies up is a marriage that a third party has been keeping broken on purpose.

predicaments.situation: a man is mistaken for another
predicaments.basis: Eddie York is taken for the playboy Francis Pemberton by a bookie's thug at a tailor's, and then by the entire Pemberton household, who have not seen Francis in two years.

predicaments.situation: an impostor lives another's life better
predicaments.basis: Standing in as Francis, Eddie is generous and decisive where Francis was evasive and timid, tells Uncle Wills to let Mary see Stephanie freely, and impresses the wife and grandfather who had given the real man up.

predicaments.situation: one man is made to answer for another
predicaments.basis: Jim Arnold's thug holds Eddie at gunpoint and takes his $3,000 against Francis Pemberton's $12,000 gambling debt, refusing every explanation that he has the wrong man.

predicaments.situation: a child is fought over by two parents
predicaments.basis: Francis is suing for sole custody of Stephanie and trying to have Mary declared an unfit mother, with half his fortune riding on the outcome.

predicaments.situation: word between two is intercepted by a third
predicaments.basis: Uncle Wills has destroyed every letter Mary sent to Francis in Mexico, and Eddie tricks him into confessing it in front of Francis, who throws him out and goes back to his wife.

predicaments.situation: one of the trusted works against them
predicaments.basis: Wills, the family man with the safe combination, engineers the custody suit, has Mary arrested for kidnapping her own daughter, and tries to get Francis committed to a psychiatric ward.

relatives.title: The Return of Martin Guerre
relatives.shares: a stranger fills a missing man's place in a family and fills it better

relatives.title: Kagemusha
relatives.shares: a double grows into the role until he outgrows the man he stands for

relatives.title: Dave
relatives.shares: an impostor does the absent man's job with a decency the man never had

relatives.title: The Prince and the Pauper
relatives.shares: two identical men and a household that cannot tell which one it has

relatives.title: Kramer vs. Kramer
relatives.shares: a child fought over by two parents with a legal machine sharpening the fight

films.title: Hangmen Also Die!
films.engine: A doctor shoots the occupation's governor and vanishes into a stranger's apartment; the occupiers answer by seizing four hundred citizens and shooting them in batches until someone gives him up. The film is about the daughter of one of those hostages, who can buy her father back with a name she happens to know, and about a whole city quietly agreeing to swear the same lie so that she does not have to.

predicaments.situation: many are held to force one to surrender
predicaments.basis: Unable to find Heydrich's assassin, the Nazi authorities take four hundred Czech men hostage and execute them forty at a time until the killer gives himself up or is denounced.

predicaments.situation: a child must betray to save a parent
predicaments.basis: Mascha knows Svoboda is the assassin and her father Professor Novotny is among the hostages; she goes to Gestapo headquarters to denounce him and cannot make herself do it.

predicaments.situation: a household shelters a stranger at mortal risk
predicaments.basis: Mascha misdirects the soldiers hunting Svoboda and takes him in; her father guesses at once who he is and hides him anyway, and is taken hostage and shot.

predicaments.situation: one of the trusted works against them
predicaments.basis: Emil Czaka sits in the resistance's meetings and knows its leaders while working as a German fifth-columnist, and his information gets most of the cell killed or arrested.

predicaments.situation: one man is made to answer for another
predicaments.basis: The resistance manufactures testimony from Mascha and many others to pin Heydrich's assassination, and later Inspector Gruber's murder, on Czaka, and the Gestapo shoot him for it.

predicaments.situation: two must pretend to be lovers
predicaments.basis: Svoboda and Mascha stage conversations for the bugged apartment so the Gestapo will read their contact as an affair behind her fiancé Jan's back rather than as conspiracy.

relatives.title: The Battle of Algiers
relatives.shares: an occupier squeezing a whole population to make it surrender the men in its middle

relatives.title: Army of Shadows
relatives.shares: an underground deciding who among its own has to be killed to protect the rest

relatives.title: Rome, Open City
relatives.shares: an ordinary household hiding a hunted man and paying for it with a life

relatives.title: Sophie's Choice
relatives.shares: a person handed the arithmetic of whose life to buy and whose to give up

relatives.title: Le Silence de la mer
relatives.shares: a father and daughter under one roof holding a line against an occupier in their house

films.title: High and Low
films.engine: A man who has mortgaged everything he owns for one decisive move gets a ransom call and learns the kidnapper took the wrong boy — his driver's son, not his own — so the price of another family's child is now his entire future. He refuses, then pays, and is ruined and publicly celebrated for it. At the end he sits across a glass screen from the young man who did it, who tells him he did it because he could see that house up on the hill from his window every single day.

predicaments.situation: one must be ruined to save a child
predicaments.basis: Gondō has mortgaged all his property for a leveraged buyout of National Shoes when the kidnapper demands the same ransom for his chauffeur's son, and paying costs him the company, the loan collateral and his house.

predicaments.situation: a child is held by strangers for gain
predicaments.basis: The kidnappers seize Jun's playmate Shin'ichi by mistake and keep him at a hideout, demanding the ransom anyway once they realise the error.

predicaments.situation: one man envies the life he can see
predicaments.basis: The kidnapper, a medical intern at a nearby hospital, tells Gondō in prison that seeing his house on the hill every day is what made him conceive the crime, and that he has no regrets.

predicaments.situation: one betrays the man he was serving
predicaments.basis: Gondō's top aide tells the rival cheap-shoes faction about the kidnapping in exchange for a promotion once they take control.

predicaments.situation: two enemies finally stand face to face
predicaments.basis: The condemned kidnapper asks to see Gondō, who agrees, and their meeting ends with a screen dropping between them as he is dragged away shrieking.

relatives.title: Parasite
relatives.shares: a crime grows directly out of one household looking up at another's house every day

relatives.title: M
relatives.shares: a whole city organises around a taken child and ends face to face with the man who took them

relatives.title: A Separation
relatives.shares: the cost of one household's crisis lands on the poorer family that works for them

relatives.title: Ransom
relatives.shares: a wealthy man must decide what a kidnapped child is worth against his own standing

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a man's entire livelihood hangs on a sum he cannot afford, with a child watching him decide

films.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
films.engine: A rail line is coming, and everything turns on one patch of desert with water under it that a bride from New Orleans inherits the day her new family is shot. Three men want something off that land — one wants the money, one wants to own it, and one wants nothing but the man who once used him as the stool under his brother's noose.

predicaments.situation: a grown man hunts his childhood tormentor
predicaments.basis: Harmonica has spent his life tracking Frank, who once made him stand under his hanging brother playing a harmonica until the boy collapsed.

predicaments.situation: two enemies finally stand face to face
predicaments.basis: Frank rides to Sweetwater where Harmonica is waiting, and the duel ends with Harmonica pushing the harmonica into the dying man's mouth.

predicaments.situation: a family is killed to clear the way
predicaments.basis: Frank and his gang murder Brett McBain and his three children at Sweetwater to stop the watering station that stands between the railroad and the land.

predicaments.situation: a newcomer inherits what powerful men want
predicaments.basis: Jill, a former prostitute married to McBain a month earlier in New Orleans, arrives to find herself the widow owning Sweetwater, which both Frank and the railway tycoon Morton intend to take.

predicaments.situation: one betrays the man he was serving
predicaments.basis: Morton hired Frank only to intimidate McBain; Frank murders the family and decides he wants the land himself, and Morton answers by bribing Frank's own men to kill him.

relatives.title: Oldboy
relatives.shares: a man's entire adult life is the working-out of one scene done to him as a boy

relatives.title: Lady Snowblood
relatives.shares: a childhood destroyed by a group of men becomes a life spent finding each of them

relatives.title: Days of Heaven
relatives.shares: an outsider's marriage decides who ends up holding the land everyone is circling

relatives.title: A Bittersweet Life
relatives.shares: a man kept by a powerful employer turns on him and both go down for it

relatives.title: The Ballad of Cable Hogue
relatives.shares: water on a dry patch of ground is the only leverage a lone claimant has against what is coming

films.title: The Mirror
films.engine: A middle-aged man, ill and never shown, goes back over the scenes he cannot get clear of: a mother left by her husband crying at a window, a burning barn, a childhood house he can never quite get into in dreams. In the present he quarrels with that mother by phone and with an ex-wife who wears the same face, argues over which of them their son should live with, and puts the question to the boy himself, who denies ever having asked for him.

predicaments.situation: a parent walks out on a small child
predicaments.basis: A passing doctor notes that Maria's husband has left her at the dacha; the father is absent through Aleksei's childhood and only returns after the war, to a still-bitter wife and tearful children.

predicaments.situation: a grown child quarrels endlessly with a parent
predicaments.basis: Aleksei has a testy phone call with his mother, who hangs up on him; he blames her for being too controlling while Natalia tells him the strain is his own fault.

predicaments.situation: a man repeats his father with his son
predicaments.basis: Aleksei, whose father left, now lives apart from Ignat and fights Natalia over custody while the same actor plays Ignat and the twelve-year-old Aleksei.

predicaments.situation: a child is asked to choose between parents
predicaments.basis: Aleksei claims Ignat has said he wants to live with him, then puts it to the boy directly, and Ignat denies ever saying such a thing.

predicaments.situation: a man returns to a face from childhood
predicaments.basis: Aleksei says it is Natalia's face he sees when he remembers his mother, and the same actress plays both; his recurring dream returns him to the childhood dacha he cannot enter.

predicaments.situation: a man cannot make anyone hear his distress
predicaments.basis: The adult Aleksei is afflicted by an unexplained malady, and every attempt to talk — with his mother, with Natalia — turns into an argument about whose fault he is.

relatives.title: Wild Strawberries
relatives.shares: an ill man walks back through his own remembered scenes and arrives at an unfinished account with his mother

relatives.title: The Tree of Life
relatives.shares: a grown man reassembles a childhood house, an absent parent and a lost sibling out of fragments

relatives.title: Distant Voices, Still Lives
relatives.shares: a family is held only as disconnected scenes organised around the father's presence and absence

relatives.title: Kramer vs. Kramer
relatives.shares: two parents argue over which of them the boy should live with, and the boy's own wish is the thing in dispute

relatives.title: Yi Yi
relatives.shares: a man's present marriage is measured against the girl and the choices of his youth

films.title: La Jetée
films.engine: After a war has driven the survivors underground, experimenters need someone whose hold on a single past moment is strong enough to survive being sent back, and they pick a prisoner who has never let go of a woman's face on an airport observation deck and a man dying there when he was a boy. He reaches her, is offered permanent refuge in a future that would save him, and asks to be returned to her instead — where he learns that the dying man he watched as a child was himself.

predicaments.situation: a man returns to a face from childhood
predicaments.basis: The prisoner's obsessive prewar memory of a woman on the jetty at Orly is what makes him usable to the scientists, and he goes back to her again and again until they become lovers.

predicaments.situation: a man is made useful by his captors
predicaments.basis: Scientists in the Palais de Chaillot galleries send test subjects through time to save the present, discard those who cannot withstand it, and plan to execute him once he brings back the power unit.

predicaments.situation: a man refuses escape to return to her
predicaments.basis: Offered permanent asylum by the people of the future, he asks instead to be put back on the prewar jetty to find the woman.

predicaments.situation: a man walks into the death he foresaw
predicaments.basis: Running toward her on the platform, he sees his jailers' agent and understands that the death he witnessed as a child was his own.

predicaments.situation: a child witnesses something he cannot understand
predicaments.basis: As a boy on the observation platform he knew only that he had seen a man die, and the unresolved image governs the rest of his life.

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man rebuilds a woman out of an image and dies at the site of the death that started it

relatives.title: Je t'aime, je t'aime
relatives.shares: experimenters send a man repeatedly into one remembered moment with a woman he cannot leave

relatives.title: Solaris
relatives.shares: the researchers' apparatus hands a man the woman from his memory and he chooses her over going home

relatives.title: Arrival
relatives.shares: a person accepts a life whose ending they have already seen

relatives.title: Oedipus Rex
relatives.shares: the thing a man spends his life pursuing turns out to be his own doom, already witnessed

films.title: Taxi Driver
films.engine: A sleepless veteran drives nights, keeps a diary he can barely write, and cannot get anyone — a woman he takes on a disastrous date, a fellow driver he half-confesses murder to — to hear how bad it has become. Turned away by her, he buys guns, trains, and tries first to shoot a presidential candidate; when that fails he empties himself into freeing a twelve-year-old from the men who sell her, and wakes up thanked by her parents and the newspapers.

predicaments.situation: a man cannot make anyone hear his distress
predicaments.basis: Travis tells Wizard about his violent thoughts and is told he'll be fine; his diary is the only place his deteriorating state is recorded.

predicaments.situation: one is turned away by the person desired
predicaments.basis: Betsy walks out of the adult theatre he takes her to on their second date, refuses to reconcile, and has him thrown out of the campaign office when he comes back shouting.

predicaments.situation: a child is held by strangers for gain
predicaments.basis: Iris, twelve years old, works out of a brothel under her pimp Sport, who is also her abusive lover, and Travis has to pose as a customer to speak with her alone.

predicaments.situation: one must be ruined to save a child
predicaments.basis: Travis walks into the brothel, kills Sport, the mafioso client and the bouncer, takes several bullets, tries to shoot himself and goes into a coma; Iris returns to school in Pittsburgh.

predicaments.situation: one man appoints himself judge of everyone
predicaments.basis: Disgusted by the crime around him, Travis decides to get the scum off the streets, buys four handguns from Easy Andy, trains, and scopes the security at Senator Palantine's rallies.

predicaments.situation: the public makes a hero of him
predicaments.basis: The press hails the massacre as the work of a heroic vigilante, he is not prosecuted, Iris's parents write to thank him, and Betsy gets into his cab having followed the story.

relatives.title: Pickpocket
relatives.shares: a solitary man narrates his own drift into crime through a diary that is his only confidant

relatives.title: The Searchers
relatives.shares: a man appoints himself the rescuer of a girl living among people he has decided are filth

relatives.title: Le Samouraï
relatives.shares: a man's entire social life is the routine of his work, and nobody hears anything he doesn't do with a gun

relatives.title: The King of Comedy
relatives.shares: a rejected man converts his isolation into a public act and the public rewards him for it

relatives.title: Hardcore
relatives.shares: an outsider moves through a sex trade determined to take a girl back to her family

films.title: Eraserhead
films.engine: A man is told over dinner by his girlfriend's mother that there is a child, that it may not even be a child, and that they must marry. It cries without stopping in his one-room apartment until the mother walks out, leaving him alone with a bandaged, skinless thing that cannot eat or breathe properly — and when the woman across the hall proves to be with someone else too, he picks up a pair of scissors and cuts the swaddling open.

predicaments.situation: two are made to marry over a child
predicaments.basis: Mary's mother corners Henry after dinner, tells him Mary has had his child and that the two must wed, though Mary herself is not sure what she bore.

predicaments.situation: a parent walks out on a small child
predicaments.basis: The infant's incessant crying drives Mary hysterical and she leaves the apartment, abandoning both it and Henry.

predicaments.situation: a man is left alone with a child
predicaments.basis: Henry stays in the one-room apartment tending a thing that refuses all food, struggles to breathe and develops sores, while his visions get worse.

predicaments.situation: one is turned away by the person desired
predicaments.basis: After a night with the woman across the hall, Henry goes to find her again and sees her with another man, and returns crushed to his room.

predicaments.situation: one kills what one was keeping alive
predicaments.basis: Henry cuts the bandages that turn out to be holding the child's organs in, then stabs the organs with the scissors as it gasps.

relatives.title: Rosemary's Baby
relatives.shares: a pregnancy produces something that may not be human and the family around it has already decided the marriage

relatives.title: Possession
relatives.shares: a marriage yields a creature, the mother walks out, and the remaining partner is left tending it

relatives.title: Grave of the Fireflies
relatives.shares: one person is left alone keeping a helpless child alive in a room and fails

relatives.title: Repulsion
relatives.shares: a person alone in a single apartment as the room itself turns hostile and the visions take over

relatives.title: The Fly
relatives.shares: tenderness toward a body that is coming apart ends in the caretaker having to end it

films.title: Blowup
films.engine: A photographer who points his camera at people he has no real interest in accidentally records what looks like a killing in a park, and enlarging the frames again and again is the only way he can make it exist. Once the body, the negatives and the woman have all been taken away, all that is left is his own certainty, and he cannot hand that to anybody — not the woman who wants the film back, not the agent he begs to come and look. The film is about the gap between having seen something and being able to make it real for another person.

predicaments.situation: what one saw cannot be shown to others
predicaments.basis: Thomas enlarges his park negatives until a gunman and a body appear, but the prints and negatives are stolen, the corpse is gone by morning, and he is left with one grainy blow-up nobody can read.

predicaments.situation: the one telling the truth is disbelieved
predicaments.basis: Thomas telephones his agent Ron claiming he may have saved a man's life, then begs him at the party to come to the park as a witness, and Ron, stoned, simply will not take it seriously.

predicaments.situation: a stranger demands back what was taken
predicaments.basis: Jane chases Thomas through the park and later comes to his studio pleading for the roll of film he shot of her and her lover, offering herself for it; he palms her a different roll and she leaves a false phone number.

predicaments.situation: a crowd fights over what nobody actually wants
predicaments.basis: At the club a bored audience only comes alive once the guitarist smashes his instrument and throws the neck into them; Thomas fights his way out with it and drops it in the street, where a passer-by picks it up, looks at it and discards it.

predicaments.situation: a shared pretence becomes as good as real
predicaments.basis: The mime troupe plays tennis with no ball until Thomas throws their imaginary ball back, at which point the sound of the ball being struck is heard and he fades from the grass.

relatives.title: The Conversation
relatives.shares: a professional watcher assembles a recording into evidence of a killing and cannot make anyone else act on it

relatives.title: Rashomon
relatives.shares: what happened cannot be established between the people who saw it

relatives.title: Caché
relatives.shares: images arrive proving something occurred, and the proof leads nowhere anyone will follow

relatives.title: Memories of Murder
relatives.shares: the investigation dissolves and leaves only the investigator's private conviction

relatives.title: Picnic at Hanging Rock
relatives.shares: a disappearance that leaves no recoverable body and no accepted account

films.title: Persona
films.engine: A nurse is sent to a seaside cottage to look after an actress who has decided to stop speaking, and mistakes that silence for the first real attention anyone has paid her; she tells the woman everything she has never told anyone. When she opens a letter and discovers she was being observed rather than heard, the arrangement turns vicious, and the two of them start losing the line between who is confessing and who is being confessed to.

predicaments.situation: one person's confessions become another's material
predicaments.basis: Alma tells Elisabet about the beach orgy and the abortion she still feels guilty for, then reads Elisabet's unsealed letter home and finds her own story written up as something Elisabet is "studying".

predicaments.situation: silence from one drives the other to speak
predicaments.basis: Elisabet has stopped speaking by an act of will, and Alma, saying no one has ever really listened to her, fills the cottage with her fiancé, her affair, her guilt — until Elisabet's one spoken plea not to be scalded is the first word she is sure of.

predicaments.situation: a mother cannot love the child she made
predicaments.basis: Elisabet tears up the photograph of her son sent by her husband, and Alma recounts back to her the pregnancy she regretted, the failed self-induced abortion, and the boy she despises who craves her love.

predicaments.situation: a man mistakes one woman for another
predicaments.basis: Elisabet's husband arrives at night calling her name, addresses Alma as Elisabet, and though she tells him he is mistaken they have sex anyway.

predicaments.situation: two people become hard to tell apart
predicaments.basis: Alma ends by telling Elisabet's life story as if it were her own, then breaks off insisting on her own identity and denying that she is Elisabet.

relatives.title: 3 Women
relatives.shares: two women in isolation trade selves until neither holds her own outline

relatives.title: Mulholland Drive
relatives.shares: one woman's life is absorbed and retold by the other

relatives.title: The Servant
relatives.shares: a caretaking arrangement inverts into control of the one who was meant to be caring

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man's intimacy rests on taking one woman for another

relatives.title: Certified Copy
relatives.shares: two people slip into an identity that is not theirs and cannot get back out of it

films.title: Au Hasard Balthazar
films.engine: A donkey christened by children on a farm is handed on down a chain of people who each work him, beat him, exhibit him or sell him, and is finally shot while carrying somebody else's contraband. Beside him the girl he was raised with keeps going back to the young man who assaults and humiliates her, refusing the one who wants to marry her, until both she and the animal have been used up by the same handful of people in the same few fields.

predicaments.situation: a creature is passed from owner to owner
predicaments.basis: Balthazar goes from the children to Marie's family, to farmhands who work him relentlessly, to a bakery, to Gérard, to Arnold and the tourist trade, to a circus, to a miller who runs him on the pump and the millstone, and finally to smugglers.

predicaments.situation: someone keeps returning to the one hurting her
predicaments.basis: Marie takes up with Gérard after he forces himself on her in her car, leaves her parents for him, runs away soaked in the rain, and then goes back to the barn to confront him, where he and his gang strip her, beat her and lock her in.

predicaments.situation: shelter is offered with a price attached
predicaments.basis: The miller takes Marie in on a wet night and talks of helping her get away, then in the morning goes to her parents and offers them the donkey, on the understanding that the girl will come back with it.

predicaments.situation: a quarrel between families ruins both households
predicaments.basis: Marie's father and Jacques' father fight for years over the farm and the court-ordered money; Jacques comes to say his father no longer wants it, and by then Marie is gone for good and her father dies.

predicaments.situation: the innocent suffer for what others do
predicaments.basis: Arnold is beaten by Gérard's gang as a suspected murderer and informer without being charged with anything, and Balthazar takes the customs guards' bullet meant for the smugglers who abandon him in the field.

relatives.title: Vagabond
relatives.shares: a drifting figure passes through a chain of people who each take something and pass her on

relatives.title: Umberto D.
relatives.shares: a helpless dependent is moved along by people with no room for it

relatives.title: EO
relatives.shares: an animal is handed between owners and registers each one's cruelty without appeal

relatives.title: The Turin Horse
relatives.shares: a working animal is driven to collapse by the household that needs it

relatives.title: Kes
relatives.shares: a creature loved by one powerless child is destroyed by everyone around them

films.title: The Conformist
films.engine: As a boy, Marcello was taken in by an adult who assaulted him, shot at him, and — he believes ever after — died for it. He spends his life buying ordinary respectability with obedience: a wife he thinks little of, a confession he does not believe, work for the secret police, and finally a honeymoon used as cover to lead assassins to his old professor and to the professor's wife, whom he wants. Years later he learns the man he thought he killed is alive, and that everything he bought was paid for on a debt that never existed.

predicaments.situation: a trusted adult forces himself on a child
predicaments.basis: In 1917 the chauffeur Lino rescues Marcello from schoolmates, shows him a pistol and then assaults him; the boy fires at him and runs, believing he is a murderer.

predicaments.situation: a man marries to look like everyone else
predicaments.basis: Marcello tells Italo he is marrying for normality, admits in confession that he thinks little of Giulia but wants the ordinary life of a wife and children, and goes to confession as an atheist purely to satisfy her Catholic parents.

predicaments.situation: one betrays a friend to those hunting him
predicaments.basis: Marcello hands Manganiello the location of Professor Quadri's country house, sits in the car while agents stab Quadri and shoot Anna in the woods, and in 1943 denounces his blind friend Italo to an anti-Fascist crowd that sweeps him away.

predicaments.situation: he loves the woman he has already condemned
predicaments.basis: Marcello pursues Anna, Quadri's wife, warns her not to travel to Savoy, and then watches from the back seat as she recognises him, screams, and is run down and shot.

predicaments.situation: those in power protect their own from consequence
predicaments.basis: The priest, shocked by Marcello's account of rape, killing, and his own absence of guilt, absolves him the moment he learns Marcello works for the Fascist secret police.

predicaments.situation: a man learns his great sin never happened
predicaments.basis: On the night Mussolini falls, Marcello sees Lino alive on the street flirting with a young man, realises there was no murder, and starts screaming accusations at him in the open.

relatives.title: Mr. Klein
relatives.shares: a man buys safety through conformity under a regime and is destroyed by the identity he was avoiding

relatives.title: Army of Shadows
relatives.shares: a comrade is delivered to the people who will kill him by someone inside the circle

relatives.title: The Remains of the Day
relatives.shares: a life of obedient ordinariness built to avoid an unbearable private truth

relatives.title: The Lives of Others
relatives.shares: a state functionary is placed inside the domestic life of the intellectual he has been assigned

relatives.title: The Act of Killing
relatives.shares: a man discovers that the killing he organised his whole self around is not what he believed it to be

films.title: Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion
films.engine: A man newly raised to the top of a police hierarchy murders his mistress and then runs the investigation into her death himself, feeding his subordinates clues pointing away from him and then straight back at him. What he wants is not to escape but to find out whether the institution he serves is capable of accusing him — and when he finally confesses outright to his superiors, they refuse to hear it and make him take it back.

predicaments.situation: a man leads the hunt for himself
predicaments.basis: The inspector kills his mistress, covers his involvement, inserts himself into the investigation, steers his officers first toward her husband and a student radical, clears them, and then plants every possible piece of evidence against himself.

predicaments.situation: the one telling the truth is disbelieved
predicaments.basis: He confesses the murder to his superiors in front of them and they simply will not accept it, pressing him until he recants with the commissioner's approval.

predicaments.situation: those in power protect their own from consequence
predicaments.basis: The police hierarchy would rather have an unsolved killing than a confessed one at its own summit, so the commissioner signs off on the withdrawal of the confession and the case closes over him.

predicaments.situation: the only witness refuses to speak against him
predicaments.basis: The anarchist Antonio Pace, the one person who can place him at the victim's apartment, declines to accuse him, preferring to leave a criminal running the repression as proof of what power is.

relatives.title: The Trial
relatives.shares: guilt and accusation come loose from each other inside an apparatus that will not resolve either

relatives.title: Z
relatives.shares: an institution closes ranks around the men who did the killing

relatives.title: Crimes and Misdemeanors
relatives.shares: a killer waits to be accused and finds the world has no mechanism to do it

relatives.title: Match Point
relatives.shares: the guilty man is cleared by the very process meant to catch him

films.title: The Battle of Algiers
films.engine: In an occupied city, an underground network builds itself cell by cell in the old quarter while the army sent to break it works down the chain by torture, each name bought with pain producing the next. Both sides put their bombs and their reprisals where ordinary people are, and when the last man in hiding is finally surrounded the organisation is finished — after which the streets fill anyway.

predicaments.situation: each side answers the other's cruelty with worse
predicaments.basis: Partisan violence between Algerians and pieds-noirs escalates until the FLN bombs European cafés and the security forces answer with indiscriminate killings, both sides committing atrocities against civilians.

predicaments.situation: a person is hurt until they name someone
predicaments.basis: The film opens with one of Ali la Pointe's compatriots giving up his hideout after being tortured, and the paratroopers are shown taking apart the whole FLN leadership by routine torture and intimidation.

predicaments.situation: one betrays a friend to those hunting him
predicaments.basis: The tortured compatriot tells the French Army where Ali la Pointe is, and the Army arrives to tell him he is surrounded and the organisation is finished.

predicaments.situation: the innocent suffer for what others do
predicaments.basis: Djamila, Zohra and Hassiba carry bombs into places full of Europeans going about their day, and the security forces answer with indiscriminate violence in the Casbah; the dead on both sides are civilians.

predicaments.situation: destroying the few does not stop the many
predicaments.basis: The paratroopers kill or capture every FLN leader in the city, and the film closes on mass demonstrations and rioting years later — the battle won and the war lost.

relatives.title: Rome, Open City
relatives.shares: an occupied city's network is broken by torturing names out of the people it catches

relatives.title: Army of Shadows
relatives.shares: a clandestine organisation is unravelled from the captured man outward

relatives.title: The Wind That Shakes the Barley
relatives.shares: occupier and insurgent escalate into atrocities on civilians in a war neither can end cleanly

relatives.title: Bloody Sunday
relatives.shares: a security operation against a population produces the uprising it was meant to prevent

relatives.title: Come and See
relatives.shares: the violence of an occupation lands almost entirely on people with no part in it

films.title: Le Samouraï
films.engine: A man has built a life nothing can reach into — a bare rented room, a caged bird, rehearsed alibis, a woman who will swear to whatever he needs — and the work that pays for it quietly cancels all of it: the people who hired him decide he is now a risk, and the one person who watched him leave the killing refuses to give him up. The rest of the film is him finding out who owns him, and then handing himself over to be shot in front of her.

predicaments.situation: help is repaid with violence
predicaments.basis: Jef goes to collect his fee for killing the nightclub owner Martey and the man he meets shoots him in the arm instead of paying.

predicaments.situation: a person sees everything then says nothing
predicaments.basis: Valérie, the club's piano player, sees Jef leaving the scene and then fails to pick him out at the identity parade.

predicaments.situation: someone is made to lie to shield another
predicaments.basis: Jane holds an alibi for Jef and flatly refuses the police offer to be left alone if she recants it.

predicaments.situation: a person becomes an inconvenience to be removed
predicaments.basis: Once witnesses place Jef near Martey's body, Olivier Rey's organisation treats him as a liability to be closed off rather than paid.

predicaments.situation: a person walks knowingly toward their own death
predicaments.basis: Jef enters the club making no effort to hide, leaves his hat-check ticket on the counter, puts on his white gloves in full view and points an unloaded gun at Valérie.

relatives.title: Branded to Kill
relatives.shares: a hired killer becomes the next name on his own organisation's list

relatives.title: Sonatine
relatives.shares: men realise their own side sent them out to be disposed of

relatives.title: Pickpocket
relatives.shares: a man whose whole method is solitude is undone by the one person who declines to turn him in

relatives.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
relatives.shares: a killer marked for death by his employers walks into the ending rather than fleeing it

relatives.title: The American
relatives.shares: a solitary professional's single attachment arrives exactly as his employers decide to erase him

films.title: Onibaba
films.engine: Two women — a mother and the wife of her dead son — stay alive by ambushing lost soldiers in a reed field, stripping the bodies and trading the armour for food, and the work needs two pairs of hands. When a neighbour comes back from the war and starts sleeping with the younger woman, the older one is watching her livelihood and her only company walk off together, so she uses a dead man's mask to frighten the girl into staying — until the mask will not come off.

predicaments.situation: one person's survival depends on another staying
predicaments.basis: The older woman cannot ambush and rob passing soldiers by herself, and pleads with Hachi not to take her daughter-in-law away from her.

predicaments.situation: a guardian forbids the young one a lover
predicaments.basis: The older woman warns her daughter-in-law to stay away from Hachi, blaming him for her son's death, and then physically blocks her path at night.

predicaments.situation: a woman wants the man her daughter has
predicaments.basis: The older woman tries to seduce Hachi herself once she learns of the affair, and is coldly rebuffed.

predicaments.situation: a person frightens another with a false face
predicaments.basis: Wearing the robes and hannya mask taken from the samurai she tricked into the pit, the older woman waylays the girl at night and tells her by day that the demon is punishment for the affair.

predicaments.situation: a deception closes on the one deceiving
predicaments.basis: After the rain the mask cannot be pulled off, and when the younger woman breaks it away with a mallet the face beneath is ruined like the samurai's.

relatives.title: What Ever Happened to Baby Jane?
relatives.shares: one woman keeps another confined because she cannot survive alone

relatives.title: The Piano Teacher
relatives.shares: an older woman polices a younger one's desire out of her own need for her

relatives.title: The Beguiled
relatives.shares: a man returned from the war sets the women of one household against each other

relatives.title: Eyes Without a Face
relatives.shares: a face is lost and a covering becomes permanent

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: people living off a war's wreckage, and a woman who becomes something monstrous to those who loved her

films.title: Lolita
films.engine: A man takes a room in a widow's house, sees her adolescent daughter, and marries the mother purely to stay near the girl; when the mother reads his diary and dies, the child is his to collect from summer camp and drive around the country as her father. The rest is him trying to hold her — against boys, a school play, and a rival who keeps appearing in other men's disguises — until she goes with the rival and, years later, wants nothing from him but cash.

predicaments.situation: one marries the mother to reach the daughter
predicaments.basis: Humbert has no interest in the room until he sees Dolores in the garden, and accepts Charlotte's marriage ultimatum only because it keeps him in the house.

predicaments.situation: a hidden contempt is discovered by its object
predicaments.basis: Charlotte finds Humbert's diary, reads his passion for her daughter and his disgust at her, and runs into the road.

predicaments.situation: a man raises a child not his own
predicaments.basis: After Charlotte's death Humbert collects Dolores from camp, tells her only later that her mother is dead, and travels the country with her as father and daughter.

predicaments.situation: a guardian forbids the young one a lover
predicaments.basis: At Beardsley, Humbert polices Dolores's male classmates, resists her taking the lead in the school play, and confronts her over the missed piano lessons.

predicaments.situation: a man is stalked by an unnamed rival
predicaments.basis: Clare Quilty turns up as a hotel guest, as a policeman, as the school psychologist Dr. Zempf and as a car in the mirror, and finally takes Dolores out of the hospital as her uncle.

relatives.title: The Night of the Hunter
relatives.shares: a man marries a woman in order to get at the children in her house

relatives.title: Beau Père
relatives.shares: a stepfather alone with his dead wife's teenage daughter

relatives.title: Manhattan
relatives.shares: a middle-aged man's hold on a girl ends with her leaving for a life he cannot follow into

relatives.title: Happiness
relatives.shares: a concealed desire for a child carried inside an unremarkable household

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man is steered through his own obsession by a rival he never sees clearly until the end

films.title: Autumn Sonata
films.engine: A daughter invites the mother she has not seen for seven years to the parsonage where she is also nursing her disabled sister, and in one night finally says the thing she has been assembling for a lifetime: that the concert career and the string of men were paid for out of her children. The mother came expecting a pleasant visit, is made to hear it, half admits it, and is gone on the morning train.

predicaments.situation: a grown child accuses a parent of neglect
predicaments.basis: Eva confronts Charlotte with the years away, the emotional coldness, and the pregnancy Charlotte pressed her to end.

predicaments.situation: one person's survival depends on another staying
predicaments.basis: Helena is paralysed and was brought home from the hospital by Eva, who is the only person keeping her.

predicaments.situation: someone unable to speak is spoken for
predicaments.basis: Helena's speech is fragmented and only Eva can understand it, while Charlotte discusses her in her presence and gives her a wristwatch.

predicaments.situation: a person sees everything then says nothing
predicaments.basis: Viktor listens to the whole confrontation from another room and chooses not to intervene.

predicaments.situation: a person becomes an inconvenience to be removed
predicaments.basis: On the train, Charlotte reflects on the encounter with Helena and asks why she couldn't die.

predicaments.situation: a reconciliation is attempted too late
predicaments.basis: Eva writes an apology letter to her mother, which Viktor reads aloud and seals, its fate left uncertain.

relatives.title: Ordinary People
relatives.shares: a parent who cannot love the surviving child, made to hear it said out loud

relatives.title: Marvin's Room
relatives.shares: the sibling who stayed to nurse the invalid faces the one who left

relatives.title: Still Walking
relatives.shares: a single family visit in which decades of unspoken accounting comes due

relatives.title: August: Osage County
relatives.shares: one night in which a mother and daughter say everything they have withheld

relatives.title: Tokyo Story
relatives.shares: parents and grown children discover what the years of absence actually cost

films.title: Mouchette
films.engine: A girl of school age keeps a collapsing household running — a dying mother in bed, an infant brother, a father who shouts — and is ostracised at school for how she looks. In the space of a day she is sheltered by a poacher, nurses him through a fit, is raped by him, is asked to be his alibi, finds her mother dead, and is handed charity by neighbours who cannot look at her without contempt; then she rolls down a bank into the river.

predicaments.situation: a child carries the household alone
predicaments.basis: Mouchette does all the housework, feeds and changes her infant brother, and takes instructions from her bedbound mother while her father is out drinking.

roles.carried: her mother, father and baby brother

predicaments.situation: help is repaid with violence
predicaments.basis: She shelters in Arsène's hut, tends him gently through his seizure, and he seizes and rapes her when he comes round.

predicaments.situation: someone is made to lie to shield another
predicaments.basis: Arsène wants her to place him in his hut all night to cover the fight with the gamekeeper, and she tells Mathieu and his wife that she stayed there because he is her lover.

predicaments.situation: someone rejects the pity offered to them
predicaments.basis: The shopkeeper's free coffee ends with her being called a little slut, and the old woman's gift of dresses and a shroud is answered with an insult and a stained carpet.

predicaments.situation: a person walks knowingly toward their own death
predicaments.basis: After watching hunters shoot rabbits, she rolls down the hill in the new dress again and again until she goes into the river and does not come back up.

relatives.title: Vagabond
relatives.shares: a girl refuses every hand extended to her and ends dead in a ditch

relatives.title: Rosetta
relatives.shares: a girl holding a household together against a mother who cannot be relied on

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: children keeping a home running with no adult who will stay

relatives.title: Sansho the Bailiff
relatives.shares: a young woman walks into water because there is no other exit left

relatives.title: The 400 Blows
relatives.shares: a child whose every adult — parent, teacher, neighbour — hands them back to the same trap

films.title: The Wild Child
films.engine: A boy who has grown up alone in a forest is run down by villagers with dogs and smoked out of a hole, taken to Paris, and given to a doctor who refuses his colleagues' verdict that the child is an idiot and stakes his own conviction on teaching him to speak. Everything the boy gains — words, a house, a place among people — is bought with the thing that let him live in the woods.

predicaments.situation: a person is hunted like an animal
predicaments.basis: A woman's scream brings hunters and a pack of dogs after the naked boy; they tree him, set the dogs on him and force him from his hole with smoke.

predicaments.situation: someone unable to speak is spoken for
predicaments.basis: Unable to speak or understand language, the boy is placed among deaf-mutes and called an idiot by others until Itard decides his silence is the result of his upbringing.

predicaments.situation: a person becomes the proof of another's belief
predicaments.basis: Itard's claim that deprivation rather than nature made the boy what he is can only be tested on the boy himself.

predicaments.situation: a man raises a child not his own
predicaments.basis: Itard takes custody, moves the boy to his house on the outskirts of Paris, names him Victor and educates him with his housekeeper.

predicaments.situation: freedom is traded for a place among people
predicaments.basis: As Victor acquires the rudiments of language and the habits of the house, he loses the capacity that let him live wild, and settles at the windows between the interior and the world outside.

relatives.title: The Enigma of Kaspar Hauser
relatives.shares: a person formed outside society is taken in, taught, and measured against what the teachers already believe

relatives.title: The Miracle Worker
relatives.shares: a teacher insists a child written off as unreachable can be brought into language

relatives.title: Dersu Uzala
relatives.shares: a man of the forest is brought under a roof and diminished by what the roof requires

relatives.title: My Fair Lady
relatives.shares: a person is remade to prove a theory and cannot go back to where they came from

relatives.title: Nell
relatives.shares: someone found living alone without language becomes the ground of an argument between the people examining her

films.title: Muriel
films.engine: A widow invites back the man she refused to follow abroad decades ago, hoping the two weeks will restage the choice; meanwhile her stepson, who took part in torturing and killing a girl during his own war service, lives in the same rooms without ever saying so aloud. Everyone in the apartment is running a private version of the past, and the visitor's arrival makes each version impossible to keep quiet.

predicaments.situation: old lovers try to resume an interrupted life
predicaments.basis: Hélène meets Alphonse off the night train twenty years after refusing to join him in Algiers, and they spend a morning walking the city imagining the life they did not have.

predicaments.situation: a partner conceals what would end the bond
predicaments.basis: Alphonse presents Françoise as his niece when she is his young lover, and hides a wife until his brother-in-law Ernest arrives demanding he go home.

predicaments.situation: a survivor keeps faith with the dead
predicaments.basis: Bernard fills a journal with Muriel, the girl he helped torture and murder in Algeria, writing that since her death he is "no longer alive".

predicaments.situation: someone is killed to keep the past quiet
predicaments.basis: Hélène urges Robert, who served alongside Bernard, to talk to him about the war; shortly afterwards Bernard has murdered him.

relatives.title: Hiroshima mon amour
relatives.shares: two people reopen an old love while one carries a wartime act that cannot be spoken

relatives.title: Casablanca
relatives.shares: a former lover reappears having concealed a marriage, and the interrupted affair is offered a second chance

relatives.title: The Act of Killing
relatives.shares: a man who took part in killing lives on unable to say plainly what he did

relatives.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
relatives.shares: a household cannot reach the young man who came back from a war stunted

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: someone tries to restage a past evening exactly and discovers it will not hold

films.title: Rosemary's Baby
films.engine: A young actor's wife is handed to the elderly neighbours who can make his career, and carries the pregnancy they arranged; as she works out what was done to her, every person she can appeal to — husband, doctor, the friendly couple next door — turns out to be on the other side, so her correct fear only ever reads as a sick woman's nerves. At the end the people who used her offer her the one role they still have no one else for.

predicaments.situation: one partner trades the other for advancement
predicaments.basis: Guy gets the stage role after the original actor is blinded, having taken the man's necktie for the coven, and lets Rosemary be given to the demon on "baby night".

predicaments.situation: a partner conceals what would end the bond
predicaments.basis: Guy explains her scratches as sex while she was unconscious, throws away the witchcraft book, and hides his pact with the Castevets until Roman states it aloud.

predicaments.situation: a person's accurate fear is treated as illness
predicaments.basis: Dr. Hill assumes Rosemary is delusional and telephones Dr. Sapirstein, who arrives with Guy to take her home; her pains and suspicions are managed as pregnancy nerves throughout.

predicaments.situation: everyone turned to for help is complicit
predicaments.basis: Her obstetrician, her neighbours, her husband and finally the second-opinion doctor all belong to or defer to the coven; the one ally who researches the building falls into a coma and dies.

predicaments.situation: a warning is delivered and not believed
predicaments.basis: Hutch warns the Woodhouses about the Bramford's history of witchcraft and murder before they move in, and they ignore him.

predicaments.situation: a victim is offered a place among captors
predicaments.basis: Roman tells Rosemary the child is Satan's and asks her to mother him because the coven's women are too old; after spitting at Guy she rocks the cradle.

relatives.title: Get Out
relatives.shares: a welcoming household has already arranged what a guest's body is for, and the partner is in on it

relatives.title: Gaslight
relatives.shares: a husband arranges things so that his wife's correct perceptions look to everyone like her breakdown

relatives.title: The Wicker Man
relatives.shares: an entire community has agreed in advance on a use for the person moving among them

relatives.title: A Woman Under the Influence
relatives.shares: a woman's distress is handed to doctors and family to be managed rather than heard

relatives.title: Rebecca
relatives.shares: a young wife is isolated inside a household whose older keepers steer her at every turn

films.title: Daisies
films.engine: Two young women decide that because the world is already spoiled they are entitled to be spoiled too, and set about taking meals, attention and property from anyone who offers them, wrecking whatever they touch. The only relationship they have is with each other, and it turns out to consist entirely of the damage; when they try to be good instead, there is nothing left of them.

predicaments.situation: a pair set themselves against everyone else
predicaments.basis: The two Maries break up a nightclub floor show, rob a friendly bathroom attendant, and devour and demolish a banquet laid for absent guests.

predicaments.situation: intimacy is traded for food
predicaments.basis: They flirt with men for free meals, cry when one leaves and then laugh, and Marie II visits an admirer only to ask him for something to eat.

roles.paying: the older men who take them to lunch

predicaments.situation: a suitor's devotion is met with indifference
predicaments.basis: The butterfly collector declares his love for Marie II in person and again over the telephone while she and Marie I chop up sausages in front of the receiver.

predicaments.situation: two bound together come to resent each other
predicaments.basis: At the pool the Maries admit they no longer like each other, and back at the apartment they cut each other to pieces with scissors.

predicaments.situation: an offer of repentance comes too late
predicaments.basis: After being dunked in the water the Maries say they no longer want to be spoiled, tidy the wrecked room and lay it with broken dishes, and the chandelier falls on them.

relatives.title: Céline and Julie Go Boating
relatives.shares: two young women build a private world out of mischief that only works while they are both in it

relatives.title: Zéro de conduite
relatives.shares: a wrecked banquet as the whole content of a revolt

relatives.title: Heavenly Creatures
relatives.shares: a closed pair whose bond generates escalating damage neither would attempt alone

relatives.title: Thelma & Louise
relatives.shares: two women take what they are owed from men and cannot stop short of the end

relatives.title: Persona
relatives.shares: two women feeding off one another until the bond turns to mutual cruelty

films.title: Shadows of Forgotten Ancestors
films.engine: A young man loves the daughter of the man who killed his father, and while he is away earning the money for their household she drowns. He marries someone else and gives her nothing, because the dead girl is still the person he lives with; when his wife takes up with another man and he is beaten down, the dead one reaches across and takes him.

predicaments.situation: love crosses a line of inherited enmity
predicaments.basis: Ivan and Marichka have known each other since childhood although his father was killed by hers and the families remain at feud.

predicaments.situation: a survivor keeps faith with the dead
predicaments.basis: After finding Marichka's body Ivan works joylessly for years and stays fixed on her memory even inside his marriage.

predicaments.situation: a new bond cannot replace the lost one
predicaments.basis: Ivan and Palahna are blindfolded and yoked together in a Hutsul wedding, and the marriage sours at once because he is elsewhere.

predicaments.situation: the neglected spouse turns to another
predicaments.basis: Estranged from Ivan, Palahna takes up with the molfar Yurko, who strikes Ivan down when he comes at them with his axe.

predicaments.situation: the dead seem to call the living onward
predicaments.basis: Wounded in the woods, Ivan sees Marichka in the water and among the trees, and dies as her colourless shade touches his outstretched hand.

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: a man's life with the living is hollowed out by a woman who is already dead and finally claims him

relatives.title: Romeo and Juliet
relatives.shares: two young people love across a killing their families have not settled

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a living woman is asked to stand in for a drowned one and cannot

relatives.title: Wuthering Heights
relatives.shares: a man marries without love and walks out to die into the memory he never left

relatives.title: Onibaba
relatives.shares: a household in a remote place where desire, a sorcerous outsider and violence close the same circle

films.title: I Am Cuba
films.engine: Four people are shown exactly what their endurance costs them: a woman who keeps a second self for foreign customers and is seen at it by the man she means to marry, a farmer whose harvest turns out to belong to whoever owns the ground under it, a student who cannot fire on an enemy once he sees him with his children, and a peasant who wants no part of the fighting until the bombs take his son. Each is carried the same distance, from putting up with it to refusing.

predicaments.situation: a partner conceals what would end the bond
predicaments.basis: María is engaged to the fruit-seller René while working nights as "Betty" in a casino bar, and he walks into her hovel as her American client is leaving.

predicaments.situation: intimacy is traded for food
predicaments.basis: María takes a client home for a few dollars tossed at her in the morning, and he pockets her crucifix necklace on the way out.

predicaments.situation: the fruit of work belongs to another
predicaments.basis: Pedro's best sugar crop is standing when his landlord rides up to say the land is sold and he may keep only the sweat he put in; Pedro burns the crop and the house and dies in the smoke.

predicaments.situation: an enemy is seen among their children
predicaments.basis: Enrique has the chief of police in his sights and finds him at breakfast with his wife and small children, and cannot pull the trigger.

predicaments.situation: a bystander is forced to take a side
predicaments.basis: Mariano tells the rebel soldier to leave and that he only wants peace; the government's planes then bomb his land, killing his son, and he goes up to the mountains.

relatives.title: The Grapes of Wrath
relatives.shares: a farming family is told the ground they raised a crop on has been sold out from under them

relatives.title: The Battle of Algiers
relatives.shares: a person who wanted no part is pushed into armed refusal, and a killer hesitates once children are in view

relatives.title: Nights of Cabiria
relatives.shares: a woman keeping a second life for paying strangers is exposed to the man she meant to marry

relatives.title: Munich
relatives.shares: an assassin's hand stops when the target turns out to be a father at home

relatives.title: Vidas Secas
relatives.shares: the poorest work of a family is claimed entirely by whoever holds the land

films.title: Don't Look Now
films.engine: After their small daughter drowns, a husband and wife take their grief in opposite directions: strangers tell her the child is still speaking and she is comforted, he refuses all of it and treats her belief as a symptom. He keeps glimpsing a small red figure in the city and follows it as if the drowned girl were leading him, and the warnings he dismissed turn out to have been about his own death, not hers.

predicaments.situation: a survivor keeps faith with the dead
predicaments.basis: Laura sits with the blind sister who claims to see Christine and joins them for a séance to reach her.

predicaments.situation: two mourners grieve in incompatible ways
predicaments.basis: Laura is transformed by contact with the sisters while John stays sceptical, and the séance's message that he must leave Venice sets them arguing.

predicaments.situation: a person's accurate fear is treated as illness
predicaments.basis: John dismisses the warning as his wife's mental state, reports her missing to a police inspector who then suspects him, and only afterwards finds she was where she said.

predicaments.situation: a warning is delivered and not believed
predicaments.basis: Told through the sisters that Christine says he is in danger and must leave, John explains away the collapsing scaffold and stays.

predicaments.situation: the dead seem to call the living onward
predicaments.basis: John pursues the small figure in a red coat like Christine's through Venice into a deserted palazzo, where it turns and cuts his throat.

relatives.title: Ordinary People
relatives.shares: a marriage after a child's drowning splits along two incompatible ways of carrying it

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: a man follows what he takes for his own beloved dead and walks into ruin

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man chases a figure he believes is a dead woman through a city until it kills him

relatives.title: Antichrist
relatives.shares: a couple whose child died take opposite routes through grief, one clinical and one otherworldly

relatives.title: Cassandra's Dream
relatives.shares: a warning is spoken plainly and explained away by the person it is about

films.title: The Wicker Man
films.engine: A man who has never broken a rule in his life is summoned to a small island by an anonymous note about a missing child, and everything that makes him decent — his chastity, his obedience to law, his refusal to be turned — is quietly being ticked off against a list of requirements. He spends the film hunting for a girl in danger; the danger was aimed at him from the first day, and the people he despises need him to have come freely, which he did.

predicaments.situation: a stranger arrives sure his own rules apply
predicaments.basis: Sergeant Howie lands on Summerisle expecting Christian morality, a cooperative populace and the authority of mainland law, and finds open copulation in the fields, children taught the maypole's meaning and churches left to rot.

predicaments.situation: a group closes ranks against one man
predicaments.basis: Every islander he questions — the innkeeper, the schoolteacher, the children at the register, the girl's own mother — tells him in concert that Rowan Morrison never existed.

predicaments.situation: the one being sought arranged the search
predicaments.basis: The anonymous letter that brought Howie to the island was written by the very community he investigates, and Lord Summerisle helpfully grants the exhumation that leads him deeper in.

predicaments.situation: a man's own virtue is turned against him
predicaments.basis: He fits the gods' four requirements precisely because he is what he is — he came of his own free will, he carries the law, he refused the innkeeper's daughter and so is a virgin, and his righteousness made him easy to fool.

predicaments.situation: a man is kept from leaving by others
predicaments.basis: On May Day morning he returns to his seaplane to call the mainland and finds the engine dead and the radio smashed.

relatives.title: Woman in the Dunes
relatives.shares: a visitor is taken in by a community that needs a body for its own survival and quietly makes leaving impossible

relatives.title: Get Out
relatives.shares: a guest is welcomed with elaborate warmth by people who chose him for use before he arrived

relatives.title: Midsommar
relatives.shares: an outsider is walked through a festival whose ending requires one of the guests

relatives.title: Kill List
relatives.shares: a man follows an ordinary commission into a rite that was arranged around him

relatives.title: The Devils
relatives.shares: a man's own religious rigour is the exact quality his community needs in order to burn him

films.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
films.engine: A young man who believes arguments should be settled by law walks into a territory run by whoever hits hardest, faces the local bully with a gun he barely knows how to hold, and survives only because someone else fired from the dark at the same instant and never says so. The senate seat, the marriage and the honours that follow all rest on a killing he did not do; the man who did it gives away the credit and the woman in one gesture and drinks himself out of the story.
