predicaments.basis: Undressing in Chloé's flat after towelling her dry, Frédéric catches his reflection with his head through the turtleneck, remembers a game with his daughter, and slips out without a word.

predicaments.situation: two people can no longer speak plainly together
predicaments.basis: Frédéric talks with Chloé about things he finds himself unable to raise with Hélène; when he comes home the two of them grope for words until Hélène breaks down crying.

relatives.title: Brief Encounter
relatives.shares: an attachment carried right up to the act and then relinquished, the person going home to the marriage

relatives.title: In the Mood for Love
relatives.shares: two people who keep the intimacy and deliberately refuse the consummation

relatives.title: Eyes Wide Shut
relatives.shares: a married man's drift through near-infidelities that returns him, shaken, to his wife

relatives.title: The Lunchbox
relatives.shares: a confidant outside the marriage who receives what the spouse cannot be told

films.title: Loving Couples
films.engine: Three women arrive at the same maternity ward, all tied to one estate, all carrying children by men who are not the ones their circumstances assigned them. Working backwards through their lives, each was steered — by a father's death, by a payment, by what her class allowed — into a bed or a marriage she did not choose; then the war takes the men away and leaves the women holding the result.

predicaments.situation: marriage is arranged across a difference of class
predicaments.basis: Adèle's love for Daniel is broken off as a mésalliance and she is married to Tord, the tenant at Eka; the maid Agda is married to Stellan von Pahlen as a matter of convenience.

predicaments.situation: a marriage is paid for by a third person
predicaments.basis: Bernhard Landborg, who fathered Agda's child in the bushes at Ösa, secures the match by offering Stellan fifteen thousand kronor a year.

predicaments.situation: a household is impoverished by a death
predicaments.basis: Adèle's father dies and she falls from comfort to hawking candies through a string of humiliations; Angela is orphaned at her father's funeral and taken in by her aunt Petra.

predicaments.situation: a woman is forced by a familiar man
predicaments.basis: Teacher Bell tries to seduce Angela at the girls' boarding school, and an older man attempts to rape Agda during her childhood.

predicaments.situation: desire is pursued outside an intact marriage
predicaments.basis: Stellan plays erotic games with Mrs. Landborg at the midsummer party, and Petra, waiting at the station, sees the former lover who is now married with a son.

predicaments.situation: the women are left behind by departing men
predicaments.basis: War breaks out and the men of Eka go into military service and out of the women's daily lives, leaving the three of them to their pregnancies and Dr. Lewin's ward.

relatives.title: The Leopard
relatives.shares: marriages settled across a class line as an estate order gives way to a new era

relatives.title: Tess
relatives.shares: a girl of a fallen household preyed on by a man above her station and left carrying the result

relatives.title: The Rules of the Game
relatives.shares: a country house where nearly every desire runs outside the pairing it is supposed to belong to

relatives.title: Raise the Red Lantern
relatives.shares: women inside one household whose lives are wholly set by what the arrangement between men permits

relatives.title: The Go-Between
relatives.shares: a love that class forbids, yielding to the marriage the family requires

films.title: A Little Night Music
films.engine: A lawyer's second marriage has gone eleven months unconsummated: his teenage wife keeps saying soon, his son by his first wife is secretly in love with her, and the actress he left fourteen years ago has decided she wants him back. Everyone in the film is attached to the wrong person and half knows it, and a weekend at a country house forces all the mismatches into the same rooms until the pairs resort themselves.

predicaments.situation: a wife withholds herself from her husband
predicaments.basis: Anne, eighteen and married to Frederich for eleven months, has kept her virginity and keeps telling him she will be ready soon.

predicaments.situation: a former lover returns to claim him
predicaments.basis: Desiree, tired of touring in play after play, meets Frederich again fourteen years after their affair and has her mother invite the whole family to the country estate so she can take him back.

predicaments.situation: a young man wants his father's wife
predicaments.basis: Erich, studying for the church and only a year older than Anne, confesses to Fredericka that he loves his father's wife, runs out to kill himself over it, and is stopped by Anne.

predicaments.situation: a spouse flirts to make the other jealous
predicaments.basis: Charlotte courts Frederich openly across the dinner table to provoke Carl-Magnus, who has been keeping Desiree.

predicaments.situation: two men risk death over the same woman
predicaments.basis: Carl-Magnus challenges Frederich to a game of Russian roulette; Frederich draws the loaded chamber and the bullet only grazes his ear.

relatives.title: The Rules of the Game
relatives.shares: a weekend in the country collects every mismatched couple and rearranges them

relatives.title: Smiles of a Summer Night
relatives.shares: an old lover stages a country weekend to take a man back from his child bride

relatives.title: Ju Dou
relatives.shares: a young man's helpless desire for the young wife of the older man he lives under

relatives.title: Phaedra
relatives.shares: a stepson and his father's wife cannot survive wanting each other

relatives.title: The Awful Truth
relatives.shares: a spouse performs a flirtation in public purely to make the other jealous

films.title: The Cowboys
films.engine: An aging rancher who cannot find grown men to move his herd hires the local schoolboys instead, and across the drive becomes the father the job keeps requiring of him. When rustlers take the herd and one of them shoots him in the back while the boys stand by under his own order not to resist, the boys are left holding what he made of them — and they go and finish it.

predicaments.situation: a man makes children do a man's work
predicaments.basis: Wil Andersen, stripped of ranch hands by the gold rush, hires schoolboys off the local benches and trains them to rope, brand and drive cattle to South Dakota.

predicaments.situation: a child is sworn to silence by threat
predicaments.basis: Asa Watts catches Dan alone, lets him go, and promises to slit his throat if he tells Andersen the gang has been trailing the herd; Dan says nothing until the rustlers are already on the camp.

predicaments.situation: children watch their protector killed
predicaments.basis: Andersen tells the boys to be non-resistant, beats Watts in a fistfight, and is shot in the back as he walks away; the boys stay passive as instructed while the herd is taken.

predicaments.situation: children take up the killing of adults
predicaments.basis: After burying Andersen the boys break out the guns locked in the chuck wagon, and with Nightlinger's plan they knife three rustlers, ambush the rest, and drag Watts to death behind a spooked horse.

predicaments.situation: the living settle a debt to the dead
predicaments.basis: With the money from the sold cattle the boys hire a stonemason to cut Andersen's name and "Beloved Husband and Father" and set the marker near where they buried him.

relatives.title: Red River
relatives.shares: an old cattleman's authority over the young men on his drive becomes the whole subject

relatives.title: True Grit
relatives.shares: a child assembles the means to kill the man who killed the father

relatives.title: Come and See
relatives.shares: a boy is handed adult violence to carry and is remade by it

relatives.title: Lord of the Flies
relatives.shares: boys with no adults left take up adult authority and killing

relatives.title: Sansho the Bailiff
relatives.shares: children must go on alone after the one protecting them is taken

films.title: Ningen
films.engine: Four men on a ship that can no longer steer run out of water and then out of food, and two of them decide the boy among them is the meal. The old man who has kept them alive by prayer and by rationing keeps them alive a second time with a vision he invents — and when a real ship appears exactly as he promised, the two who did the killing cannot go on living inside the rescue.

predicaments.situation: a man rations the little that is left
predicaments.basis: Kamegoro prays to Kompira and doles out the remaining food and water, while Hachizo and Gorosuke rebel and insist on eating their whole share at once.

predicaments.situation: the starving kill the weakest among them
predicaments.basis: After weeks without food Hachizo and Gorosuke lure Sankichi with the promise of something to eat and kill him with an axe.

predicaments.situation: an old man fails to protect a boy
predicaments.basis: Sankichi is the grandson who kept faith with Kamegoro's rationing and prayers; Kamegoro comes looking for him too late, fights the weakened Hachizo, and buries the boy at sea.

predicaments.situation: a lie is told to keep people alive
predicaments.basis: Kamegoro invents a second vision in which Kompira has blown a ship from San Francisco off course toward them, and such a ship then appears.

predicaments.situation: the killers cannot live with what they did
predicaments.basis: Safe on the deck of the rescuing ship, Gorosuke dances himself into a cargo hold and dies and Hachizo kills himself, leaving Kamegoro the only survivor.

relatives.title: Lifeboat
relatives.shares: survivors adrift ration the last of everything and turn on one of their own

relatives.title: Society of the Snow
relatives.shares: starving survivors of a wreck do the thing they swore they would not do to the dead

relatives.title: Fires on the Plain
relatives.shares: hunger brings men to the point of eating each other and unmakes them

relatives.title: In the Heart of the Sea
relatives.shares: a boat's crew adrift decides which of them will be consumed

relatives.title: Life Is Beautiful
relatives.shares: a man invents a story and holds to it so the one in his care will survive

films.title: Exorcist II: The Heretic
films.engine: A priest whose own attempt at an exorcism ended with the woman burning to death is sent to clear the name of the dead colleague the Church wants to condemn — and the only witness is the girl that colleague died freeing. Everyone wants her opened up: her doctor wants the buried memory, the priest wants the death explained, and the thing that had her wants back in and offers him power to help it. Her ability to reach into other people is a symptom to the clinic and the beginning of a new species to the dead man.

predicaments.situation: an institution disowns the man it sent
predicaments.basis: The Cardinal tells Lamont that Merrin faces posthumous heresy charges over his writings, because Church authorities are modernising and would rather not concede that Satan exists.

predicaments.situation: a survivor is pressed to remember what happened
predicaments.basis: Regan says she remembers nothing of Washington; Dr Tuskin believes the memory is repressed and hypnotises her through a brainwave synchroniser, and Lamont couples himself to the same device to reach the night Merrin died.

predicaments.situation: a doubter is offered power for his allegiance
predicaments.basis: Pazuzu appears to the faltering Lamont as a double of Regan and offers him unlimited power; he gives in before the real Regan pulls him back and he tears the double apart.

predicaments.situation: the ones able to heal are hunted
predicaments.basis: Lamont learns that Pazuzu goes after people with psychic healing power — the woman who claimed to heal the sick, the boy Kokumo in Africa, and now Regan.

predicaments.situation: a gift is mistaken for a sickness
predicaments.basis: Regan reaches into an autistic girl's mind and gets her to speak; the clinic staff treat it as a case to be studied while Merrin's circle held such powers to be a spiritual gift coming to everyone.

relatives.title: Spellbound
relatives.shares: a clinician unlocks a patient's buried memory and is pulled inside it

relatives.title: Carrie
relatives.shares: a girl's power is read by everyone around her as an illness

relatives.title: Ordet
relatives.shares: a congregation disowns the man whose faith is taken literally

relatives.title: The Devils
relatives.shares: an institution condemns its own priest rather than admit what he says is happening

relatives.title: Diary of a Country Priest
relatives.shares: a priest's faith fails at exactly the point his work requires it

films.title: Liza
films.engine: A man has walked out on his wife and children to live alone on an empty island with his dog, and a woman who wants to be attended to the way he attends to that animal drowns it and takes its place, on all fours, by mutual agreement. The arrangement survives his family calling him home; what it may not survive is the island itself, once the sea takes their only boat and the fishing will not feed two.

predicaments.situation: a stranger will not leave the solitary alone
predicaments.basis: Liza has herself put ashore on Giorgio's uninhabited island after a row with Ludwig and the friends she is sailing with, and returns to him after he ferries her back to the mainland.

predicaments.situation: a woman kills what her lover loves more
predicaments.basis: Finding that Giorgio wants her as a lover but would rather talk to his dog Melampo, Liza makes the animal swim until it drowns of exhaustion.

predicaments.situation: one lover consents to be owned by another
predicaments.basis: Liza takes the dead dog's place, playing the animal to Giorgio's master, and he accepts the game of dominance and submission.

predicaments.situation: a deserted family calls the man back
predicaments.basis: Giorgio's teenage son comes to tell him his mother has attempted suicide, and he leaves the island for Paris and the bourgeois life he had abandoned, asking Liza to wait.

predicaments.situation: two people cut themselves off from everyone else
predicaments.basis: Liza follows him to the city and talks him back to the island for a life with no one else in it; the sea then carries off their inflatable boat and they face starvation with only a patched-up wartime plane to try.

relatives.title: Swept Away
relatives.shares: two people stranded alone on an island fall into an owner-and-owned arrangement

relatives.title: The Night Porter
relatives.shares: a pair rebuild a private master-and-animal bond and shut out the world until it starves them

relatives.title: Secretary
relatives.shares: submission entered freely becomes the actual terms of a relationship

relatives.title: Woman in the Dunes
relatives.shares: a man and a woman sealed off from everyone else build a life out of the enclosure

relatives.title: Fatal Attraction
relatives.shares: a lover destroys an animal to be felt by the person who will not attend to her

films.title: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold
films.engine: A blind swordsman comes to a village to make peace at the grave of a man he killed, and arrives just as the tax money eighteen drought-starved villages have scraped together is ambushed on the road. The villagers blame him, so he promises to bring it back — and finds that the official the money was owed to arranged the robbery and is now demanding the sum a second time, while the dead man's sister follows him unsure whether she wants him killed or wants his help.

predicaments.situation: the living settle a debt to the dead
predicaments.basis: Ichi travels to Itakura to pay respects at the grave of a man he killed two years earlier, is trailed the whole film by the man's sister Chiyo, and finally hands over his gambling winnings so her brother can have a proper headstone.

predicaments.situation: a helper is blamed for the harm done
predicaments.basis: After Ichi holds off the robbers at the foot of the hill, the village men accost him as the cause of the theft, and he promises to find the gold.

predicaments.situation: the one entrusted with it took it himself
predicaments.basis: Intendant Gundayu, to whom the eighteen villages of Usui county owed 1,000 Ryo, turns out to have arranged the ambush with the whip-wielding Jushiro and taken the gold.

predicaments.situation: the poor are made to pay twice
predicaments.basis: After three years of drought and near famine, Gundayu rejects the headman's plea for leniency, demands the tax again within ten days, and orders four village men executed at dawn.

predicaments.situation: a leader is answerable for his men's crimes
predicaments.basis: Ichi climbs Mt Akagi to ask the outlaw Chuji why he stole the money; two of his troupe confess to having gone rogue and beg to be killed, and Chuji gives up the bandit life.

relatives.title: Yojimbo
relatives.shares: a wandering swordsman finds that the men holding the town are the ones bleeding it

relatives.title: Seven Samurai
relatives.shares: farmers with nothing left are stripped again and an outsider stands between them and it

relatives.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
relatives.shares: the official who collects the tax is the man stealing it

relatives.title: Unforgiven
relatives.shares: a killer comes back to settle what he owes the people he made

films.title: Il gatto
films.engine: A brother and sister who own a decaying building can only sell it if every tenant is gone, so they turn the private life of each person under their roof into a reason to remove them. When their cat dies, the hunt for who killed it becomes the pretext for opening every door in the building, and each secret they uncover — a brothel, a drug stash, a corpse, a hidden past — clears another apartment. They win the building empty and lose the sale to a single woman who walks back in.

predicaments.situation: people are driven from their home for profit
predicaments.basis: Amedeo and Ofelia Pegoraro are offered a billion lira for their apartment building on condition it holds no tenants, so they set about goading and evicting everyone in it.

predicaments.situation: private lives are searched for grounds to expel
predicaments.basis: The siblings spy on and raid apartments, exposing the Princess's brothel, the musicians' cocaine, Don Garofalo's bloodstains and Don Pezzolla's conduct, each discovery emptying another flat.

predicaments.situation: two who cannot part quarrel without end
predicaments.basis: The Pegoraro siblings fight constantly yet run the building, the cat, the spying and the scheme together as one inseparable pair.

predicaments.situation: a dead animal sets neighbors accusing one another
predicaments.basis: The siblings' cat is found dead and the investigation into who killed it becomes the instrument by which every tenant is suspected, denounced and removed.

predicaments.situation: a vague accusation lands on a guilty conscience
predicaments.basis: Ofelia's anonymous letters saying 'we know your secret' are dismissed by most tenants, but the American journalist Paul Herdigher takes his seriously and kills himself.

predicaments.situation: the prize is lost at the final moment
predicaments.basis: With the last tenant gone and the cheques in hand, Wanda moves back into her apartment and the buyer's lawyer tears the cheques up.

relatives.title: Le Corbeau
relatives.shares: anonymous notes promising to expose a secret drive a small community to turn on itself, with one recipient dying of it

relatives.title: The Tenant
relatives.shares: a building's inhabitants police and pry into each other's private conduct until living there becomes untenable

relatives.title: Parasite
relatives.shares: occupancy of a house is itself the prize, and people are worked out of it by manufactured grounds

relatives.title: The Ladykillers
relatives.shares: schemers who out-manoeuvre everyone are finally defeated by the ordinary occupant they never took seriously

relatives.title: Rear Window
relatives.shares: watching neighbours for their secrets is legitimised by a death that must be solved

films.title: Grand Slam
films.engine: A quiet teacher bored by his own life assembles four specialists who have never met to take diamonds during a carnival, each brought in for one skill and told nothing about the whole. The plan works; what destroys them is that each man wants the whole for himself the moment the job is over. The one who arranged everything was never one of them, and even he does not keep it.

predicaments.situation: the mildest person is the one behind everything
predicaments.basis: Professor James Anders, a retiring teacher in Rio, is the one who conceives the diamond robbery and outlives the professional criminals he hired.

predicaments.situation: a woman is seduced for what she guards
predicaments.basis: Jean-Paul Audry is recruited solely to romance Mary Ann, the only person with a key to the building where the diamonds are held, so the key can be borrowed.

predicaments.situation: partners turn on each other after the deed
predicaments.basis: Once clear of the road block, Erich murders Jean-Paul, Milford murders Erich for the case, and Agostino is shot returning to the woman he loves.

predicaments.situation: a secret partner is hidden from the rest
predicaments.basis: Mary Ann, apparently the victim of the seduction, is Anders's undisclosed accomplice and has already swapped the diamonds for an empty case.

predicaments.situation: the prize is lost at the final moment
predicaments.basis: Anders and Mary Ann, holding the diamonds in a Rome cafe with everyone else dead, have them snatched by two thieves on a motorcycle.

relatives.title: Rififi
relatives.shares: a robbery executed perfectly, then dismantled entirely by what the thieves do to each other afterwards

relatives.title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
relatives.shares: the thing everyone killed for is lost by accident in the last moments

relatives.title: The Asphalt Jungle
relatives.shares: a planner assembles specialists who each carry a private motive that unpicks the job

relatives.title: Bob le flambeur
relatives.shares: a meticulous scheme whose outcome is decided by a chance intervention after the work is done

relatives.title: The Killing
relatives.shares: a crew of strangers held together by one man's plan, undone at the handover

films.title: My Dear Killer
films.engine: An old kidnapping in which a rich man and his small daughter were left to die turns out to have been done by someone inside the family, and the investigation of a fresh murder is really the process of that person killing everyone who has come close to the truth. The killer's cover-up is what generates the film's body count. What finally names him is a mark the dying child left behind.

predicaments.situation: a man destroys the kin he envies
predicaments.basis: Oliviero admits he killed his brother-in-law Moroni and the man's daughter Stefania out of jealousy of the family's industrial wealth.

predicaments.situation: whoever learns the secret dies before telling it
predicaments.basis: The insurance investigator Paradisi, the excavator driver, the investigator's wife, the kindergarten teacher and the derelict Mattia are each killed as they approach what happened in the shack.

predicaments.situation: a victim leaves a sign naming the killer
predicaments.basis: Before dying, Stefania drew a human figure missing one hand on the back of a mirror, which identifies her one-handed uncle.

predicaments.situation: a man tries to sell a dangerous secret
predicaments.basis: Paradisi, having found a lead on the cold case, attempts to sell the information to the victims' relatives and is decapitated for it.

predicaments.situation: the guilty is exposed before the assembled household
predicaments.basis: Peretti gathers the whole Moroni family, denounces the murderer's one oversight and produces the mirror, and Oliviero breaks down in the dark.

relatives.title: The Inugami Family
relatives.shares: a wealthy family's fortune motivates a sequence of killings carried out from inside the household

relatives.title: Murder on the Orient Express
relatives.shares: the guilty party is named aloud before every suspect gathered in one room

relatives.title: Chinatown
relatives.shares: an outside investigator uncovers that the crime was committed within the family itself

relatives.title: Les Diaboliques
relatives.shares: a first crime forces further killings to keep those who might know from speaking

relatives.title: The Night of the Hunter
relatives.shares: a child's knowledge of what an adult did is the thing that person must destroy

films.title: Damien: Omen II
films.engine: A boy of twelve, raised by the uncle and aunt who took him in after his parents died, is told what he is and finds it confirmed on his own scalp; from that point every adult who works out the same thing dies, and every adult who already knew was placed near him on purpose. The film is about a household destroying itself from the inside while continuing to set a place at the table for the child doing it. His only real friend is offered a share and refuses.

predicaments.situation: a child discovers what he truly is
predicaments.basis: Sergeant Neff directs Damien to Revelation 13, and Damien finds 666 on his scalp in a mirror, then runs to the lake shouting 'Why me?'

predicaments.situation: a household is destroyed by its own child
predicaments.basis: Richard, Ann, their son Mark and Richard's aunt Marion all die around Damien while he lives with them as family, leaving him the sole heir to the Thorn fortune.

predicaments.situation: whoever learns the secret dies before telling it
predicaments.basis: Bugenhagen and Morgan are buried in the ruins, the photojournalist Joan Hart is run down, the doctor who finds jackal marrow is killed by a cable, and Dr. Warren dies at the rail yard before he can be believed.

roles.silenced: Bugenhagen, Joan Hart, the doctor, Warren

predicaments.situation: a friend is killed for refusing to join
predicaments.basis: Mark, Damien's cousin and closest companion, is told the truth and asked to rise with him, and dies of an induced aneurysm when he will not.

predicaments.situation: a spouse is secretly loyal to another master
predicaments.basis: Ann Thorn, who has raised Damien as her nephew, uses the daggers meant for him to kill her husband Richard, saying she has always belonged to Damien.

relatives.title: We Need to Talk About Kevin
relatives.shares: a family raises the child who dismantles it, and the adults keep behaving like parents while it happens

relatives.title: Rosemary's Baby
relatives.shares: the people closest to the household are secretly devoted to the child and arranged its upbringing

relatives.title: Village of the Damned
relatives.shares: children who are not human are protected by adults until the adults understand what they are

relatives.title: The Bad Seed
relatives.shares: a child kills those who come near the truth and the family conceals what it half-knows

relatives.title: Let the Right One In
relatives.shares: a being that must kill offers a companion a place beside it, and everything depends on the answer

films.title: Flesh for Frankenstein
films.engine: A man who wants a race of people built to obey him works on corpses in a cellar while his wife, whom he has stopped touching, buys the attentions of a farmhand. The bodies he assembles are made from people the household knows, so the farmhand comes to dinner and finds his friend's head on a servant's body. Everything the master does — cutting, coupling, commanding — is copied downward by his assistant and, at the end, by his children.

predicaments.situation: a man makes people meant to obey him
predicaments.basis: Baron von Frankenstein assembles a male and female creature from corpse parts to found a Serbian race that will follow his every command.

predicaments.situation: a neglected wife takes a lover
predicaments.basis: Katrin, the Baron's wife and sister, is ignored while he works in the laboratory and summons the farmhand Nicholas to the castle to satisfy her.

predicaments.situation: a man recognizes his friend in a stranger
predicaments.basis: Nicholas sees the head of his would-be-monk friend on the male creature serving dinner and conceals that he knows it until he can investigate.

predicaments.situation: a servant copies his master's appetites
predicaments.basis: Otto, having watched the Baron use the female creature's surgical wound, repeats the act himself and disembowels her.

predicaments.situation: what was made turns upon its maker
predicaments.basis: Ordered to kill Nicholas, the male creature instead retains enough of his friend's personality to kill the Baron, then opens himself up.

predicaments.situation: children take up the cruelty of their parents
predicaments.basis: Erik and Monica enter the laboratory over their dead father, hoist the trapped Nicholas on the crane and take up the scalpels.

relatives.title: Eyes Without a Face
relatives.shares: a man cuts other people apart to assemble the body he wants, with an assistant who procures the material

relatives.title: Island of Lost Souls
relatives.shares: a maker who demands obedience from the beings he has assembled and is destroyed by them

relatives.title: The Servant
relatives.shares: a household's servant absorbs and then reproduces the master's appetites until the hierarchy inverts

relatives.title: Ex Machina
relatives.shares: a creator builds a being for compliance and sexual use, and the being ends him

relatives.title: Blue Velvet
relatives.shares: a young man drawn in by an unsatisfied woman finds himself inside a household's private cruelty

films.title: Les Créatures
films.engine: A man drives too fast with his pregnant wife telling him to slow down, hits a tree, and she never speaks again; afterwards he settles in a small coastal town and writes a novel. In the novel, nobody in the town is responsible for their own cruelty — a man in a tower controls them all by remote — and the writer's part is a game in which he tries to keep the townspeople's relationships from being pulled apart. The story and his life stop being separable when the man in the tower turns out to have really died the way the writer wrote it.

predicaments.situation: a man's recklessness maims the person beside him
predicaments.basis: Edgar Piccoli refuses to slow down despite Mylène asking three times, crashes into a tree, and she is left mute and pregnant.

predicaments.situation: a newcomer is watched by a closed community
predicaments.basis: On Noirmoutier the shopkeeper's daughter says Edgar frightens her, the linen vendors Max and Pierre single him out at the market, and the hotel accuses him of a killing.

predicaments.situation: a dead animal sets neighbors accusing one another
predicaments.basis: A dead cat left at Edgar's door sends him from shopkeeper to hotel, being accused of killing it and accusing the cook in turn, until he beats his accusers with the corpse.

predicaments.situation: cruelty is blamed on an unseen hand
predicaments.basis: In Edgar's novel, Mr. Ducasse in the tower drives the townspeople to ruin their relationships by remote control, the discs on their bodies accounting for every hostile act.

predicaments.situation: someone struggles to keep others' bonds intact
predicaments.basis: Edgar plays a chess-like game with miniature townspeople in which he must hold the relationships together while Ducasse takes minds for a minute at a time; some couples survive and some break.

predicaments.situation: a man invents a story that comes true
predicaments.basis: Edgar writes Ducasse's death from the tower balcony, and on going to town for a doctor learns the real Ducasse killed himself the same way.

relatives.title: Providence
relatives.shares: a writer populates the novel he is composing with the people around him, and the two layers stop being separable

relatives.title: In the Mouth of Madness
relatives.shares: what an author writes turns out to have happened, collapsing the distance between the page and the town

relatives.title: Dogville
relatives.shares: a small isolated community closes around an outsider and turns its collective suspicion into harassment

relatives.title: Le Corbeau
relatives.shares: a town's residents are turned against one another by something none of them can locate

relatives.title: The Sacrifice
relatives.shares: a man tries to hold the people he loves together by an act performed in a private, half-imagined register

films.title: Machine Gun McCain
films.engine: A mob operations chief wants a share of a casino he has no claim on, and to force the issue he has an old bank robber sprung from prison — using the robber's own son as the messenger, and telling neither of them who is really behind it. The robber goes ahead with the job after it is called off, and discovers that the money he took belonged to the same people he came from, so that everyone who has ever been close to him becomes something to be erased.

predicaments.situation: a person is used without being told why
predicaments.basis: McCain is released from prison and handed a casino robbery by his son Jack, who is fronting for Charlie Adamo's attempt to squeeze a stake out of the Royal, and McCain senses from the start that his son's naivete is covering something.

predicaments.situation: a powerful man demands what is not his
predicaments.basis: Adamo, newly promoted over the West Coast, demands that manager Abe Stilberman sell him twenty percent of the newly built Royal Casino-Hotel, and sets the whole robbery in motion when Stilberman refuses.

predicaments.situation: a trusted person leads another into a trap
predicaments.basis: Jack calls his father to a remote warehouse meeting where the two cohorts he brought along, both on Adamo's payroll, intend to kill them both.

predicaments.situation: a child is turned against a parent
predicaments.basis: Jack is recruited by Adamo to spring and manage his own father, and dies in the crossfire of the ambush he walked his father into.

predicaments.situation: a person is hunted by their own people
predicaments.basis: The casino McCain blows open turns out to be Mafia-owned, so Don Francesco's organisation circulates his photograph through its informant network and runs him down; Adamo, exposed by his own wife's manoeuvring, is tortured and killed by the same organisation.

predicaments.situation: those close to a hunted person are killed
predicaments.basis: Irene, the young woman McCain married while casing the Royal, is spotted by an informant and shot on his waiting boat, and his old partner Rosemary Scott is caught after arranging their passage out.

predicaments.situation: death is the only refusal left
predicaments.basis: Rosemary kills herself when Francesco's men take her, before she can be tortured into giving up McCain's escape route.

relatives.title: Point Blank
relatives.shares: a robber discovers the money he took belongs to the organisation that will now hunt him

relatives.title: Le Samouraï
relatives.shares: a hired man is set up by the people who employed him and spends the film being erased

relatives.title: A Bittersweet Life
relatives.shares: a man is used by his own side and then hunted by it

relatives.title: Rififi
relatives.shares: a robbery that succeeds and then kills everyone standing near the robber

relatives.title: The Killing
relatives.shares: a crew is destroyed by what the man who assembled it did not tell them

films.title: Rocky Road to Dublin
films.engine: A country is asked, person by person, who actually decides how its people live — and the answer keeps turning out to be priests, censors, schoolmasters and an older generation who settled these terms before the young were born. The film goes into confessionals, classrooms, dance halls and newspaper offices to catch the exact moments where that authority touches a private life, and finds the people under thirty no longer agreeing to it.

predicaments.situation: an outsider sets the terms of a marriage
predicaments.basis: A young married woman with three children in three years is told at confession to sleep apart from her husband rather than share in his sin of contraception; the couple stop, she miscarries, and she concludes that priests and doctors alike stand only on the husband's side.

predicaments.situation: the old hold the young to their rules
predicaments.basis: Schoolboys recite the catechism on original sin in a Christian Brothers classroom, censors and clergy police what may be read or discussed, and the newspaper editor observes that his older readers cannot adapt while those under thirty are ready to.

roles.holding: clergy, censors and the revolutionary generation

predicaments.situation: one must leave home in order to speak
predicaments.basis: The emigration of Irish writers is called the country's most notorious export, with a roll call of banned native and international authors read over funeral bells.

predicaments.situation: a group expels members for mixing with outsiders
predicaments.basis: The Gaelic Athletic Association's half-million members faced suspension for so much as watching soccer, cricket, rugby or hockey, and the ban extended to any club whose activities included them.

roles.expelled: members who played or watched English games

predicaments.situation: one side must wait to be chosen
predicaments.basis: With single-sex schooling, middle-class young people meet only at tennis club dances under strict decorum, where the women are shown waiting for men to approach them.

relatives.title: The Sorrow and the Pity
relatives.shares: a nation interviewed one person at a time about the settlement it quietly agreed to

relatives.title: Chronicle of a Summer
relatives.shares: ordinary people asked on camera how they actually live under the arrangements they were handed

relatives.title: The Magdalene Sisters
relatives.shares: clergy holding the terms of women's private lives with the community's consent

relatives.title: 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days
relatives.shares: a rule about contraception and pregnancy whose whole cost falls on the woman

relatives.title: Kes
relatives.shares: a classroom drilling the young into a settlement they had no part in making

films.title: Love under the Crucifix
films.engine: A woman loves a childhood friend who is already married, and takes a husband she does not want because refusing him could bring trouble down on her father. From then on every powerful man who wants something from her family reaches for her, using her father's life as the lever, until the only answer she has left that no one can overrule is her own death.

predicaments.situation: love is surrendered to protect a parent
predicaments.basis: Ogin accepts the merchant Shintaro's proposal after her mother warns that a refusal could have consequences for her father, the tea master Sen no Rikyū, and after Ukon shows no sign of objecting.

predicaments.situation: a powerful man demands what is not his
predicaments.basis: Hideyoshi summons Ogin to his palace to make her his mistress and gives her two days to reconsider her refusal, saying he will otherwise take her father's life; earlier, Ogin watches a young woman led to execution for refusing the same demand from Hidetsugu.

predicaments.situation: a trusted person leads another into a trap
predicaments.basis: The commander Ishida, wanting to block Ukon's rehabilitation, proposes through Ogin's own husband a meeting between her and Ukon that can be used to prosecute them both.

predicaments.situation: a person is punished for refusing to recant
predicaments.basis: Ukon, a Christian daimyō, will not renounce his faith under the government's hardening anti-Christian policy and is sent into exile, later taking refuge in Kaga.

predicaments.situation: a spouse is blamed for loving someone else
predicaments.basis: Two years into the marriage Shintaro accuses Ogin of still loving Ukon while refusing his own advances, and keeps up his dealings with Ukon for business reasons even so.

predicaments.situation: death is the only refusal left
predicaments.basis: With soldiers already surrounding the house and her father preparing to kill himself, Ogin prepares to take her own life and sends her maid to carry a fan bearing her farewell note to Ukon.

relatives.title: Sansho the Bailiff
relatives.shares: a woman whose only remaining refusal of the power over her is her own death

relatives.title: Silence
relatives.shares: holding to a forbidden faith while a state demands renunciation and answers refusal with exile or execution

relatives.title: Raise the Red Lantern
relatives.shares: a woman handed to a man's household because her family's position leaves her no other answer

relatives.title: The Age of Innocence
relatives.shares: a love given up to keep a family's standing intact, with both parties consenting to the loss

relatives.title: The Story of the Last Chrysanthemum
relatives.shares: a private attachment that a family's obligations make unlivable

films.title: The Shining
films.engine: A man who has already hurt his son once takes a job that puts the three of them somewhere no one else can reach, and then spends the winter converting his resentment of his wife and child into permission to kill them. The film is the slow conversion of a household's ordinary fear of its father into an actual hunt through the snow.

predicaments.situation: a father moves to destroy his own child
predicaments.basis: Jack, who once dislocated Danny's shoulder drunk, ends the winter chasing him with an axe through a hedge maze.

predicaments.situation: shut in together with no way out
predicaments.basis: The Overlook is snowed in for the season and Jack has wrecked the radio and the snowcat, so Wendy and Danny cannot leave the man they are afraid of.

predicaments.situation: those closest cannot stop what one becomes
predicaments.basis: Wendy's attempts to raise the bruises, to suggest leaving, and finally to lock him in the pantry only accelerate Jack's turn.

predicaments.situation: pressed by others to turn against his own
predicaments.basis: The ghostly bartender restarts his drinking and the waiter Grady tells him his wife and son need to be "corrected".

predicaments.situation: a child must outthink the adult hunting him
predicaments.basis: Danny walks his own footprints backward in the snow and hides behind a drift while his father runs on into the maze and freezes.

relatives.title: The Night of the Hunter
relatives.shares: children fleeing across a landscape from the man installed as their father

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: a man drawn into a house of the dead while his wife and child are left to survive him

relatives.title: Take Shelter
relatives.shares: a family sealed in with a father whose mind is turning and who insists nothing is wrong

relatives.title: A Woman Under the Influence
relatives.shares: a household that cannot leave the room where one member is coming apart

relatives.title: Yeelen
relatives.shares: a father who resolves that his child must not outlive him

films.title: Blade Runner
films.engine: Four manufactured people with four-year lifespans come back to the man who set that limit to ask him to lift it, and the man paid to shoot them starts sleeping with one instead. Underneath the hunt is a simpler exchange: everyone in the film wants someone else to tell them what they are, and the one who finally gives an honest answer is the thing being hunted.

predicaments.situation: a maker refuses what his creation asks
predicaments.basis: Roy reaches Tyrell's penthouse and demands more life; Tyrell tells him it is impossible and praises his design instead.

predicaments.situation: a creature destroys the one who created it
predicaments.basis: Roy kisses Tyrell and then kills him by crushing his eyes and skull.

predicaments.situation: one sent to kill falls in love instead
predicaments.basis: Deckard is ordered to retire Rachael, and instead promises not to track her down and leaves the city with her.

predicaments.situation: someone discovers their memories are not their own
predicaments.basis: Rachael offers a family photograph as proof of her humanity and Deckard recites the childhood memories that were copied from Tyrell's niece.

predicaments.situation: one is taken for someone he is not
predicaments.basis: Rachael passes as human even to herself, and the origami unicorn Gaff leaves behind puts the same question to Deckard.

predicaments.situation: the wronged one chooses to spare the other
predicaments.basis: With Deckard hanging off the roof edge, the dying Roy — whose companions Deckard has just killed — hauls him up instead of letting go.

relatives.title: Frankenstein (1931)
relatives.shares: the made thing walking back to its maker to demand an account

relatives.title: Ikiru
relatives.shares: a man handed a fixed short span and spending it trying to make it mean something

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man in love with a woman whose remembered self was written for her by someone else

relatives.title: Solaris (1972)
relatives.shares: a being assembled from another person's memories asking whether that makes her real

relatives.title: Unforgiven
relatives.shares: a hunter who can no longer keep the people he is paid to kill in a separate category

films.title: Akira
films.engine: Two boys grew up in the same gang with fixed places — one always the rescuer, one always rescued — and when the rescued one is given a power greater than the city's army, the first thing he does with it is settle accounts with everyone who ever had to pick him up. The film is that friendship enlarging until it takes the city with it.

predicaments.situation: the protected one becomes the danger
predicaments.basis: Tetsuo, whom Kaneda's gang has always had to pull out of trouble, gains psychic power and kills Yamagata over Kaneda's bike before turning on everyone else.

predicaments.situation: those closest cannot stop what one becomes
predicaments.basis: Kaneda's laser rifle, Kaori's arms around him and Shikishima's offer to heal his injuries all fail as Tetsuo swells into a mass of flesh that consumes the stadium.

predicaments.situation: a creature destroys the one who created it
predicaments.basis: The espers made by the government's psychic program are what levelled Tokyo in 1988, and the program's newest subject levels Neo-Tokyo the same way.

predicaments.situation: one hoards what another would give to all
predicaments.basis: Akira's remains are kept sealed in jars in cryonic storage under the stadium for research while parliament dismisses the warning that this will happen again.

predicaments.situation: one is taken for someone he is not
predicaments.basis: Cultists in the ruined streets mistake the rampaging Tetsuo for Akira himself and follow him toward the stadium.

relatives.title: Carrie
relatives.shares: the one everybody knew as weak receiving power and spending it on the people who knew that

relatives.title: Mean Streets
relatives.shares: a friendship where the rescuer cannot stop rescuing and the rescued destroys them both

relatives.title: Der Golem
relatives.shares: a made power that a city builds for its own safety and then cannot put down

relatives.title: Ran
relatives.shares: a settled order tearing itself apart the moment power passes to someone who cannot hold it

relatives.title: Stalker
relatives.shares: a sealed zone of a prior catastrophe that the state guards rather than understands

films.title: Farewell My Concubine
films.engine: A boy handed over to an opera troupe is beaten until he can say he is a girl by nature, and he spends the next fifty years in love with the boy who was beaten beside him — a love that only exists inside the play they perform together. Every regime that arrives, occupier, nationalist, communist, makes the two of them prove their loyalty by damaging each other, until the only line left is the one from the play.

predicaments.situation: one loves a friend unable to return it
predicaments.basis: Cheng Dieyi, who finishes Duan Xiaolou's stage makeup before every performance, loves him for a lifetime while Xiaolou wants an ordinary marriage.

predicaments.situation: another takes the place beside the beloved
predicaments.basis: Xiaolou marries Juxian, and the three-way jealousy between her, Dieyi and Xiaolou becomes the wound that runs through every later crisis.

predicaments.situation: pressed by others to turn against his own
predicaments.basis: Paraded before Red Guards, Xiaolou accuses Dieyi of counterrevolution and implies he is homosexual; Dieyi answers by telling the guards Juxian was a prostitute, and Xiaolou swears he never loved her.

predicaments.situation: a mother leaves her child with strangers
predicaments.basis: Douzi is abandoned by his prostitute mother to Master Guan's troupe in 1924 and mocked by the other boys for where he came from.

predicaments.situation: punished for the thing done to save another
predicaments.basis: Dieyi performs for the Japanese to get Xiaolou released from arrest, and is charged with treason for it once Japan surrenders.

predicaments.situation: the one he trained takes his place
predicaments.basis: Xiao Si, the foundling Dieyi raised and taught the dan roles, denounces him as a capitalist and seizes the role of Consort Yu mid-performance.

relatives.title: Brokeback Mountain
relatives.shares: one man's lifelong love for a friend who marries and keeps the thing between them off the record

relatives.title: The Conformist
relatives.shares: a regime that demands you prove loyalty by handing over the person you loved

relatives.title: All About Eve
relatives.shares: the protégé you trained stepping into your role while you watch

relatives.title: The Blue Kite
relatives.shares: successive political turns forcing a household to injure its own members to survive

relatives.title: Sunset Boulevard
relatives.shares: a performer who can no longer separate the part from the person playing it

films.title: Close-Up
films.engine: A poor cinephile tells a well-off family on a bus that he is a famous director, is welcomed into their house for two weeks on that basis, and is arrested when they check. The film is the argument he makes afterward in front of the people he lied to: that pretending to be the man who made those films was the only time anyone had looked at him.

predicaments.situation: one is taken for someone he is not
predicaments.basis: Hossain Sabzian claims to be Mohsen Makhmalbaf, is believed by the Ahankhahs for weeks, and is exposed when Mr. Ahankhah compares him to a magazine photograph.

predicaments.situation: a welcomed stranger betrays the trust given
predicaments.basis: Taken into the family home as an honoured guest, Sabzian promises to shoot his next film there, cast the sons, and borrows 1,900 tomans for cab fare.

predicaments.situation: the wronged one chooses to spare the other
predicaments.basis: Asked by the judge, the family agrees to pardon Sabzian in exchange for his promise to become a productive member of society.

predicaments.situation: the admired one meets the one imitating him
predicaments.basis: After the trial the real Makhmalbaf collects Sabzian and drives him to the Ahankhahs' house, where the father says he hopes he will be good now.

relatives.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
relatives.shares: a man without means living inside a borrowed name because it is the only life that gets him treated well

relatives.title: Mr. Klein
relatives.shares: a man's identity taken for another's and his life reorganised around the mistake

relatives.title: The Purple Rose of Cairo
relatives.shares: a poor person for whom the films are more habitable than the life

relatives.title: Catch Me If You Can
relatives.shares: a fraud sustained entirely by other people's willingness to believe the claimed name

relatives.title: Shoplifters
relatives.shares: a court asked what to do with a deception that gave everyone involved something real

films.title: Yeelen
films.engine: A father who sees that his son will be the cause of his death sets out across the country to kill him first, rather than share any part of the knowledge he holds. The son, armed by an uncle who was blinded for having used that knowledge on other people's behalf, walks back toward him — and the meeting destroys them both and leaves the power with a child.

predicaments.situation: a father moves to destroy his own child
predicaments.basis: Soma receives a vision that his son will cause his death and pursues Nianankoro across the land with a tracking pylon that breaks every barrier put in its way.

predicaments.situation: a maker refuses what his creation asks
predicaments.basis: Nianankoro reaches his father and tries to reason with him, and finds Soma cannot bear to share his power and wants only his death.

predicaments.situation: a creature destroys the one who created it
predicaments.basis: Father and son turn into an elephant and a lion and the light of Kore's Wing kills them both, fulfilling the vision Soma tried to outrun.

predicaments.situation: one hoards what another would give to all
predicaments.basis: Soma warns the Komo that his son means to disperse their magic for everyone's use, while blind Djigui, who lost his sight using Kore's Wing for his people, hands the relic on.

predicaments.situation: a welcomed stranger takes advantage of trust
predicaments.basis: Spared and employed by King Rouma Boli after driving off a rival tribe, Nianankoro is asked to cure the queen's infertility and sleeps with her instead.

predicaments.situation: the wronged one chooses to spare the other
predicaments.basis: Nianankoro and Attou return that night to confess, and the king, instead of killing them, reluctantly orders them married and sends them away.

relatives.title: Edipo Re
relatives.shares: a father acting on a prophecy that his son will kill him and bringing it about by acting

relatives.title: Ran
relatives.shares: an old man who will not let his power pass and destroys his line rather than divide it

relatives.title: The Return
relatives.shares: a father whose authority over his son turns into something the son must survive

relatives.title: There Will Be Blood
relatives.shares: a man who would rather lose the son than share what he has built

relatives.title: Blade Runner
relatives.shares: the made walking back to the maker to ask for something the maker will not give

films.title: Shoah
films.engine: A man goes to the people who were physically present at the killing — the ones who cut hair at the chamber door, the ones who drove the trains, the ones who lived up the road, the ones who ran the timetables — and keeps asking until each says out loud what they did and what they knew. The film is the pressure of that asking: some break down mid-sentence, some explain that fear excused them, some insist they only handled paperwork. What it turns on is not what happened but what it costs a person to say it in front of another person, decades later.

predicaments.situation: a witness is pressed to relive what happened
predicaments.basis: Abraham Bomba is kept talking until he breaks down describing cutting the hair of a friend's wife and sister inside the gas chamber, and Filip Müller breaks down recalling the prisoners singing as they were forced in.

predicaments.situation: someone is made to help do harm
predicaments.basis: Bomba survived by barbering at the chamber, Müller by burning the bodies, and Henryk Gawkowski drove the transports and drank the vodka the Germans gave him as a bonus, saying refusal would have sent him to a work camp.

roles.compelling: the SS and the camp system

predicaments.situation: someone insists they only did their part
predicaments.basis: Walter Stier says he was managing railroad traffic and did not know he was moving people to their deaths, admitting only that he knew the destinations were camps; Franz Suchomel describes the assembly line in detail and claims he asked the barbers to slow down so the women waited less time naked in the cold.

predicaments.situation: onlookers plead fear to excuse doing nothing
predicaments.basis: Villagers near the camps saw the trains go in full and come back empty and guessed what that meant, and when asked why they did nothing they answer that they were afraid of being killed or sent to Treblinka I themselves.

predicaments.situation: a warning reaches people unwilling to act
predicaments.basis: Jan Karski was smuggled into the Warsaw ghetto and travelled on false papers to England to press the Allied governments to intervene for the Jews.

relatives.title: The Act of Killing
relatives.shares: perpetrators talked into performing, out loud and at length, exactly what they did

relatives.title: S21: The Khmer Rouge Killing Machine
relatives.shares: survivors and guards returned to the site and made to speak in each other's presence

relatives.title: The Look of Silence
relatives.shares: neighbours who watched and excused themselves by fear, questioned face to face

relatives.title: Night and Fog
relatives.shares: an atrocity approached through the empty ground where it happened rather than through its images

relatives.title: Hôtel Terminus
relatives.shares: an interviewer refusing to release a functionary from his own account of himself

films.title: Hoop Dreams
films.engine: Two fourteen-year-olds from poor Chicago neighbourhoods are recruited by a suburban school that wants what their bodies can do on a court, and one keeps a rich sponsor while the other is sent home the year his family cannot pay tuition — after which the same talent buys two completely different lives. Around them, adults who did not make it themselves lean their unfinished hopes on the boys, and the film watches four years of what that weight does to a household.

predicaments.situation: someone is wanted only for being useful
predicaments.basis: A scout recruits Gates and Agee for St. Joseph's basketball program, and their place there lasts exactly as long as their value on the court and someone else's willingness to pay for it.

predicaments.situation: an opportunity is withdrawn for lack of money
predicaments.basis: Agee is thrown out of St. Joseph after freshman year when his family cannot cover tuition, while Gates stays on because the president of Encyclopedia Britannica pays his fees and finds him a summer job.

predicaments.situation: a child carries an adult's unfinished ambition
predicaments.basis: Gates's older brother Curtis was a talented player who never turned professional and transfers all of it onto William, whose every season is measured against being "the next Isiah Thomas".

predicaments.situation: a body fails at the decisive moment
predicaments.basis: Gates's knee injury and surgery leave him playing timidly, and in the sectional final he takes two free throws to win it — normally his strength — and misses both.

predicaments.situation: a parent walks out then comes back
predicaments.basis: Bo Agee leaves the family and becomes addicted to drugs while Sheila loses her job and goes on welfare, and he later gets clean and returns as she qualifies as a nurse.

relatives.title: Sugar
relatives.shares: a young player recruited far from home and kept only as long as his arm is worth something

relatives.title: Billy Elliot
relatives.shares: a poor family's whole future routed through what one child's body can do

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a chance at a livelihood that collapses the moment the money underneath it fails

relatives.title: Whiplash
relatives.shares: an older man feeding his own unfinished career into a young performer

relatives.title: The Up Series
relatives.shares: the same children returned to across years while class quietly decides the outcome

films.title: Lessons of Darkness
films.engine: A wrecked landscape of burning oil is filmed as if by a visitor to another planet, with the war that caused it never named, so that the people in it appear only as unexplained creatures moving through fire. The one human act the film insists on is this: after the crews finally kill a well, they go back and set the oil alight again.

predicaments.situation: people rekindle the ruin they just put out
predicaments.basis: The climactic scene shows the firefighting crews re-igniting the flow of oil shortly after they succeed in stopping the fires, with the narration asking whether life without fire has become unbearable for them.

predicaments.situation: those suffering are watched as if inhuman
predicaments.basis: Herzog withholds all political and geographical context and narrates over the Kuwaiti oil-field workers as "creatures" driven by madness, filming a real aftermath so that no frame is recognisable as Earth.

roles.watched: the workers and the people of the burnt country

relatives.title: Night and Fog
relatives.shares: a catastrophe approached only through its aftermath, with a narrator standing deliberately outside it

relatives.title: Nostalgia for the Light
relatives.shares: a desert filmed as a cosmic object while what people did there goes unspoken

relatives.title: Sans Soleil
relatives.shares: commentary that lifts documentary footage out of its context and into invented fiction

relatives.title: Fata Morgana
relatives.shares: a real landscape narrated as another planet's creation myth

films.title: The Sacrifice
films.engine: A man who has stopped believing in God and grown to hate the emptiness of speech is told, in the middle of his birthday dinner, that a nuclear war has begun — and he promises God he will give up everything he loves, including his small son, if the night can be taken back. He wakes to an ordinary morning and pays anyway: he burns the house down with his family watching, and is driven off by men who take him for mad, leaving the boy alone under the tree they planted together.

predicaments.situation: someone bargains away all they love
predicaments.basis: Hearing the broadcast about the beginning of what looks like world war, Alexander vows to God to renounce his house, his family and even Little Man if it can all be undone.

roles.offered: Adelaide, Marta, Little Man, the house

predicaments.situation: a promise made in terror is kept afterwards
predicaments.basis: He wakes the next morning to everything apparently normal and still tricks the household into going for a walk so he can set the house on fire, then confesses to them as they run back.

predicaments.situation: a family has one of its own removed
predicaments.basis: An ambulance arrives with no explanation and two paramedics chase down Alexander, who is restrained by the others and driven away as he tries to reach Maria.

predicaments.situation: a child listens without being able to answer
predicaments.basis: Little Man, temporarily mute after a throat operation, absorbs his father's long bitter monologue by the sea, is knocked down and bloodied by accident, and speaks his single line only at the very end, watering the tree.

predicaments.situation: deliverance is sought from a near stranger
predicaments.basis: On Otto's instruction that the maid Maria is a witch "in the best possible sense", Alexander bicycles to her house, holds a pistol to his own temple until she yields, and they lie together as the jets pass overhead.

relatives.title: Take Shelter
relatives.shares: a man acting on a private certainty of coming catastrophe until his household treats him as ill

relatives.title: Breaking the Waves
relatives.shares: a private bargain with God paid off through the body and read by everyone else as madness

relatives.title: Ordet
relatives.shares: a house waiting on a miracle while the one who believes in it is taken for mad

relatives.title: Melancholia
relatives.shares: the end of the world arriving inside one family's celebration at a beautiful house

relatives.title: Winter Light
relatives.shares: a man whose relationship with God is stated as nonexistent forced to act as though it were not

films.title: Schindler's List
films.engine: A party member arrives in occupied Kraków to get rich on labour he does not have to pay for, and discovers that the paperwork calling his workers essential is the only thing keeping them out of the camps. From there he spends the entire fortune he made off them buying names back, one bribe at a time, from the officer he has to keep flattering as a friend — and ends with nothing, convinced he could have bought more.

predicaments.situation: someone profits from people they later protect
predicaments.basis: Schindler bribes his way into an enamelware factory staffed by ghetto Jews for the money, and by the end has spent everything he earned bribing officials, buying shell casings from other firms and making sure his own factory produces no usable armaments.

predicaments.situation: a rescuer must flatter the one they fear
predicaments.basis: Every extension — the sub-camp at the factory, the transfer to Brünnlitz, the women redirected to Auschwitz-Birkenau — is bought by keeping up a friendship with Amon Göth, who shoots prisoners from his balcony, and by paying Höss.

predicaments.situation: someone is wanted only for being useful
predicaments.basis: Itzhak Stern keeps Jews alive by classifying as many as possible as essential to the German war effort, which is what stands between them and the transports.

predicaments.situation: someone decides the few to be spared
predicaments.basis: Schindler and Stern sit down and write out the names of those to be moved to Brünnlitz rather than Auschwitz, and the list closes at 1,100.

predicaments.situation: a rescuer feels they should have done more
predicaments.basis: Given a ring engraved "Whoever saves one life saves the world entire", Schindler breaks down over the car and the possessions he could have traded for more names, and has to be comforted by the people he saved.

relatives.title: In Darkness
relatives.shares: a man who begins by charging Jews for shelter and ends up protecting them at his own cost

relatives.title: Hotel Rwanda
relatives.shares: survival bought by keeping up a friendship with the men running the killing

relatives.title: Sophie's Choice
relatives.shares: the weight of having been the one who decided which lives were spared

relatives.title: The Battle of Algiers
relatives.shares: an occupier's clerical machinery of lists deciding who is taken and who is left

relatives.title: Ida
relatives.shares: the arithmetic afterwards of who was hidden, who was handed over, and what it cost the one who chose

films.title: Total Recall
films.engine: A construction worker keeps dreaming of a planet he has never visited, and when he buys a fake memory of being a spy there, the fake turns out to be a lid over a real one: his job, his apartment and his wife were all built around him by the people he used to work for. Everyone who has ever been close to him was assigned to him, and the man he used to be arranged all of it himself, so his real problem is deciding which of the two men gets to keep the body.

predicaments.situation: someone learns their life was arranged without them
predicaments.basis: Quaid's job, marriage and memories were installed by Cohaagen after his earlier self volunteered to be wiped and planted as bait for the Martian rebels.

predicaments.situation: a marriage is arranged between strangers
predicaments.basis: Lori was assigned by the Agency to live eight years as Quaid's wife and is in fact married to Richter, the man sent to kill him.

predicaments.situation: a friend denounces a friend to the authorities
predicaments.basis: His workmate Harry reports the slip he made at Rekall, and Benny, the driver who has carried him everywhere on Mars, leads Cohaagen's troops into the rebel base.

predicaments.situation: many are killed to keep power in place
predicaments.basis: Cohaagen wipes out the mutant rebellion and shuts off Venusville's air rather than let the alien reactor end his monopoly on turbinium.

predicaments.situation: someone falls for a stranger never actually met
predicaments.basis: Quaid dreams nightly of a dark-haired woman on Mars, then finds Melina in Venusville, where she knows a version of him he cannot remember.

predicaments.situation: one person tells another their life is imagined
predicaments.basis: Lori and Dr Edgemar come to his hotel room to tell him he is still strapped in the implant chair on Earth and must swallow a pill to wake up.

relatives.title: Blade Runner
relatives.shares: a life furnished with memories someone else wrote to make its owner useful

relatives.title: The Truman Show
relatives.shares: every intimate in a man's life turns out to have been assigned to him

relatives.title: Angel Heart
relatives.shares: a man carries out an errand set by his former self and is the thing he is hunting

relatives.title: The Manchurian Candidate
relatives.shares: a man conditioned by his own side to act against the people closest to him

relatives.title: Solaris
relatives.shares: a woman appears in the flesh who first existed only inside the man's head

films.title: The Elephant Man
films.engine: A surgeon pays a fairground showman for a look at the deformed man he keeps hooded in a booth, finds that the man can read and speak, and moves him into a hospital — where titled visitors begin queueing at his door and a night porter quietly resumes selling tickets. The film turns on how little separates rescuing a man from acquiring him, and on the fact that the man himself, who has never had company of any kind, is grateful for both.

predicaments.situation: a person is shown to strangers for profit
predicaments.basis: Bytes charges the East End to see Merrick unhooded, and once he is housed at the London Hospital a night porter runs paying crowds through his room after dark.

predicaments.situation: a person is handed between keepers
predicaments.basis: Merrick passes from the showman to Treves, is debated and finally kept by the hospital governors, then is stolen back for a continental tour.

predicaments.situation: a voiceless person depends on another's voice
predicaments.basis: Assumed an idiot because he is silent under the hood, Merrick is coached sentence by sentence by Treves until he recites the whole psalm unprompted and begins speaking for himself.

predicaments.situation: a helper cannot tell help from possession
predicaments.basis: Mothershead says plainly that Merrick is still being displayed, only to a better class of audience, and Treves starts questioning the morality of what he has done.

predicaments.situation: a crowd turns on someone for being different
predicaments.basis: Chased through Liverpool Street station, unmasked and cornered, Merrick cries that he is not an animal but a man.

predicaments.situation: someone wants a dead parent to be proud
predicaments.basis: Merrick keeps his mother's photograph, believes he must have been a disappointment to her, and hopes she would be proud to see him among friends.

relatives.title: The Wild Child
relatives.shares: a doctor rescues a person and turns the rescue into a demonstration before colleagues

relatives.title: The Miracle Worker
relatives.shares: speech is drawn out of someone everyone had written off as unreachable

relatives.title: Freaks
relatives.shares: people kept as an exhibit for paying strangers, and the crowd outside the tent

relatives.title: Nightmare Alley
relatives.shares: a human being sold as a spectacle by the man who feeds him

relatives.title: Frankenstein
relatives.shares: a body outside the ordinary run is chased and cornered by a mob

films.title: A City of Sadness
films.engine: A Taiwanese family opens a nightclub the week Japan surrenders, and over the next three years the order that replaces the occupation takes the brothers apart one at a time: gangsters with mainland connections get one denounced as a collaborator, a prison sends another back brain-damaged, a gambling-house brawl kills a third, and the deaf youngest — who has no politics, only friends — is arrested and never heard of again. The film is about a household learning that knowing someone has become evidence against you.

predicaments.situation: a friend denounces a friend to the authorities
predicaments.basis: Cut out of the counterfeit money, the Shanghai gang use their mainland contacts to name the Lin brothers as Japanese collaborators; Wen-liang is arrested and returns brain-damaged from torture.

predicaments.situation: many are killed to keep power in place
predicaments.basis: After the February 28 protests thousands are massacred, martial law is declared, and the Kuomintang run summary trials and executions until Hinoe's mountain guerrillas are wiped out.

predicaments.situation: someone is taken away leaving no trace
predicaments.basis: Wen-ching is arrested for funding the resistance and disappears; Hinomi writes to Ah-shue that she has searched Taipei and can find no word of him.

predicaments.situation: a voiceless person depends on another's voice
predicaments.basis: Wen-ching is deaf and conducts his friendships, his courtship of Hinomi and his marriage through notes passed back and forth on paper.

predicaments.situation: a household loses its sons one by one
predicaments.basis: The eldest is killed in a gambling-house fight, the third ruined in jail, the fourth disappeared, leaving the old father, a widow and an infant in the house.

relatives.title: Missing
relatives.shares: a family searching a capital city for a person the state has taken and will not account for

relatives.title: The Official Story
relatives.shares: living beside a machinery of disappearance while trying to keep an ordinary household running

relatives.title: Farewell My Concubine
relatives.shares: private lives dismantled by each successive regime, with old friends supplying the accusations

relatives.title: The Conformist
relatives.shares: a denunciation delivered by someone close enough to know exactly where to point

relatives.title: Ashes and Diamonds
relatives.shares: a new order consolidating power over the bodies of the people who fought the last one

films.title: The Terrorizers
films.engine: A girl stuck in her mother's flat with a bad leg dials numbers at random and tells a woman she has never met to come and settle something with her husband; the marriage was already ending, and the call is enough to finish it. Around that, a doctor who framed his oldest colleague to clear his own path loses his wife, the post he schemed for and his footing, and comes back with a stolen gun. The film is about how little contact strangers need to destroy one another.

predicaments.situation: a lie to a stranger ruins a marriage
predicaments.basis: Bored and immobilised, Shu An prank-calls the flats in her building and tells Zhou Yufen to come to an apartment where something will be settled with her husband.

predicaments.situation: a crime is pinned on an innocent person
predicaments.basis: Angling for the dead section chief's post, Li falsely implicates Jing, his friend and colleague of years, for something the chief himself did; Jing quits blaming a third man.

predicaments.situation: a partner is left for someone more attentive
predicaments.basis: Zhou leaves Li over his blankness about her miscarriage and her writing, and takes up with Shen, the editor who rehires her and takes a genuine interest in her work.

predicaments.situation: someone falls for a stranger never actually met
predicaments.basis: Qiang photographs Shu by chance as her boyfriend is arrested, enlarges her into a collage across his wall, and only long afterwards meets the girl in the picture.

predicaments.situation: a man denied his advancement turns to violence
predicaments.basis: Passed over for section chief because the separation has wrecked his work, Li gets his police friend drunk, steals his gun, kills the hospital director and shoots his wife's lover.

relatives.title: Blow-Up
relatives.shares: a photographer enlarges a stranger caught by accident until the image runs his life

relatives.title: Caché
relatives.shares: an anonymous intrusion from outside detonates a marriage that was already hollow

relatives.title: Amores Perros
relatives.shares: strangers whose lives touch once, briefly, and wreck each other

relatives.title: Falling Down
relatives.shares: a man passed over and left by his wife walks out with a gun

relatives.title: Short Cuts
relatives.shares: an idle prank call travels into households that have nothing to do with the caller

films.title: Pixote
films.engine: A ten-year-old is swept up in a street round-up and put in a reformatory where the guards run the rackets and the children absorb the punishment; when he escapes, the handful of boys he escapes with are the only family on offer, and through accident and appetite he takes that apart too. What he wants the whole way through is a mother, and the one woman who might have stood in for one pushes him off in disgust.

predicaments.situation: the protectors are the ones doing the harm
predicaments.basis: In the FEBEM reformatory the commander and guards use the boys as pawns in their own criminal games, and one boy dies of a police beating.

predicaments.situation: a crime is pinned on an innocent person
predicaments.basis: To cover the beating death, the officials frame Lilica's unnamed young lover for the murder and then kill him.

predicaments.situation: a person is handed between keepers
predicaments.basis: Pixote passes from the street round-up to the reformatory, then to Cristal's apartment, then to whoever will house and feed the group next.

predicaments.situation: a partner is left for someone more attentive
predicaments.basis: Dito falls for Sueli, the ageing prostitute the boys are pimping, and Lilica walks out on the group.

predicaments.situation: someone looks for a mother in a stranger
predicaments.basis: Having shot Dito by accident, Pixote climbs onto Sueli and sucks at her breast until she recoils in disgust and sends him out.

predicaments.situation: the only family available is a criminal one
predicaments.basis: Outside the walls the escapees hold together by dealing cocaine, robbing a prostitute's clients and pimping, and each botched job kills one of them.

relatives.title: Los Olvidados
relatives.shares: children on the street with no adult who is not using them, and an ending that offers no way out

relatives.title: City of God
relatives.shares: a child's only available family is the one that robs and shoots

relatives.title: Salaam Bombay!
relatives.shares: a boy adrift among prostitutes and addicts, looking for someone to belong to

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: children left to run a household with no adult who will claim them

relatives.title: The 400 Blows
relatives.shares: an institution for boys that punishes what the adults around them caused

films.title: The Piano
films.engine: A woman who has not spoken since the age of six is shipped to colonial New Zealand with her daughter and her piano to marry a settler she has never met; he leaves the piano on the beach, and the neighbour who fetches it sells it back to her one key at a time in exchange for what he can touch while she plays. Everything that is hers — the instrument, her daughter's loyalty, her own hands — has to be bargained for with men who hold it, in a currency she did not choose.

predicaments.situation: a marriage is arranged between strangers
