predicaments.basis: Ada is sent from Scotland to marry Alisdair Stewart, who first meets her stranded on a beach and refuses to bring her piano up to the farm.

predicaments.situation: intimacy is bought back piece by piece
predicaments.basis: Baines trades Stewart land for the piano, then returns it to Ada one key per lesson in exchange for what he is allowed to do while she plays.

predicaments.situation: a voiceless person depends on another's voice
predicaments.basis: Ada signs and her daughter Flora speaks for her to everyone, including at moments when Ada would rather not be reported at all.

predicaments.situation: a partner is left for someone more attentive
predicaments.basis: Ada turns from the husband who confiscated her piano and forced himself on her to the neighbour who listens to her play and asks to be genuinely wanted.

predicaments.situation: a message is delivered to the wrong person
predicaments.basis: Flora, who has taken Stewart as a father, carries the piano key engraved with Ada's love declaration to him instead of to Baines.

predicaments.situation: one person maims another to keep them
predicaments.basis: Stewart takes an axe to Ada's index finger so she cannot play, and sends the finger to Baines as a warning.

relatives.title: Raise the Red Lantern
relatives.shares: a woman delivered into a household as property and rationed her small privileges by the man who owns it

relatives.title: Johnny Belinda
relatives.shares: a mute woman whose meaning reaches everyone else only through an interpreter

relatives.title: Children of a Lesser God
relatives.shares: silence used as the last thing a woman owns, against a man who wants her voice

relatives.title: Breaking the Waves
relatives.shares: a woman's body becomes the currency in which everything else is negotiated

relatives.title: Wuthering Heights
relatives.shares: a wife leaves the husband arranged for her for the rough neighbour who wants her outright

films.title: Sweetie
films.engine: A family has spent years treating its unstable adult daughter as an adorable little girl, applauding her performances and forgiving each rampage, and she has never been asked to be anything else. When she comes home again the household reorganises itself around placating her, her sister's already brittle life collapses, and only her death lets the others stop bracing — after which they go back to picturing her as the child they preferred.

predicaments.situation: a grown child is kept a child
predicaments.basis: Gordon indulges Sweetie's delusions of being an actor and treats her mental illness as childishness, Flo admits he encourages her, and after her death the family keeps an image of her as a little girl.

predicaments.situation: a returning family member wrecks the household
predicaments.basis: Sweetie arrives back with her boyfriend Bob and proceeds to intimidate and control everyone, ruining Kay's clothes and breaking furniture in cycles of rage and forgiveness.

predicaments.situation: a life is arranged around a prophecy
predicaments.basis: Kay is with Louis because a fortune teller told her he was the one, and she digs up and hides the tree he plants out of a superstitious dread.

predicaments.situation: a third person comes between two lovers
predicaments.basis: Kay and Louis's strain turns into a breakup as Sweetie's presence takes over the house, and they only reunite once she is gone.

predicaments.situation: a household is relieved by a death
predicaments.basis: Sweetie shakes the childhood tree house until it falls and kills her, injuring Flo, and afterwards the family no longer feels manipulated or agitated.

relatives.title: A Woman Under the Influence
relatives.shares: a family organises itself around one member's unmanageable behaviour and cannot decide whether to treat her as ill or as herself

relatives.title: Rachel Getting Married
relatives.shares: a volatile sister comes home and the household bends around her until it breaks

relatives.title: Grey Gardens
relatives.shares: a mother and daughter hold each other permanently in a childhood role neither will leave

relatives.title: Ordinary People
relatives.shares: a parent's love falls plainly on one child and the other lives beside the fact

relatives.title: The Idiots
relatives.shares: performed childishness becomes a licence for damage that the group keeps forgiving

films.title: Germany in Autumn
films.engine: In the weeks after a kidnapped industrialist and the imprisoned members of the group that took him all end up dead, the country works out in private what it is now allowed to say, screen, shelter and mourn. Friends argue in kitchens over whether the prison deaths were suicides, a woman lets a wanted man into her flat and decides not to report him, a committee quietly shelves a play about burying an enemy of the state, and two funerals are held under very different rules.

predicaments.situation: a killing is answered with a killing
predicaments.basis: Schleyer is kidnapped and killed by the RAF and Baader, Ensslin and Raspe are found dead in Stammheim under an official account nobody in the film trusts.

predicaments.situation: a stranger in need is taken in
predicaments.basis: A woman in Munich welcomes an injured bleeding man into her apartment, recognises him among the wanted terrorists in the newspaper and chooses not to inform; Franziska Busch stops a beating in a car park and takes the victim home.

roles.sheltering: the woman in Munich, Franziska Busch
roles.sheltered: the wanted man, the beaten woman

predicaments.situation: a story is withheld for fear of consequence
predicaments.basis: A board of television producers debates prefacing a broadcast of Antigone with a disclaimer and finally agrees not to transmit the play at all.

predicaments.situation: the dead of two sides are mourned unequally
predicaments.basis: Schleyer gets a state memorial with factory workers standing in silence, while at the funeral of Baader, Ensslin and Raspe hundreds of mourners gather and some are arrested.

predicaments.situation: someone doubts the account they must pass on
predicaments.basis: Gabi Teichert questions the history curriculum she teaches, alarming her superiors, and digs through the Spartacist uprising and Rommel's poisoning for a version she can stand behind.

predicaments.situation: the unknown are treated as suspect
predicaments.basis: An unmarried couple are stopped at the French border and their papers checked because a guard thinks the woman resembles a wanted face, and a Turkish man is arrested outside the memorial service.

relatives.title: Rome, Open City
relatives.shares: ordinary people decide one at a time whether to hide someone the authorities are hunting

relatives.title: The Official Story
relatives.shares: someone begins to doubt the account of recent events they have been repeating

relatives.title: Hunger
relatives.shares: a state and its imprisoned enemies each answer the other's deaths with more deaths

relatives.title: Antigone (1961)
relatives.shares: the burial of the state's enemy becomes the thing authority cannot allow

relatives.title: The Nasty Girl
relatives.shares: a private inquiry into what the official history leaves out makes the inquirer an enemy

films.title: Aria
films.engine: Ten short films, each set to an opera recording, mostly about people whose wanting is larger than what their lives will hold: two teenagers make love in a cheap hotel and open their wrists, a husband and wife cheat on each other in the same building without knowing it, women strip in front of men too absorbed to look, and aging figures give a last performance to an audience that is barely there.

predicaments.situation: two lovers choose to die together
predicaments.basis: In the Liebestod segment, a young couple drive through Las Vegas at night, make love in a cheap hotel and slash their wrists in the bath.

predicaments.situation: a third person comes between two lovers
predicaments.basis: In the Rigoletto segment a film producer cheats on his wife with a starlet at the Madonna Inn, unaware that his wife is in the same inn with a lover of her own.

roles.intruding: the starlet and the wife's hunk

predicaments.situation: the desired one refuses to look
predicaments.basis: In the Armide segment two young women cleaning a gym are transfixed by the bodybuilders, who go on concentrating on their lifts even when the women undress.

predicaments.situation: one performs a last time before dying
predicaments.basis: In the Pagliacci segment an aging virtuoso mimes his aria to an old recording in an empty opera house and dies; in the Louise segment a veteran singer gives her final performance intercut with home movies of her young and in love.

relatives.title: Elvira Madigan
relatives.shares: two lovers agree that the life they want is unavailable and end it together

relatives.title: In the Realm of the Senses
relatives.shares: desire is followed past the point where it can coexist with staying alive

relatives.title: Sunset Boulevard
relatives.shares: a performer plays to an audience that exists mostly in her own head

relatives.title: All That Jazz
relatives.shares: a last performance and a death are staged as the same event

relatives.title: The Red Shoes
relatives.shares: the performance consumes the person giving it

films.title: Decalogue V
films.engine: A drifting nineteen-year-old with a rope in his bag kills a taxi driver he has no reason to kill, slowly and while the man begs. A year later the young lawyer who argued against the death penalty and lost sits with him, learns that a child's death five years ago sits under everything, and then watches several men hold the boy down and hang him — the same act, done deliberately, by everyone.

predicaments.situation: a stranger is killed for no reason
predicaments.basis: Jacek strangles the taxi driver Rekowski with a length of rope and finishes him with a stone, having chosen the cab at random after a day of aimless cruelties.

predicaments.situation: a killing is answered with a killing
predicaments.basis: The court sentences Jacek to death for the murder and he is hanged by policemen who restrain him, with his lawyer made to watch.

predicaments.situation: one is asked to speak for the condemned
predicaments.basis: Piotr, in his first case out of law school, argues against the death penalty, fails, and asks the judge whether a better lawyer could have saved Jacek; the judge says nothing could have changed the outcome.

predicaments.situation: an old loss is repaid on strangers
predicaments.basis: Jacek tells Piotr that his twelve-year-old sister was run over by a drunk driver who had been drinking with him, and wonders whether he would have lived differently had she lived.

predicaments.situation: the dying ask to lie beside their dead
predicaments.basis: Before the execution Jacek asks to be buried in the family plot beside his sister and father, though the last space would have to be given up by his mother, and sends her the enlarged photograph of the girl.

relatives.title: L'Argent
relatives.shares: a chain of ordinary wrongs ends in a killing with no proportion to anything behind it

relatives.title: Dead Man Walking
relatives.shares: someone stays beside a condemned killer through to the execution and is changed by watching it

relatives.title: El verdugo
relatives.shares: the deliberate, staffed, procedural business of putting a man to death

relatives.title: In Cold Blood
relatives.shares: a motiveless murder and the state's answering execution are laid side by side

relatives.title: Antigone (1961)
relatives.shares: where the condemned is allowed to be buried becomes the last thing at stake

films.title: Hard Eight
films.engine: An older gambler finds a broke, hungry stranger outside a diner, feeds him, teaches him how to make money and, over two years, comes to treat him as a son — and the reason for all of it is that he killed the young man's father. When a friend of the son's finds out and puts a price on the secret, the old man kills again to keep the family he built out of an apology.

predicaments.situation: a stranger in need is taken in
predicaments.basis: Sydney buys John coffee outside a diner in Sparks, takes him to Vegas and shows him how to win the money he needs for his mother's funeral.

predicaments.situation: a man makes a son of a stranger
predicaments.basis: Over two years Sydney turns John into a protégé, steers him toward Clementine, and tells him on the phone that he loves him like a son; John says it back.

predicaments.situation: help is given to hide an old wrong
predicaments.basis: Jimmy tells Sydney he has heard the stories about Sydney killing John's father in Atlantic City, which is what the fatherly care has been paying off all along, and John never learns it.

predicaments.situation: a secret is used to extract money
predicaments.basis: Jimmy pulls a gun and demands ten thousand dollars to keep quiet about Atlantic City, settles for six, wins on a hard eight with it, and Sydney comes to his house and kills him.

predicaments.situation: a rash act is covered up by another
predicaments.basis: Sydney arrives at the motel where John and Clementine are holding an unconscious tourist and phoning his wife for ransom, sends the newly married pair off on a honeymoon and clears the evidence out of the room.

relatives.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
relatives.shares: a man attaches himself to the family of someone he killed and calls it kindness

relatives.title: Midnight Cowboy
relatives.shares: a broke drifter is taken up by a more knowing man and the two make a household of it

relatives.title: Paper Moon
relatives.shares: an improvised father-and-child bond built on a debt neither party states plainly

relatives.title: Le Samouraï
relatives.shares: a quiet older man's tidiness about evidence is the whole measure of his life

relatives.title: A History of Violence
relatives.shares: a life built as atonement collapses when someone from the buried past turns up to name it

films.title: The Time to Live and the Time to Die
films.engine: A boy grows up in a household that is quietly emptying — a father who dies of long illness, a mother who dies after him, a grandmother who keeps setting off on foot for a homeland nobody can reach — and he spends those years fighting strangers instead of looking at any of it. Only when the grandmother dies unnoticed in the same house as him does someone else's silent judgment tell him what his inattention amounted to. The film is the account he gives of it afterwards, in his own voice.

predicaments.situation: an elder loses the thread of the present
predicaments.basis: Ah-ha's grandmother repeatedly walks out onto the road intending to travel back to mainland China, an impossible journey, confusing local residents and taking the boy along with her.

predicaments.situation: the young neglect an elder unto death
predicaments.basis: The grandmother dies at home without Ah-ha or his two younger brothers noticing, and the mortician, finding half her body already decayed, silently rebukes them.

predicaments.situation: children are left to raise themselves
predicaments.basis: The father dies of his illness while Ah-ha is small, the mother dies of tongue cancer some years later, and the boys are left in the Fengshan dormitory with no adult but the failing grandmother.

predicaments.situation: grief is discharged as violence toward strangers
predicaments.basis: Through the years of the deaths Ah-ha brawls with other students and local gangs, deflates his teacher's bicycle tire after an argument, and breaks a veteran's window.

predicaments.situation: love is offered only on a condition
predicaments.basis: The girl from the other high school tells Ah-ha she will consider him once he has been admitted to college, which sends him to study seriously for the entrance exam; a year later he fails it.

relatives.title: Tokyo Story
relatives.shares: the old are left unattended by the young until death settles the question

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: children keep a household running alone after the adult stops being there

relatives.title: Pather Panchali
relatives.shares: an old woman on the edge of the family dies uncared for while the children look elsewhere

relatives.title: The 400 Blows
relatives.shares: a boy's unspoken family situation comes out as delinquency against teachers and strangers

relatives.title: A Brighter Summer Day
relatives.shares: displaced families and schoolboy gang fighting in the same postwar Taiwan

films.title: Decalogue III
films.engine: A woman with nobody to spend Christmas night with invents a missing husband so that a man she slept with three years ago will drive her around the city until morning. He suspects the emergency is false and keeps driving anyway; she has privately made the night a wager against killing herself. At dawn they separate, he goes back into a house where his wife already knows, and she goes back to being alone.

predicaments.situation: someone invents an emergency to keep another close
predicaments.basis: Ewa tells Janusz her husband has disappeared and plants clues through hospitals and the train station to hold him beside her until seven in the morning, though the husband has been living with a new family in Kraków for three years.

predicaments.situation: someone stakes their life on a private test
predicaments.basis: Ewa has decided in advance that if she can keep Janusz away from his family until 7am all will be well, and that if she fails she will kill herself; she only tells him once the clock strikes.

predicaments.situation: one person lets another's lie stand unchallenged
predicaments.basis: Janusz works out partway through the night that the search is staged and says nothing, continuing to drive with her.

predicaments.situation: a spouse suspects the other of an affair
predicaments.basis: Janusz leaves on Christmas night claiming his taxi has been stolen; his wife tells him to let it go, and when he returns at dawn she asks outright whether he has gone back to Ewa.

predicaments.situation: a person alone watches others keep their families
predicaments.basis: Ewa wanders into the Christmas mass after visiting the retirement home, and spends the holiday watching families she has no part in, including the one she borrows Janusz from.

predicaments.situation: an elder loses the thread of the present
predicaments.basis: Ewa's senile aunt in the retirement home asks whether she has done her homework and then asks after the husband Ewa no longer has.

relatives.title: The Apartment
relatives.shares: a person with nowhere to be at the holidays makes their life hang on whether someone stays

relatives.title: Brief Encounter
relatives.shares: a household lie buys the hours spent with someone outside the marriage

relatives.title: Before Sunset
relatives.shares: a night is stretched out with pretexts because it ends when the other person goes home

relatives.title: In the Mood for Love
relatives.shares: two people conduct a whole relationship inside a search for absent spouses

relatives.title: Wild Strawberries
relatives.shares: a night's driving with a companion turns into an accounting of an old failure

films.title: Intervista
films.engine: A director being interviewed by a foreign television crew about his new film keeps not making that film, and instead films the studio itself, his own first arrival there as a young reporter decades earlier, and the people who were young when he was. The adaptation everyone is casting and building sets for exists mainly as a reason to keep the cameras running. What the film actually stages is a man arranging to be in the same frame as his own past — and arranging for old colleagues to sit and watch themselves as they were.

predicaments.situation: a person meets their younger self
predicaments.basis: Fellini shares scenes with the aspiring actor Sergio Rubini playing him as the young journalist who first visited Cinecittà in 1938, riding a fake tramway out to interview a matinee idol.

predicaments.situation: one work is a pretext for another
predicaments.basis: The adaptation of Kafka's Amerika is cast, scouted and built throughout, but it is a fiction Fellini uses to shoot the film about Cinecittà that we are watching, and it collapses before completion.

predicaments.situation: people gather to look back on shared years
predicaments.basis: Fellini takes the crew to Anita Ekberg's house, where she and Marcello Mastroianni sit and replay their own scenes from La Dolce Vita.

predicaments.situation: a maker is questioned by curious visitors
predicaments.basis: A Japanese television crew follows Fellini around the studios for a news report, and he keeps deflecting them into the backlot, the commercials in production and other people's business.

predicaments.situation: a shared undertaking collapses before it is finished
predicaments.basis: A thunderstorm and a mock attack by fake warriors on horseback carrying television antennae bring the Amerika production down, and Fellini's voiceover announces the film is simply over.

relatives.title: 8½
relatives.shares: a director keeps a production alive as cover for not having a film, and fills it with his own past

relatives.title: Day for Night
relatives.shares: the making of a film becomes the film, crew and casting troubles included

relatives.title: Sunset Boulevard
relatives.shares: a performer is put back in front of their own younger image on a screen

relatives.title: Close-Up
relatives.shares: the apparatus of filmmaking is turned on the people who once lived the events being restaged

relatives.title: Wild Strawberries
relatives.shares: an old man walks through scenes of his own youth as a present-tense visitor

films.title: The Last Waltz
films.engine: Five musicians who have played together for sixteen years decide to stop touring while they still can, and stage the ending as a single concert with the people they learned from standing beside them. Between songs they are asked to account for how the thing began — the names they discarded, the fee one of them charged the others for lessons, the rooms they played. The film is a group choosing its own last night rather than being ended by the road.

predicaments.situation: a group ends its shared life on purpose
predicaments.basis: Robertson tells Scorsese that sixteen years on the road is the whole point of the evening, that the numbers have begun to scare him and he could not survive twenty.

predicaments.situation: people gather to look back on shared years
predicaments.basis: The concert is interrupted throughout by studio interviews in which Danko, Manuel, Hudson and Robertson recall the early names, the burnt-out nightclub owned by Jack Ruby, and how being called "the band" became the name.

predicaments.situation: those who taught appear beside those who learned
predicaments.basis: Muddy Waters, Paul Butterfield, Dr. John, the Staple Singers and others come onstage with the group, covering the blues, gospel, R&B and folk the group was built out of.

predicaments.situation: someone hides their work from their parents
predicaments.basis: Hudson would only join if each of the others paid him ten dollars a week for music lessons, so that his classical training let him tell his parents he was a music teacher rather than a rock-and-roll player.

relatives.title: The Wrestler
relatives.shares: a performer decides whether to keep living on the road when the road has begun to cost more than it returns

relatives.title: Buena Vista Social Club
relatives.shares: players are gathered to perform together once and account for where the music came from

relatives.title: Summer of Soul
relatives.shares: the elders of a tradition share a stage with the people carrying it forward

relatives.title: Amazing Grace
relatives.shares: a single performance is filmed as the definitive record of a body of work

films.title: Something to Talk About
films.engine: A woman sees her husband kiss another woman outside a bank, and when she goes to her father for support she finds he did the same thing to her mother for years. Pulling on the thread wrecks two marriages at once, and forces out what neither couple had said: that she stopped wanting her husband because she had given up her own life to work in her father's barn. Both marriages are put back together only after each side admits its share.

predicaments.situation: a spouse suspects the other of an affair
predicaments.basis: Grace sees Eddie kiss a blonde woman outside the bank, catches him with her at a restaurant after he lies about dining with clients, and takes their daughter to her sister's house.

predicaments.situation: a child discovers the parent did the same
predicaments.basis: Grace researches her father Wyly and finds he cheated on her mother Georgia with several women; Georgia throws him out of the house.

predicaments.situation: a parent withholds support from a grown child
predicaments.basis: Grace goes to Wyly after catching Eddie and he will talk about nothing but the coming show jumping competition and which horse will ride in it.

predicaments.situation: both sides discover their share of the fault
predicaments.basis: At the house Eddie says he strayed because they had stopped sleeping together, and Grace answers that she stopped because she had sunk into depression over the life she was living.

predicaments.situation: a person abandoned their own life for family
predicaments.basis: Grace left veterinary college when she became pregnant with Caroline and went to work at her father's lesson barn, which she had never wanted; by the end she is enrolled again while still working the stable.

relatives.title: Scenes from a Marriage
relatives.shares: an affair forces a couple to finally say what had gone unsaid about wanting each other

relatives.title: The Awful Truth
relatives.shares: a couple breaks apart over suspicion, flirts with replacements, and finds their way back

relatives.title: Autumn Sonata
relatives.shares: a grown daughter confronts the parent whose choices shaped the life she settled for

relatives.title: An Unmarried Woman
relatives.shares: a wife discovers the infidelity and uses the wreckage to restart the career she had dropped

relatives.title: A Separation
relatives.shares: two generations' marriages come apart at once under the same pressure

films.title: The Castle of Cagliostro
films.engine: A thief tracking counterfeit money finds the country printing it is run by a regent forcing his own ward into marriage so he can take what she inherited. It turns out she saved the thief's life ten years earlier when he first came for the treasure and failed, so the theft becomes a rescue. He gets her out, refuses her offer to leave with him, and leaves her the country.

predicaments.situation: a marriage is forced to secure another's power
predicaments.basis: Clarisse, princess of Cagliostro, is to be married against her will to Count Cagliostro, the regent, to cement his rule and combine the two ancestral rings that unlock the hidden treasure.

predicaments.situation: a guardian steals from the one he guards
predicaments.basis: The Count rules Cagliostro in Clarisse's place, keeps her captive, drugs her for the ceremony, and wants only her ring and her inheritance.

predicaments.situation: a rescuer repays a debt from long ago
predicaments.basis: Lupin tells his companions that Clarisse saved his life ten years earlier during his failed first attempt on the treasure, which is why he is going back for her rather than the money.

predicaments.situation: a pursuer must cooperate with the one pursued
predicaments.basis: Lupin and Inspector Zenigata, who has chased him for years, make a pact in the castle catacombs, escape together, and later coordinate so Zenigata can expose the counterfeiting under cover of the chase.

predicaments.situation: the rescued offers to follow the rescuer away
predicaments.basis: Freed, Clarisse tells Lupin she does not want him to go and says she is willing to become a thief herself; he gently refuses and leaves her as the rightful ruler.

predicaments.situation: an official is stopped from prosecuting the powerful
predicaments.basis: Zenigata brings the counterfeiting evidence to his Interpol superiors, who fear the political consequences, halt the investigation and take him off the case.

relatives.title: Roman Holiday
relatives.shares: a commoner gets a sheltered royal out for a while and then hands her back to the role rather than keep her

relatives.title: The Princess Bride
relatives.shares: a woman is married off to secure a usurper's rule and an outsider comes to take her out of it

relatives.title: Catch Me If You Can
relatives.shares: a lawman and the criminal he has chased for years end up needing and protecting each other

relatives.title: The Defiant Ones
relatives.shares: two men on opposite sides of the law must escape as a pair

relatives.title: Hamlet
relatives.shares: a regent holds a throne that belongs to the heir he keeps under his roof

films.title: No End
films.engine: A month after her husband dies, a woman is offered every available way out of him — a friend, a stranger, a hypnotist who will make her forget — and takes none of them, while the unfinished case he left behind passes to an older lawyer who plans to free the imprisoned client by presenting him as harmless, and the client would rather stay inside than be made harmless. Two refusals run in parallel: a man who will not let himself be saved on someone else's terms, and a woman who will not be talked out of her dead. She ends by going to him.

predicaments.situation: the dead are kept present among the living
predicaments.basis: Antek narrates his own death and then appears to Ula during hypnosis, at the candlelit grave and in her son's nightmare, so the household goes on organising itself around a man who is gone.

predicaments.situation: one chooses the dead over the living
predicaments.basis: Ula seals herself in the kitchen with the gas on and tape over her mouth, and the film's last image is the two of them walking together in black.

predicaments.situation: one refuses the rescue another has arranged
predicaments.basis: Labrador lines up union witnesses to argue that Darek is no threat and get the sentence cut, and Darek insists on staying in and continuing the hunger strike.

predicaments.situation: one takes up the work the dead left
predicaments.basis: Joanna comes to the widow for the file, and Labrador, the man Antek once clerked for, takes over the client Antek died holding.

predicaments.situation: one is imprisoned for what they believe
predicaments.basis: Darek was arrested for organising for Solidarity and is held while lawyers argue over how much of that belief to admit in court.

predicaments.situation: a stranger takes the place of the missing
predicaments.basis: Ula scoffs at the English visitor's offer of fifty dollars and then goes with him anyway.

relatives.title: The Green Room
relatives.shares: a survivor builds a life of tending the dead and cannot be recalled to the living

relatives.title: Under the Sand
relatives.shares: a widow keeps her husband present in the house rather than admit he is gone

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: the dead spouse returns and the living one goes willingly toward them

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man cannot let a dead woman go and destroys the living one offered in her place

relatives.title: Hiroshima mon amour
relatives.shares: someone is urged to be cured of a dead lover by forgetting

films.title: Sleepers
films.engine: Four boys sent away for an accident are raped and beaten for a year by the men paid to keep them, and agree on release that they will never say it aloud because no one would believe them. Fifteen years later two of them shoot one of those men in a crowded bar, and the other two rig the murder trial — a bought lawyer, a frightened witness, a priest talked into perjury — so that the killers walk free and the thing they swore never to mention is finally said in a room where it must be written down.

predicaments.situation: a child is harmed by its protector
predicaments.basis: Nokes, Addison, Ferguson and Styler, the guards at the Wilkinson home, torture and rape the four boys in their custody and beat a fifth, Rizzo, to death.

predicaments.situation: one refuses to speak what others demand
predicaments.basis: Shakes urges the four to report the abuse before release and the others refuse, and they vow never to speak of it again.

predicaments.situation: one is not believed about being harmed
predicaments.basis: Michael's argument for silence is that nobody would believe them or care, and Rizzo's family is simply told he died of pneumonia.

predicaments.situation: an injury to a friend is avenged
predicaments.basis: John and Tommy shoot Nokes on sight in a pub, Michael takes the prosecution in order to lose it, and Rizzo's brother has Addison killed once King Benny tells him how Rizzo really died.

roles.avenging: Michael, Shakes, John, Tommy, Eddie Robinson

predicaments.situation: the guilty are punished outside the law
predicaments.basis: The court is used backwards — a prosecutor scripting the defence, witnesses intimidated, an acquittal engineered — while gangsters and a bribery charge finish off the rest.

predicaments.situation: a good man lies to save the wronged
predicaments.basis: Father Bobby, who once talked Shakes into confessing his wrongdoing, swears the killers were with him at a basketball game and produces three ticket stubs.

relatives.title: Silenced
relatives.shares: children in an institution are abused by their keepers and disbelieved until a court is forced to hear it

relatives.title: The Magdalene Sisters
relatives.shares: the young are brutalised by the adults charged with reforming them and expected never to say so

relatives.title: Mystic River
relatives.shares: childhood violation among friends is never spoken of and returns as a killing decades later

relatives.title: Spotlight
relatives.shares: long-buried abuse by trusted men is finally forced into a public record

relatives.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
relatives.shares: a man wronged in confinement returns years later to punish each of his keepers in turn

films.title: The Green Room
films.engine: A man who lost his wife eleven years ago has turned his life into a service for her and, after a fire, for every dead person he knew, filling a ruined chapel with candles for them. A young woman who helps him keep the place asks him to add one more flame — for the friend who once betrayed him and who was also her lover — and he would rather shut himself in and stop eating than admit that man to the altar. He forgives too late to live on it.

predicaments.situation: the dead are kept present among the living
predicaments.basis: Davenne maintains a room, and then a chapel of lit candles and photographs, for his wife Julie and for everyone he has outlived, having reached the point where he knows more dead than living.

predicaments.situation: one chooses the dead over the living
predicaments.basis: Rebuffed over the candle for Massigny, Davenne locks himself away, refuses food and the doctor, and reaches the chapel only in time to collapse and die there.

predicaments.situation: a lover is found to belong to another
predicaments.basis: Davenne walks out of Cécilia's home on seeing it full of photographs of Massigny, and she tells him plainly at the chapel that she was one of that man's women and loves him still.

predicaments.situation: one is betrayed by a closest friend
predicaments.basis: Massigny, once Davenne's best friend, did something to him the film never names, and only after the man's death does Davenne allow him a flame.

predicaments.situation: one takes up the work the dead left
predicaments.basis: Cécilia finishes the chapel exactly as she first asked, adding a last candle for Davenne himself.

relatives.title: No End
relatives.shares: a shrine to one dead person consumes the mourner's remaining life

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: devotion to a dead woman makes the living one who offers herself unacceptable

relatives.title: Rebecca
relatives.shares: a dead wife's maintained presence leaves no room for the woman who is actually there

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: a man prefers the company of the dead to the household still waiting for him

relatives.title: Truly, Madly, Deeply
relatives.shares: someone must let a dead spouse go before a living attachment is possible

films.title: Joi Baba Felunath
films.engine: A rich man who wants a small family idol first tries to buy the investigator off the case and, when that fails, has a knife thrown at the investigator's friend for entertainment — which turns a piece of work into a personal vow to see him finished or quit. Underneath the theft, a boy has hidden the thing to keep it from that man, a household servant has been paid to take it, and a craftsman who briefly held it is stabbed so he cannot say so.

predicaments.situation: one is punished for refusing to be bought
predicaments.basis: Maganlal offers Feluda two thousand rupees to drop the investigation, and when he refuses, stages a knife-throwing act with Jatayu as the target.

predicaments.situation: an injury to a friend is avenged
predicaments.basis: After Jatayu's humiliation Feluda vows either to settle with Maganlal or to stop being a detective, and ends by trapping him in a sting that puts him in police hands.

predicaments.situation: one inside the house serves an outsider
predicaments.basis: Bikash Singha, a member of the Ghosal family, is paid by Maganlal to take the Ganesh and later guides the killer to the man who had it.

predicaments.situation: a child hides what the elders would lose
predicaments.basis: Ruku, hearing that the statue was to be stolen, concealed it inside the lion of the Durga idol without telling the household.

predicaments.situation: an innocent is killed to keep a secret
predicaments.basis: Shashibhushan Pal, the idol-maker, found the statue while painting and passed it to Bikash, and is tracked down and stabbed so he cannot say what he handled.

relatives.title: The Maltese Falcon
relatives.shares: a small prized object draws in a detective who is offered money to stop and does not

relatives.title: Chinatown
relatives.shares: an investigator is warned off by a rich man's hospitality and an innocent dies for what he knew

relatives.title: Knives Out
relatives.shares: a wealthy household is robbed from within and a witness is killed before he can speak

relatives.title: The Third Man
relatives.shares: a friend's harm turns an outsider's curiosity into a personal reckoning

relatives.title: High and Low
relatives.shares: a man refuses to let money settle the matter and is made to pay for it

films.title: King Lear
films.engine: An old man dictating his memoirs keeps one daughter beside him as typist, demands that she declare her love for him more effusively than she will, cuts her off when she does not, and leads her away from the only young man who speaks to her — while her silence sits at the centre of everything and everyone around it strains to fill it. That young man has been commissioned to recover words that disappeared when everything else did, and finds them coming out of the old man's mouth. Note that the plot text is largely a description of the film's own making, so what happens between these figures is only intermittently visible.

predicaments.situation: a parent demands a declaration of love
predicaments.basis: Learo reproves Cordelia for not professing her love effusively enough and tells her she will lose her inheritance, while telexes carry his other daughters' extravagant versions.

predicaments.situation: one refuses to speak what others demand
predicaments.basis: Cordelia says nothing, sinks to the floor at her sisters' words, and the film states that everything organising itself to silence her silence is what produces the violence.

predicaments.situation: a father keeps his daughter from other men
predicaments.basis: When Will Jr. thanks Cordelia, Learo accuses him of making a play for his girl and leads her away without a word.

predicaments.situation: one is charged with recovering what was lost
predicaments.basis: Will Jr. explains he was engaged by the Cannon Cultural Division to recover a culture that never came back after the explosion, starting with his famous ancestor's works, and recognises Learo speaking lines from one of them.

relatives.title: Ran
relatives.shares: an old man divides what he has by how loudly his children will say they love him

relatives.title: Fahrenheit 451
relatives.shares: someone is set to recover words that a catastrophe erased from the world

relatives.title: 8½
relatives.shares: a director owes a producer a film he cannot assemble and puts that failure inside the film

relatives.title: Ordet
relatives.shares: the person who says least is the one everyone else's speech is arranged around

films.title: Dream Lover
films.engine: A woman kills an intruder who broke into her flat demanding a woman she has never heard of, and afterwards cannot stop dreaming the attack — partly because her body fails to hold her still while she sleeps, so she acts the dreams out. The treatment teaches her to overpower the man inside her own dreams, and what it finally uncovers is a much older night in which the man who came into her bedroom was her father. She wounds him with a knife, goes out the window as she did as a child, and survives it.

predicaments.situation: a child is harmed by its protector
predicaments.basis: In the last dream Kathy is a small girl in a white dress that turns red, and her father Ben enters, reveals himself as the intruder Danny, and rapes her.

predicaments.situation: a father keeps his daughter from other men
predicaments.basis: Ben wants Kathy on the trip to Japan rather than in Kevin's band, objects to her moving in with Kevin, and follows her to London when she goes.

predicaments.situation: one is not believed about being harmed
predicaments.basis: The police find semen in her bed and press her on whether she and Danny were involved, treating a woman who stabbed an unarmed man as a suspect rather than a survivor.

predicaments.situation: a stranger takes the place of the missing
predicaments.basis: Danny arrives at her door searching for a Maggie she has never heard of, and returns that night to attack the woman he has put in Maggie's place.

predicaments.situation: a lover is found to belong to another
predicaments.basis: Kathy comes back to the apartment to find Kevin with another woman, and afterwards dreams of murdering him for it.

relatives.title: Marnie
relatives.shares: a woman's violent reactions are traced back to a childhood night she cannot consciously reach

relatives.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me
relatives.shares: the man entering the daughter's room at night turns out to be her father

relatives.title: Spellbound
relatives.shares: dreams are analysed under supervision to recover the buried event that explains the present

relatives.title: Sleepers
relatives.shares: a child is violated by the adult in charge of it and the memory governs the adult life

relatives.title: Repulsion
relatives.shares: a woman kills an intruder while unable to tell hallucination from what is in the room

films.title: Memories
films.engine: Three stories about people who keep doing what they were told while the cost of it lands somewhere they cannot see. Two salvage men answer a call from a woman who killed the man who refused her and now offers strangers their own dead back; a sick technician carries a delivery across a country he is killing with every breath; a family loads and fires shells over a wall at an enemy no one has ever laid eyes on.

predicaments.situation: the dead are offered back to the living
predicaments.basis: The station's hologram of the diva Eva conjures Heintz's dead daughter Emily and invites him to stay inside the memory with her double.

predicaments.situation: a rejection is answered with a killing
predicaments.basis: Eva murdered her fellow singer Carlo for refusing to marry her, and has since forced others to relive his likeness.

predicaments.situation: a man is offered another man's life
predicaments.basis: Miguel is seduced into believing he is Carlo and stays inside the station fully inhabiting the dead man's identity.

predicaments.situation: a man is used without being told why
predicaments.basis: Headquarters orders the flu-stricken Nobuo to carry the experimental drug to Tokyo without telling him he is the source of the gas killing everyone he passes.

roles.using: the research company and the military

predicaments.situation: a child's question is deflected by the parent
predicaments.basis: The schoolboy asks his cannon-loader father why they are at war, and is told he will understand when he is older; he falls asleep imagining himself as the officer who fires the big gun.

relatives.title: Solaris
relatives.shares: a station returns the dead to the men who lost them, and staying with the copy is the offer

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a living person is remade into the likeness of a dead one and comes to accept the part

relatives.title: Brazil
relatives.shares: a whole population labours against an enemy nobody has ever seen

relatives.title: Come and See
relatives.shares: a boy inside a war whose reason is never given to him

relatives.title: Dr. Strangelove
relatives.shares: a man carries out his delivery orders while the harm he causes is invisible to him

films.title: The River
films.engine: A farming couple hold a stretch of river bottom that floods, against a local grain buyer who needs them ruined so he can drown the valley on purpose behind a dam. To keep the land the husband takes factory work that turns out to be strikebreaking, and the last fight over the water is really a fight against neighbours who already lost their farms and are being paid to break his levee.

predicaments.situation: a man is worn down into selling
predicaments.basis: Joe Wade quietly buys up the river properties and offers Tom less for his corn than it cost to plant, to make holding the farm impossible.

predicaments.situation: a man takes work against his own kind
predicaments.basis: Tom takes a job at a steel mill to stop foreclosure and only realises he is a strikebreaker as he crosses the picket line.

predicaments.situation: the ruined are hired to ruin the remaining
predicaments.basis: Wade arrives with a truckload of bankrupt farmers paid to dismantle the levee, and offers Tom's own neighbours a bonus to sabotage it.

predicaments.situation: a wife asks her husband to stop fighting
predicaments.basis: Exhausted after nearly losing her arm in a farm accident while Tom was away at the mill, Mae confronts him over his stubbornness in a losing fight against both Wade and the water.

relatives.title: The Grapes of Wrath
relatives.shares: farmers driven off land by a buyer's arithmetic and set against each other by need

relatives.title: Matewan
relatives.shares: strikers and the desperate men brought in to replace them recognising each other

relatives.title: The Tree of Wooden Clogs
relatives.shares: a family working land whose owner can end them with a decision

relatives.title: The Naked Island
relatives.shares: a couple's whole life spent in labour against water that will not cooperate

relatives.title: Country
relatives.shares: a farm couple holding out against foreclosure while the marriage takes the strain

films.title: One Hundred and One Nights
films.engine: A very old man whose memory is dissolving into other people's lives pays a film student to come and talk to him every night for a hundred and one nights. She and her boyfriend, who needs money for a short film, hire a young stranger to pose as the great-grandson nobody has seen in ten years — and the impostor grows fond of the old man while the fortune goes to a woman mistaken for a star.

predicaments.situation: a stranger is hired to pose as family
predicaments.basis: Camille and Mica recruit a friend's brother, also called Vincent, to impersonate Simon Cinéma's missing great-grandson for a third of the inheritance, coaching him with childhood details.

predicaments.situation: a young person is paid to visit nightly
predicaments.basis: Cinéma engages Camille to come to his château every night for 101 days to talk about cinema with him.

predicaments.situation: a fortune draws people to a failing mind
predicaments.basis: Camille, Mica and Vincent scheme over the inheritance while the entertainer Marina, taken for Elizabeth Taylor, gets the delusional old man to sign everything over to her.

predicaments.situation: the deceiver comes to love the deceived
predicaments.basis: Vincent, planted in the house as a fake heir, is pleased rather than sorry when the scheme collapses, having become fond of Cinéma.

predicaments.situation: a man mistakes those before him for others
predicaments.basis: Cinéma's head is "full of stars": he takes a begging vagabond for a princess and then a knight, believes an entertainer is Elizabeth Taylor, and mistakes himself for other people.

relatives.title: Sunset Boulevard
relatives.shares: a young hopeful paid to keep company with an old figure living inside a vanished career

relatives.title: The Return of Martin Guerre
relatives.shares: an impostor received as the missing relative, and coming to want the family he is robbing

relatives.title: Family Romance, LLC
relatives.shares: a stranger hired to play a relative, with the fiction outlasting the arrangement

relatives.title: Being There
relatives.shares: a dying rich man's household reorganised around someone taken for what he is not

relatives.title: Wild Strawberries
relatives.shares: an old man near the end whose memory keeps replacing the people in front of him

films.title: Big Deal After 20 Years
films.engine: A man comes out of prison to a Rome that has closed over him: his wife lives with a painter who pays her rent, his camera gear was sold to pay his lawyer, and his grown son is quicker at the family's old criminal trade than he is. He goes back to the only work he knows and finds even the crime has moved on without telling him what is actually in the car.

predicaments.situation: a man returns to find his place filled
predicaments.basis: Tiberio comes home from prison to find Teresa living with a house painter who pays her rent for her company, and is thrown out of his own house; he sleeps in a wrecked car in the junkyard opposite.

predicaments.situation: the son surpasses the father at his work
predicaments.basis: Brunino interrupts his father's outdated robbery attempts, and it is his cunning that hides the money from the border police.

predicaments.situation: a man outlives the use of his skill
predicaments.basis: Tiberio's safecracking has no buyers, Peppe's scheme needs a middle-aged woman he can only impersonate as a joke, and Ferribotte pumps petrol; in the end they leave the city for a small town.

predicaments.situation: a man is used without being told why
predicaments.basis: The crew believe they are carrying money across the Yugoslav border for the Banker, and only discover cocaine hidden under a swapped car seat on the way back.

predicaments.situation: a debt is owed for accidental harm
predicaments.basis: Tiberio's turn in drag sends Peppe into laughter and a heart attack, and out of guilt he takes over leading the job for him — Peppe is shot dead at his own birthday party by one of the traffickers.

relatives.title: Straight Time
relatives.shares: a man out of prison finding no room left for him and returning to the only trade he has

relatives.title: The Friends of Eddie Coyle
relatives.shares: an aging small-timer whose usefulness to the business has quietly expired

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a son watching his father fail at the only work available to him

relatives.title: The Wrestler
relatives.shares: a man whose one skill has outlived the world that paid for it

relatives.title: Le Cercle Rouge
relatives.shares: men assembled for a job and kept ignorant of what they are actually moving

films.title: Chronicle of a Death Foretold
films.engine: A girl is pressed into marrying a rich stranger and is handed back to her family on the wedding night for not being a virgin; beaten, she names a man she may never have been alone with. Her brothers do not want to kill him and announce it to everyone they meet, and a whole town — amused, disbelieving, or officially busy — lets the murder happen while keeping the one man concerned in the dark.

predicaments.situation: a marriage is forced on an unwilling woman
predicaments.basis: Angela Vicario tells her parents she does not love Bayardo San Román and her mother answers that love can be learned; she yields and the wedding is thrown.

predicaments.situation: the doomed man alone is not told
predicaments.basis: The Vicario twins announce their intention all over town; the shopkeeper tries to get them drunk, the authorities do nothing, and Santiago Nasar walks to the square unarmed and unaware.

predicaments.situation: a killing is done to satisfy others
predicaments.basis: Pablo and Pedro are reluctant to stab Santiago but local custom requires them to avenge their sister's dishonour.

predicaments.situation: an accusation is never withdrawn
predicaments.basis: There is no evidence Santiago ever touched Angela and the town believes she was shielding someone else, but questioned again twenty-seven years later she still names him.

predicaments.situation: a rejected woman waits years for his return
predicaments.basis: Angela falls in love with Bayardo only after he returns her to her family, writes to him weekly for years without an answer, and one day finds a trail of her own unopened letters leading back to him.

predicaments.situation: a man is worn down into selling
predicaments.basis: The widower Xius insists his house is not for sale, and Bayardo raises the offer until he gives in, because Angela had said she liked that house best.

relatives.title: The Ox-Bow Incident
relatives.shares: a killing everyone present could stop and nobody does

relatives.title: The White Ribbon
relatives.shares: a village that knows what is happening among its own and says nothing

relatives.title: Blood Wedding
relatives.shares: a marriage arranged over a woman's refusal, settled afterwards by an obligatory killing

relatives.title: Dogville
relatives.shares: a whole community's complicity dressed up as ordinary daily business

relatives.title: High Noon
relatives.shares: a town that foresees the violence and quietly declines to be involved

films.title: Crimes and Misdemeanors
films.engine: A respected eye doctor has his mistress killed when she threatens to tell his wife, waits for a judgement that never arrives, and discovers he can live comfortably with what he did. Alongside him a documentary maker hired to flatter a man he despises loses the woman he loves to that same man, and the philosopher whose case for living he was filming kills himself.

predicaments.situation: a lover threatens to tell what was hidden
predicaments.basis: Dolores Paley, realising Judah will never leave Miriam, threatens to disclose the affair and his questionable finances; Judah's gangster brother has her killed.

predicaments.situation: the guilty man is never punished
predicaments.basis: The murder is pinned on a drifter, Judah's guilt lifts with time, and he leaves the wedding cheerfully with his wife after describing the whole thing as a hypothetical.

predicaments.situation: a woman chooses the rival over the suitor
predicaments.basis: Halley Reed gently puts Cliff off, goes to London, and comes back engaged to Lester, who had sent her white roses round the clock for days.

predicaments.situation: a man must praise someone he despises
predicaments.basis: Cliff is paid by his brother-in-law Lester to make a film celebrating him, cuts him against footage of Mussolini on a balcony, and is fired at the screening.

predicaments.situation: the one preaching hope takes his life
predicaments.basis: Professor Levy, whose celebration of life Cliff has been filming for years, jumps from a window leaving a note reading only "I've gone out the window".

predicaments.situation: advice is sought then ignored
predicaments.basis: Judah confides in his patient Rabbi Ben, who is going blind and counsels honesty with Miriam; Judah calls his brother instead.

relatives.title: Match Point
relatives.shares: a man kills the mistress who threatens his marriage and is never made to answer for it

relatives.title: A Place in the Sun
relatives.shares: a woman becomes an obstacle to the life a man has climbed toward, and is removed

relatives.title: L'Argent
relatives.shares: a comfortable man's lie costs someone else everything and never touches him

relatives.title: Sweet Smell of Success
relatives.shares: a man doing degrading work for someone he hates and losing what he wanted to him

relatives.title: Force of Evil
relatives.shares: a respectable career resting on a crime the man keeps arguing himself out of

films.title: Waterland
films.engine: A history teacher whose wife has broken down over the child they never had stops teaching the syllabus and starts telling his class the story of the summer that made them childless: a teenage pregnancy nobody could assign a father to, a botched abortion by the river, and a killing done by his damaged brother. He is confessing to a room of strangers what he cannot say to her, and the more of it he tells, the less hold he has on the present.

predicaments.situation: a life is reexamined for where it broke
predicaments.basis: Faced with Mary's collapse in 1974, Crick abandons his history lessons and narrates three generations of his own family in the Fens to his class instead.

predicaments.situation: a woman cannot have the child she wants
predicaments.basis: Mary was left infertile by the abortion performed by an old woman on the riverbank, and decades later takes a baby from a woman in a supermarket, calling it a gift from God.

predicaments.situation: two men want the same woman
predicaments.basis: Young Tom asks Mary to teach his mentally impaired older brother Dick about sex, then suspects the child she carries is Dick's and not his.

predicaments.situation: a hidden parentage is revealed to the child
predicaments.basis: Dick forces Tom to read aloud their grandfather's letter, which tells Dick he was conceived by their mother and that same grandfather; he then throws himself into the water.

predicaments.situation: an elder makes the young carry his past
predicaments.basis: Crick binds his student Matthew Price into the confession, is dismissed after student complaints, and uses his last speech to beg Price not to lose hope.

relatives.title: The Go-Between
relatives.shares: a boy's part in an adult pregnancy fixes the whole rest of his life

relatives.title: Sophie's Choice
relatives.shares: a man narrates a past whose withheld secret still governs the present

relatives.title: A Separation
relatives.shares: a pregnancy ends in a way no one can settle responsibility for

relatives.title: Hiroshima mon amour
relatives.shares: a wartime love is told and retold because it cannot be set down

relatives.title: The Sweet Hereafter
relatives.shares: a drowning is recounted by someone carrying a private sexual guilt about it

films.title: Eyes of Laura Mars
films.engine: A fashion photographer known for staged violence starts seeing real murders as they happen, through the killer's eyes, as he works his way through the people around her. The detective running the case comforts her, becomes her lover and arms her — and is the man she has been watching from inside all along.

predicaments.situation: the one protecting is the one causing harm
predicaments.basis: Neville takes charge of the investigation, gives Laura a gun for her safety, begins a romance with her, and is exposed as the killer when his account of Tommy's motives contradicts the man she knew.

predicaments.situation: someone foresees harm they cannot prevent
predicaments.basis: Laura watches the killings live from the murderer's viewpoint — her editor, her models, her agent, her ex-husband — and can only arrive afterward or crash her car trying.

predicaments.situation: a person is asked to kill their beloved
predicaments.basis: When Neville's gentler personality reasserts itself, he closes her hand around the gun he gave her and asks her to shoot him before the other one returns; she does.

predicaments.situation: someone is blamed for what they show others
predicaments.basis: Laura's stylised violent photographs draw press and feminist attack, and the police show her unpublished crime scenes that mirror her shoots almost exactly.

predicaments.situation: a wrong is pinned on the most convenient person
predicaments.basis: Her ex-convict driver Tommy is built into the killer by planted photographs and a playing card, then shot dead in a chase before he can clear himself.

relatives.title: Gaslight
relatives.shares: the man closest to her and apparently protecting her is the one destroying her

relatives.title: Peeping Tom
relatives.shares: someone who makes images of violence is bound to the violence itself

relatives.title: Blow-Up
relatives.shares: a photographer sees a killing through their own work and cannot make it hold still

relatives.title: Don't Look Now
relatives.shares: visions of a death arrive as warnings that cannot be acted on in time

relatives.title: Deep Red
relatives.shares: a witness saw the murderer without recognising what they were looking at

films.title: Pirates
films.engine: An old pirate and the boy who serves him stow away on a treasure galleon and spend the film chasing a golden throne through mutiny, capture and betrayal. The boy also falls for a nobleman's niece aboard, and every turn of the chase quietly asks whether he belongs to her or to the old man — until he answers.

predicaments.situation: loyalty to an elder outweighs a love
predicaments.basis: In the middle of his duel with Don Alfonso over Maria Dolores, Frog breaks off to help Captain Red get the golden throne away, and leaves her behind on the burning ship.

predicaments.situation: two men want the same woman
predicaments.basis: Don Alfonso, who commands the Neptune, and the cabin boy Frog both want Maria Dolores, who returns only Frog's feeling and finally spoils Alfonso's aim as he fires at him.

predicaments.situation: the ruled overthrow the one commanding them
predicaments.basis: Sentenced to death by Don Alfonso after a failed attempt to stir the crew, Red launches an open rebellion that takes the ship — which Alfonso later takes back while the pirates are drunk.

predicaments.situation: a captive is used to bargain with kin
predicaments.basis: Red seizes Maria Dolores to trade her to her uncle the governor for the throne, and finds the uncle unmoved by her fate until he is tortured through his gout.

predicaments.situation: a leader saves himself abandoning his followers
predicaments.basis: Red sinks his own ship to cut off retreat, has Boomako secretly ready a boat for the throne, and rows away leaving the surviving crew in the water.

relatives.title: Treasure Island
relatives.shares: a boy is attached to a charming old rogue whose word is worth nothing

relatives.title: Chimes at Midnight
relatives.shares: a young man's bond to a dissolute old man is weighed against the life waiting elsewhere

relatives.title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
relatives.shares: gold turns partners into men who plan how to leave each other

relatives.title: The Man Who Would Be King
relatives.shares: two adventurers' appetite for a throne outruns what they can hold

relatives.title: Mutiny on the Bounty
relatives.shares: a crew rises against the officer who has sentenced them

films.title: The Best Intentions
films.engine: A poor divinity student and a rich, willful young woman marry over the flat objection of her family, who tell him to his face he is not man enough for her and destroy a letter to keep the two apart. What almost ends the marriage afterwards is not class but his conscience: in a bleak northern parish he refuses to flatter anyone, and she refuses to stay.

predicaments.situation: a match is refused for what someone is
predicaments.basis: Karin Åkerblom tells Henrik plainly he is neither mature nor able to nurture Anna, and the family confirms he is still living with Frida the waitress.

predicaments.situation: elders keep two lovers apart by deception
predicaments.basis: Anna's letter from Switzerland asking to resume with Henrik is opened by her father and burned by her mother; Karin only confesses it after Johan dies.

predicaments.situation: two people marry across a gulf between them
predicaments.basis: The wealthy, stubborn Anna and the poor, austere Henrik marry despite their class conflict and nearly break apart in Forsboda before he asks her to Stockholm.

predicaments.situation: a child taken in is given back up
predicaments.basis: The Bergmans foster the orphan Petrus; Anna insists he be sent away, he overhears it, carries the baby Dag to an icy river, and leaves after Henrik strikes him down.

predicaments.situation: one refuses to flatter those with power
predicaments.basis: Henrik lends his church to a socialist meeting, humiliates the mill owner Nordenson from the pulpit, and tells Queen Victoria that suffering is useless and God looks on the world with horror.

relatives.title: The Heiress
relatives.shares: a family declares a poor suitor unworthy of the daughter's money

relatives.title: The Age of Innocence
relatives.shares: relatives quietly manage letters and visits to keep two people apart

relatives.title: Winter Light
relatives.shares: a clergyman's rigour toward God is paid for by the people nearest him

relatives.title: Diary of a Country Priest
relatives.shares: a young clergyman's conscience turns his own parish against him

relatives.title: Shoplifters
relatives.shares: a household takes in a child not its own and cannot keep hold of them

films.title: Another Woman
films.engine: A philosophy professor over fifty rents a quiet apartment to write and finds she can hear a stranger's therapy sessions through the wall — a woman saying her life feels false and empty. Recognising her own life in it, she goes back through everyone she has been cold to and discovers each of them had been waiting years to tell her so.

predicaments.situation: a stranger's confession is overheard as one's own
predicaments.basis: Through the wall of the sublet Marion hears Hope's despairing sessions with her analyst, and the words about a life that is false start applying to Marion instead.

predicaments.situation: a life is reexamined for where it broke
predicaments.basis: On leave to write a book, Marion instead audits her father's coldness in herself, her first husband's suicide, her second marriage and her missed chance with Larry.

predicaments.situation: those closest were treated with quiet contempt
predicaments.basis: Her brother Paul and his wife Lynn believe she is ashamed of them, her oldest friend Claire feels eclipsed by her, and her stepdaughter Laura resents her high-handedness.

predicaments.situation: a marriage is found empty from the inside
predicaments.basis: Marion admits her second marriage to Ken is unfulfilling and leaves him after catching him in an affair.

predicaments.situation: a woman cannot have the child she wants
predicaments.basis: Talking to Hope in front of the Klimt painting, Marion decides the abortion she had years ago was a mistake and that at her age the child is among the things now closed to her.

relatives.title: Wild Strawberries
relatives.shares: an ageing academic is shown, one relative at a time, how cold he has been

relatives.title: Ikiru
relatives.shares: a life is audited late for what it actually amounted to

relatives.title: The Remains of the Day
relatives.shares: a lifetime of withheld feeling is counted up when it is too late to spend it

relatives.title: 45 Years
relatives.shares: a long marriage is found hollow from the inside

relatives.title: Yi Yi
relatives.shares: each person privately admits the life they are living is not the one they meant

films.title: Black Rain
films.engine: A young woman was caught in the fallout that fell as black rain over Hiroshima, and five years on no family will let their son marry her, in case she sickens or cannot bear healthy children. Her uncle keeps trying to arrange a life for her while their friends die one by one of the same thing, and the film is the long wait to see which of them it takes next.

predicaments.situation: a match is refused for what someone is
predicaments.basis: Every prospect's family withdraws once they hear Yasuko was in Hiroshima on the day of the bomb; her uncle in turn balks at Yuichi because of his war trauma before consenting.

predicaments.situation: everyone waits for a harm already done
predicaments.basis: Yasuko, Shigematsu and Shigeko were all exposed in 1945 and their health declines slowly while his fellow survivors die of radiation sickness one after another.

predicaments.situation: a guardian arranges a future he cannot promise
predicaments.basis: Shigematsu spends years seeking a husband for his niece, finally agrees to Yuichi's mother's request, and then watches the ambulance take Yasuko away as her hair falls out.

predicaments.situation: a household raises a child not its own
predicaments.basis: Half-orphaned Yasuko lives with her uncle, aunt and his mother, and refuses her remarried father's offer of a home with him.

predicaments.situation: two damaged people find each other
predicaments.basis: Yasuko, ill from the fallout, grows close to Yuichi, a neighbour disabled by what the war did to his mind.

relatives.title: Testament
relatives.shares: a household waits out a slow radiation death together, counting the dead around them

relatives.title: Late Spring
relatives.shares: a household presses a marriage on a daughter who would rather stay with them

relatives.title: Philadelphia
relatives.shares: illness makes someone untouchable to people frightened of what he carries

relatives.title: Hiroshima mon amour
relatives.shares: the bombing goes on living inside the body long after the day itself

relatives.title: Grave of the Fireflies
relatives.shares: relatives take in what the war orphaned, and the taking-in has a limit

films.title: Table for Five
films.engine: A father who left his children years ago books a holiday to charm them back, and is still performing the fun stranger when their mother dies and the man who actually raised them arrives to collect them. The trip stops being a courtship and becomes the question of whether a man who cannot name his children's teachers is allowed to take them home.

predicaments.situation: a parent returns to children raised by another
predicaments.basis: J.P. Tannen, an ex-golfer estranged from three children living in New York with their mother and her attorney husband Mitchell, takes them on a Mediterranean cruise to reconnect.

predicaments.situation: a parent offers friendship in place of parenthood
predicaments.basis: Feeling inadequate as a father, Tannen invites the children to call him "J.P." and treat him as a friend, until Trung tells him furiously that he needs a father instead.

predicaments.situation: the bearer of terrible news delays telling it
predicaments.basis: Told at sea that Kathleen has died in a car accident, Tannen insists on being the one to tell the children and asks Mitchell for more time, carrying it through two ports before breaking down at the Pyramids.

predicaments.situation: a child is claimed by two rival fathers
predicaments.basis: Tannen tells Mitchell in a Cairo tavern that he wants full custody; Mitchell counters with his record of absence and threatens to use his legal expertise to ruin him.

predicaments.situation: a child runs away hoping to be pursued
predicaments.basis: At Tunis, Trung takes the first launch ashore meaning to get back to America, and only opens up once Tannen chases him down in the marketplace.

relatives.title: Kramer vs. Kramer
relatives.shares: a parent who was never present has to become the only one, against a rival claim

relatives.title: The Descendants
relatives.shares: a father who left the raising to his wife must tell the children she is dying and take over

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: children left to manage themselves while the adult who should hold them is elsewhere

relatives.title: Aftersun
relatives.shares: a holiday abroad as the only container a distant father has for his child

relatives.title: Shoplifters
relatives.shares: the question of who has earned the right to be called a family's parent

films.title: Good News
films.engine: A man who processes footage of atrocities all day and cannot speak to his wife at night is visited by a schoolfriend who believes unknown people are coming to kill him. The friend is committed, then really is killed, and the man discovers his wife is carrying that friend's child — leaving him the survivor of a life in which everything happened to someone else.

predicaments.situation: a friend reappears convinced he is being hunted
predicaments.basis: Gualtiero, unseen for fifteen years, tells the man that enemies are following him though he cannot say who they are, agrees to be committed, and is then murdered for reasons that stay unclear.

predicaments.situation: a couple lives together unable to speak
predicaments.basis: The man returns each evening to Fedora in a marriage defined by their inability to communicate, while he makes rejected advances to his colleague Tignetti and to Fedora's friend Benedetta.

predicaments.situation: a child turns out to be another man's
predicaments.basis: At Gualtiero's funeral Fedora tells her husband that the child she is carrying is his dead friend's; after an initial fury he agrees with her to keep it.

predicaments.situation: a dying man leaves a message saying nothing
predicaments.basis: An envelope posted by Gualtiero arrives at the office marked "not to be opened"; opened, it contains only a mass of cards printed with the same words.

relatives.title: The Tenant
relatives.shares: a man insisting he is the target of a persecution nobody else can confirm

relatives.title: Caché
relatives.shares: a media worker surrounded by images who cannot register the violence aimed at his own life

relatives.title: Scenes from a Marriage
relatives.shares: two people sharing a home who have lost the ability to say anything true to each other

relatives.title: The Conversation
relatives.shares: a professional handler of other people's catastrophes undone by one that turns out to be his

relatives.title: Three Colours: Blue
relatives.shares: a survivor learning after the death that another woman was carrying the dead man's child

films.title: A Last Note
films.engine: An old actress retreats to her country house for the summer and finds everyone around her quietly closing their accounts: a gardener who kills himself leaving the note "it's over", a senile former colleague who visits to say goodbye before drowning herself with her husband, a housemaid who finally admits she bore the actress's husband a daughter. She ends by asking the maid to keep the gardener's coffin stone for her own.

predicaments.situation: a visit turns out to be a farewell
predicaments.basis: Tomie, a former troupe colleague now losing her memory, arrives with her husband and recites Chekhov with Yoko's help; a journalist later reports that the couple drowned themselves together at Naoetsu.

predicaments.situation: an old betrayal is confessed decades too late
predicaments.basis: After the guests leave, Toyoko tells Yoko that she slept with Yoko's husband Saburo twenty-two years ago while Yoko was on tour; Yoko is indignant, Toyoko walks out, and the two women make it up.

predicaments.situation: a child turns out to be another man's
predicaments.basis: Toyoko's daughter Akemi is revealed to be Saburo's; the two women then attend Akemi's "tentative marriage" ceremony to Daigoro together.

predicaments.situation: the old arrange their own deaths in advance
predicaments.basis: The eighty-three-year-old gardener builds his own coffin and leaves a stone on the lid for nailing it shut; Yoko instructs Toyoko to keep that stone for her own coffin, and Toyoko carries it to the river and throws it in.

relatives.title: Tokyo Story
relatives.shares: the old quietly taking leave while the living carry on around them

relatives.title: 45 Years
relatives.shares: a marriage re-read late in life once a long-hidden other woman surfaces

relatives.title: Amour
relatives.shares: a couple deciding together how their own ending will be managed

relatives.title: Wild Strawberries
relatives.shares: an aged performer revisiting old company and finding the accounts still open

relatives.title: Three Colours: Blue
relatives.shares: a widow told that her dead husband fathered a child by another woman

films.title: Guilty as Sin
films.engine: A lawyer takes a murder case because the accused flatters her belief in her own brilliance, then learns he had been studying her long before his wife died and chose her deliberately. The rules that make her his defender forbid her to say what she knows, so she can only destroy him by breaking herself, and he kills the people around her to prove she has nothing left.

predicaments.situation: a challenge is accepted out of vanity
predicaments.basis: Jennifer Haines first refuses David Greenhill, then tells her partners she wants the high-profile trial because "I am that good."

predicaments.situation: a person is sworn to conceal a crime
predicaments.basis: Once her investigator uncovers Greenhill's history of older women who end up dead, attorney-client privilege forbids Haines to turn him in, and a judge refuses to let her withdraw from the case.

predicaments.situation: someone discovers they were selected long before meeting
predicaments.basis: In the empty courtroom after the mistrial, Greenhill confesses the murder of his wife Rita and tells Haines he had been scouting her well before the case ever reached her.

predicaments.situation: loved ones are punished for another's defiance
predicaments.basis: When Haines has evidence planted at his apartment, Greenhill beats Phil Garson into hospital, then plans her death as a suicide brought on by grief.

predicaments.situation: a man is killed for what he knows
predicaments.basis: Greenhill knocks out the investigator Moe and burns his office down once Moe has dug up the pattern of dead women.

predicaments.situation: an attacker is destroyed by the one attacked
predicaments.basis: Thrown over a railing in her apartment building, Haines drags Greenhill down with her; his body breaks her fall and he dies while she survives badly injured.

relatives.title: Cape Fear
relatives.shares: a lawyer stalked by a man whose claim on them comes out of the professional relationship itself

relatives.title: The Silence of the Lambs
relatives.shares: a killer who selected the professional assigned to him and works on her as the real project

relatives.title: Primal Fear
relatives.shares: a defender learns from the client's own mouth, too late, what they actually did

relatives.title: Blue Steel
relatives.shares: a woman doing her job becomes the fixation of the man she is meant to handle
