relatives.title: Q & A
relatives.shares: a rule of the legal system binding an ambitious lawyer to protect the guilty party

films.title: The Plot of the Fuma Clan
films.engine: A wedding is interrupted when ninja carry off the bride and demand the family heirloom for her, and her grandfather refuses the trade because the object holds the location of the clan's treasure. The groom's thief friends steal the heirloom themselves, so the rescue and the robbery become the same journey — and once she is safe the groom walks away to train, telling her to wait, and she tells him she won't.

predicaments.situation: a hostage is taken to force a trade
predicaments.basis: During the disrupted wedding of Goemon and Murasaki Suminawa, ninja abduct the bride and leave a note offering her in exchange for the family's antique urn.

predicaments.situation: an elder refuses to ransom his own kin
predicaments.basis: Clan Elder Suminawa will not hand over the urn for his granddaughter because it hides the location of the family treasure, so Lupin steals it and makes the exchange without him.

predicaments.situation: an ally turns out to serve the enemy
predicaments.basis: Inspector Kazami, the policeman who talked Zenigata out of retirement, is found among the Fuma ranks working for their Boss, and later holds Murasaki at knifepoint.

predicaments.situation: a rescuer wounds the person being rescued
predicaments.basis: Hallucinogenic gas in the armour hall turns Goemon on his own companions and he injures Murasaki, the woman he came to bring out.

predicaments.situation: a pursuer has no life without the pursued
predicaments.basis: Zenigata has retired to a Buddhist temple believing Lupin dead and says he has "no interest in a world without Lupin", returning to duty the moment he is shown a photograph of him alive.

predicaments.situation: one leaves to become worthy of a marriage
predicaments.basis: With the treasure buried and Murasaki safe, Goemon declares he must train away his weaknesses before he will return to marry her; she calls after him that she won't wait.

relatives.title: The Searchers
relatives.shares: a woman taken by the enemy while her own family weighs what she is worth getting back

relatives.title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
relatives.shares: a fortune that dissolves at the moment of reaching it, with every party racing the others

relatives.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
relatives.shares: a warrior deferring the marriage in front of him for the discipline he thinks he owes first

relatives.title: Ride Lonesome
relatives.shares: a rescue undertaken by people whose real interest lies in the prize behind the hostage

relatives.title: Catch Me If You Can
relatives.shares: a lawman whose existence has narrowed to the one man he chases

films.title: Farewell to Nostradamus
films.engine: A presidential candidate's daughter is snatched by a sect that governs its followers with prophecies it forges, and her father refuses to withdraw from the race for her because a kidnapped child buys him sympathy. The thieves who happened to be on her plane end up being the only people trying to get her back, while the sect's own men turn on each other over the real book locked in her father's vault.

predicaments.situation: a hostage is taken to force a trade
predicaments.basis: Chris seizes Julia from the hijacked plane by helicopter and demands on television that her father Douglas quit the presidential race in exchange for her.

predicaments.situation: an elder refuses to ransom his own kin
predicaments.basis: Douglas rejects the demand outright, reasoning aloud that his daughter's kidnapping will win his campaign sympathy.

predicaments.situation: people are governed by predictions someone invents
predicaments.basis: Rhisley recites verses from a book he presents as Nostradamus's lost prophecies — the real one is in Douglas's vault and his is a fake — timing them to a hijacking and a bombing so his followers see them come true, and he means to rule by it.

predicaments.situation: a follower betrays the leader he serves
predicaments.basis: Chris breaks from Rhisley's plan and enters the Earth Building to take the real prophecies for himself, reaching the vault ahead of everyone.

predicaments.situation: a man is killed for what he knows
predicaments.basis: The sect takes Lupin's Uncle Philip, the only man who ever opened the vault, and extracts the method from him with a machine that kills him.

predicaments.situation: someone is made to forget their own life
predicaments.basis: Fujiko is captured and turned into a sect handmaiden with no memory of herself until Julia cuts off the wristband; the same bands hypnotise the Brazilian football team into planting bombs.

relatives.title: Ransom
relatives.shares: a powerful father who refuses the kidnappers' terms and turns his own child's abduction into leverage

relatives.title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
relatives.shares: a child taken to control what an adult does in public

relatives.title: Wag the Dog
relatives.shares: an invented account of the world staged so convincingly that it governs the people who watch it

relatives.title: The Master
relatives.shares: a movement held together by a leader's fabricated text and the followers who need it true

relatives.title: Total Recall
relatives.shares: a person stripped of their own memory and made to serve the people who took it

films.title: Lupin III: Dead or Alive
films.engine: A general who murdered a king and took his country needs the dead king's son, because the only thing that will open the treasure vault is bound to that surviving boy — so everyone in the film converges on him, wearing each other's faces to get there. A thief arrives as the prince, a policewoman has been living as the general's daughter, and the general's own body turns out to be a borrowed thing too. What the film keeps returning to is people finding out, too late, whose purpose they were actually serving.

predicaments.situation: someone passes as another to get close
predicaments.basis: Lupin walks onto the island disguised as Prince Panish and is handed the key; Olèander lives as "Headhunter's daughter" Emerah while working for the Zufu police, and Fujiko takes a job as a secretary to reach the real Emerah.

predicaments.situation: someone loyally serves the one deceiving them
predicaments.basis: Olèander carries out Headhunter's orders until she learns she has only been his instrument, and the real Emerah obeys him while he lies that her father Dr. Voltsky is dead when he is in fact Headhunter's prisoner.

predicaments.situation: someone is discarded once no longer useful
predicaments.basis: Once Headhunter has what he needs from Olèander he wants her killed alongside Lupin as a piece of "swift justice", and Crisis, his right hand, is left to be torn apart by the nanomachines his master has just taken control of.

predicaments.situation: a killer hunts the last of a family
predicaments.basis: Headhunter took the country by killing its king and must find Prince Panish, the only surviving royal, who is in hiding and is the one person the island's defenses will tolerate.

relatives.title: Kagemusha
relatives.shares: a thief stands in for a ruler and the impersonation is what holds a kingdom's power in place

relatives.title: The Prisoner of Zenda
relatives.shares: an outsider passes as the rightful heir to keep a usurper from what he seized

relatives.title: The Lion King
relatives.shares: a man who killed the king rules while the true heir survives in hiding

relatives.title: The Bad Sleep Well
relatives.shares: someone works faithfully for the man who has been lying to them about a death in their own family

films.title: A Love in Germany
films.engine: A woman running her called-up husband's shop is given a prisoner to work for her, finds she likes that he must obey her, and takes him as a lover in a town where everyone is watching the shop and therefore watching her. Her neighbours' disapproval, and the law of the moment, turn a love affair into an execution — he hangs, she serves two years — and decades later her son and grandson come back to the village to ask what happened and find the man who warned her and then let her fall still living quietly among the people who will not talk.

predicaments.situation: love across a forbidden line is punished
predicaments.basis: Pauline Kropp, a German soldier's wife, takes the Polish prisoner of war Stanisław as her lover in 1941, and the affair is prosecuted as "Rassenschande".

predicaments.situation: two lovers pay unequally for the same act
predicaments.basis: Stanisław is taken to court and sentenced to death for the affair; Pauline is imprisoned for two years and lives on.

predicaments.situation: a community polices what a woman does privately
predicaments.basis: Because her husband's fruit-and-vegetable shop feeds the town under rationing, Pauline's character is treated as everyone's business, and the other soldiers' wives' doubts about her integrity become the pressure that destroys her.

predicaments.situation: the one warning of danger later abandons them
predicaments.basis: The town official repeatedly tells Pauline what the law will do to her and what the women are saying, and then, when it comes, leaves her to it.

predicaments.situation: the young ask the old about buried wrongs
predicaments.basis: Pauline's son and grandson come to the village to find out what happened to her in 1941 and are met with the residents' mistrust — and with the official, still living there.

relatives.title: Hiroshima mon amour
relatives.shares: a woman is punished by her own town for having loved a man from the enemy side

relatives.title: Devils on the Doorstep
relatives.shares: villagers under occupation take an enemy prisoner into their daily life and are destroyed by the intimacy

relatives.title: The Nasty Girl
relatives.shares: someone returns to a town to ask what it did in the war and meets a wall of silence

relatives.title: Black Book
relatives.shares: a woman's love across the occupation line is judged by the community as collaboration

relatives.title: The Reader
relatives.shares: descendants confront what an ordinary woman did and what the law made of it

films.title: A Dangerous Toy
films.engine: A Milanese accountant has spent his life being useful to a rich childhood friend — carrying his cash, fronting his hidden funds — and when a robbery leaves him wounded he is quietly replaced by a harder man. He discovers instead that he is a natural with a pistol, kills a robber, is a hero for about a week, and is then dropped altogether once he has signed what his friend needed signed. What is left is a man with a gun, a family that mocks him, and a wife dying in the next room who is the only thing standing between him and what he means to do about it.

predicaments.situation: someone loyally serves the one deceiving them
predicaments.basis: Vittorio Barletta carries security for the industrialist Nicola Griffo and serves as cover for his black funds on the strength of a childhood friendship.

predicaments.situation: someone is discarded once no longer useful
predicaments.basis: Wounded in the supermarket robbery, Vittorio is replaced as carrier by a former carabinieri marshal, then fired outright by Nicola after being made to sign the sale of a phantom company.

predicaments.situation: a mild man discovers a talent for killing
predicaments.basis: Through his friendship with the police agent Sauro Civera, the accountant finds he can shoot, wins competitions, kills the convict who has just shot Sauro, and later wounds men who ambush him.

predicaments.situation: public praise leaves the praised no better off
predicaments.basis: TV and the press make Vittorio a hero for killing the bandit, the noise dies down quickly, and it brings in no money while Ada's illness worsens.

predicaments.situation: the dying restrain the living from vengeance
predicaments.basis: When Vittorio finally sets out to humiliate the Griffos, his dying wife Ada is determined to stop him.

relatives.title: Death Wish
relatives.shares: an unremarkable city man finds out he can shoot people and that it changes what he is

relatives.title: Falling Down
relatives.shares: a discarded office man with a weapon works his way toward the people he holds responsible

relatives.title: The Servant
relatives.shares: a friendship that is really one man's long use of another, ended when the use runs out

relatives.title: Wall Street
relatives.shares: a patron drops the man who did his dirty carrying the moment the paperwork is signed

films.title: Thunderheart
films.engine: An FBI agent is picked for a reservation murder case because he has Sioux blood the Bureau thinks will open doors, and he arrives as the instrument of the men who sent him. Following the evidence his partner keeps waving away, he finds that the killing, the informer who did it, and the feud between the council's militia and the activists were all arranged from his own side to keep a uranium lease quiet. The case ends with him belonging to the people he was sent to investigate and no longer to the agency that sent him.

predicaments.situation: those asked to find the guilty are guilty
predicaments.basis: Agent Frank Coutelle, running the investigation into Leo Fast Elk's murder, turns out to have blackmailed the killer Richard Yellow Hawk into it and steered the case toward Jimmy Looks Twice; Ray's recording of the confession implicates him.

predicaments.situation: an outsider among strangers comes to belong
predicaments.basis: Ray Levoi arrives on the reservation as an FBI man embarrassed by his mixed heritage, is taught by Walter Crow Horse and Grandpa Sam Reaches, dreams Wounded Knee, is named Thunderheart, and leaves the Bureau.

predicaments.situation: someone loyally serves the one deceiving them
predicaments.basis: Ray takes Frank's direction and Frank's suspect list as good faith, chasing Jimmy while the man giving him orders is concealing his own part in the murder.

predicaments.situation: someone is discarded once no longer useful
predicaments.basis: Richard Yellow Hawk, blackmailed with a return to prison and used to stir up the ARM, is found dead with his wrists slit to look like suicide once he has confessed.

predicaments.situation: neighbours are set against each other by outsiders
predicaments.basis: Jack Milton's hired militia and the ARM are pushed into shooting at each other — a boy is shot and blamed on the activists — while the tension itself is manufactured to cover the mining.

predicaments.situation: outsiders take wealth from land others live on
predicaments.basis: A government-sponsored plan strip-mines uranium on the reservation, poisoning the water Maggie Eagle Bear was asking questions about, with Milton taking kickbacks on leases for land he does not own.

relatives.title: Chinatown
relatives.shares: the investigation leads back to the people who commissioned it, over water and land

relatives.title: Dances with Wolves
relatives.shares: a man sent out by his own institution ends up belonging to the people he was sent among

relatives.title: Z
relatives.shares: a killing is dressed up as something else by the state agents nominally investigating it

relatives.title: Erin Brockovich
relatives.shares: a poisoned water supply traced back to those profiting from the land

relatives.title: The Wind That Shakes the Barley
relatives.shares: a community turned against itself by an outside power's arrangements

films.title: It Takes Two
films.engine: A man about to marry the woman he has known his whole life panics — not at her, but at the life being assembled around him by everyone else — and spends the days before the wedding chasing a fake sports car and the woman who sold it to him. She sells him a lemon and then, once she is fired and he has missed the rehearsal dinner, helps him steal back what he paid for. The bride, standing jilted in front of the congregation, works out that she stopped listening to him, which is the thing that has to be said before he can come back.

predicaments.situation: someone about to marry is drawn elsewhere
predicaments.basis: Travis Rogers, engaged to Stephi Lawrence since childhood, misses the rehearsal dinner, sleeps with the saleswoman Jonni Tigersmith, and phones his father to say he is in love with her.

predicaments.situation: one partner stops listening to the other
predicaments.basis: Left at the altar, Stephi tells the congregation how she lost her childhood pony by not paying attention and leaving the gate open, and says that is what she did with Travis's worries.

predicaments.situation: others decide what work a person should do
predicaments.basis: Travis's future father-in-law tries to force him into the manure business and his coworkers talk down the marriage; he ends up choosing the ranch with his own father.

predicaments.situation: the cheat returns to undo the harm
predicaments.basis: Jonni talked Travis into a loaded imitation Lamborghini without the warranty, then — fired after finding her boss Dave was fitting inferior parts — breaks into the showroom with him and the mechanic Wheel and leaves a paid-in-full receipt in the car.

predicaments.situation: a parent confesses an old failing
predicaments.basis: Travis's father talks him out of his declaration of love by telling him about his own dalliance before his own wedding.

relatives.title: The Graduate
relatives.shares: a wedding held up by someone who cannot say what he wants until the last possible moment

relatives.title: It Happened One Night
relatives.shares: a person flees toward the altar by way of a stranger who turns out to have done them a favour

relatives.title: Muriel's Wedding
relatives.shares: someone chases a fantasy of a life and has to be shown what the real one was offering

relatives.title: The Philadelphia Story
relatives.shares: cold feet before a wedding resolved by the couple finally hearing each other out loud, in company

films.title: Doc Hollywood
films.engine: A newly qualified doctor driving to a lucrative cosmetic-surgery job crashes into a judge's fence and is sentenced to work off the damage in the small town's clinic, where the mayor wants to keep him, the retiring old doctor wants to dismiss him, and a woman with a small daughter wants him and won't say so. Everyone in his life — colleagues, the town, and finally she herself — has a position on what he ought to be doing with himself, and hers is that staying there would waste him. She lies about being engaged to push him out, and he goes, and has to find out for himself that the life he was driving toward is not one he can live in.

predicaments.situation: an outsider among strangers comes to belong
predicaments.basis: Ben Stone is held in Grady, South Carolina by 32 hours of court-ordered service at the town clinic, treats its patients, delivers a baby by the reservoir, and after a few weeks in Beverly Hills comes back for good.

predicaments.situation: others decide what work a person should do
predicaments.basis: Ben's Washington colleagues say plastic surgery is wasting his life, the mayor's committee wants to install him as Dr. Hogue's replacement, and Lou pushes him toward Los Angeles because she thinks a small town would waste his talents.

predicaments.situation: love is concealed to free the other
predicaments.basis: After their night together, Lou hides her feelings and tells Ben she is marrying Hank so he will take the plane ticket the town bought him.

predicaments.situation: someone about to marry is drawn elsewhere
predicaments.basis: Lou is being courted by the insurance agent Hank Gordon and becomes engaged to him while spending an intimate evening with Ben; Hank later tells Ben the engagement is off.

predicaments.situation: the old make way for the young
predicaments.basis: Dr. Hogue, planning to retire and dismissive of Ben as too young and inexperienced, changes his mind after Ben saves him from a heart attack and privately telephones Halberstrom on his behalf.

relatives.title: Local Hero
relatives.shares: a man passing through on business for a bigger life is quietly claimed by a small place

relatives.title: Welcome to the Sticks
relatives.shares: someone dreading a posting to a provincial town finds he belongs there more than where he came from

relatives.title: Cars
relatives.shares: a driver bound for a glamorous career is sentenced to work off damage in a small town and stays

relatives.title: Casablanca
relatives.shares: one person hides what they feel and lies about a marriage so the other will get on the plane

films.title: Goopy Bagha Phire Elo
films.engine: Two old friends who won a kingdom find that comfort has stopped their lives, and go looking for the danger they used to live in. What they find is a man who trades on their gift — he will pay them in youth if they steal for him — and who is quietly killing children because he has been told a child will be the end of him. The film is about what old men will do to feel young again, and what a powerful man will do to make sure no one comes after him.

predicaments.situation: the old chase what age has taken
predicaments.basis: Goopy and Bagha, bored of royal luxury in Shundi, leave to find the adventuring life again and accept a stranger's offer to make them twenty years younger.

predicaments.situation: payment is refused after the work is done
predicaments.basis: Brahmananda Acharya promises Goopy and Bagha twenty years of youth for stealing three rare stones, knowing he cannot make anyone younger.

predicaments.situation: a child is feared by those in power
predicaments.basis: Told a twelve-year-old named Bikram will destroy him, Brahmananda has every boy of that name in Anandapur seized and hypnotised into service.

predicaments.situation: a man is answerable to no one
predicaments.basis: Brahmananda's accumulated powers make him immune even to Goopy's paralysing song, and his soldiers take children out of the town without consequence.

predicaments.situation: the hunted becomes the hunter
predicaments.basis: The one boy who escapes hypnosis walks into Anandagarh fort himself, and the man who hunted him sinks into the ground at his approach.

relatives.title: The Night of the Hunter
relatives.shares: a powerful adult hunting children who hold his undoing

relatives.title: Ikiru
relatives.shares: a man in comfortable office life realising he has not been living

relatives.title: The Straight Story
relatives.shares: the old setting out for something age is supposed to have closed off

relatives.title: Faust
relatives.shares: a bargain for restored youth offered by someone who cannot deliver it

relatives.title: Pan's Labyrinth
relatives.shares: a child whose ordinary powerlessness turns out to be the thing that ends the tyrant

films.title: Someone's Watching Me!
films.engine: A woman moves to a city where she knows nobody and is watched, called and furnished with gifts by a man she cannot see — and everyone she reports it to explains that nothing punishable has happened yet. The film is about what it does to a person to be the only one who believes she is in danger, and about the point where she stops asking to be protected and goes to find him herself.

predicaments.situation: a stranger watches someone unable to see him
predicaments.basis: Leigh Michaels, newly arrived in Los Angeles, is phoned at work, has her apartment bugged and is sent a telescope and a swimsuit by a man watching from another building.

predicaments.situation: those meant to protect refuse to act
predicaments.basis: Officer Gary Hunt tells Leigh the caller has committed no crime, and after Sophie vanishes the police explain the disappearance away rather than investigate.

predicaments.situation: the wrong person is punished for another's act
predicaments.basis: A man from Iowa is arrested for harassment on the strength of Leigh's telescope sighting, denies everything and leaves the state, while the letters keep coming.

predicaments.situation: a disappearance is treated as a departure
predicaments.basis: Leigh sees Sophie attacked in her apartment, but police find a booked flight to Fort Worth and assume she simply left Los Angeles.

predicaments.situation: the hunted becomes the hunter
predicaments.basis: Leigh breaks into Herbert Stiles's house, finds his surveillance equipment, and when he attacks her on her own balcony she stabs him with broken glass and he goes over the rail.

relatives.title: The Vanishing
relatives.shares: an ordinary-seeming man's private project of watching and taking someone

relatives.title: Cure
relatives.shares: authorities who cannot classify a danger and therefore do nothing about it

relatives.title: Repulsion
relatives.shares: a woman alone in a flat whose fear no one around her will credit

relatives.title: A Girl Walks Home Alone at Night
relatives.shares: the watched woman turning and becoming the thing to be afraid of

relatives.title: Blow-Up
relatives.shares: someone certain a crime happened, holding evidence no institution will accept

films.title: Il Marchese del Grillo
films.engine: A Roman nobleman spends his days demonstrating that nothing he does to poorer people can be made to cost him anything — he refuses a debt, buys the verdict when he is sued, and treats the collapse of the state he is supposed to defend as an interruption to a love affair. Then he dresses a drunk who looks exactly like him in his own clothes, and the joke runs long enough that the poor man is nearly executed in his place and the film's one authority above him arranges to make him the victim of the same trick.

predicaments.situation: a man is answerable to no one
predicaments.basis: Onofrio del Grillo, a favourite of Pope Pius VII, plays pranks on the poor without fear, and when arrested tells the crowd his nobility lets him do as he likes because they are worth nothing.

predicaments.situation: payment is refused after the work is done
predicaments.basis: Onofrio refuses to pay the Jewish tradesman Aronne Piperno what he is owed, arguing that a Jew is a murderer of Jesus.

predicaments.situation: justice is sold to the stronger side
predicaments.basis: Piperno takes the debt to court and loses because Onofrio buys the judges and cardinals, after which Onofrio tells the Pope that justice has died in his States.

predicaments.situation: one man is put in another's place
predicaments.basis: Onofrio has a drunken coalman who is his double dressed in his clothes and put in his bed while he lives as Gasperino, and the household decides the marquis is possessed.

predicaments.situation: the wrong person is punished for another's act
predicaments.basis: When the Pope returns after Napoleon's defeat and condemns Onofrio, it is Gasperino in the marquis's clothes who is taken to the guillotine.

predicaments.situation: a trickster is tricked by a greater power
predicaments.basis: The execution is halted at the last moment on the Pope's order, who staged the whole condemnation to play a joke on Onofrio for once.

relatives.title: The Prince and the Pauper
relatives.shares: a rich man and a poor double swapped, the poor one left holding the danger

relatives.title: Kagemusha
relatives.shares: a lowly man dressed as his lord and made to live the lord's exposure

relatives.title: The Rules of the Game
relatives.shares: a class that treats consequences as something other people have

relatives.title: The Merchant of Venice
relatives.shares: a court that finds against the creditor because of what he is

relatives.title: Being There
relatives.shares: a household reading a man's wrong manners as a higher kind of meaning

films.title: City Hall
films.engine: A boy is killed by a stray bullet in a shootout between a detective and a dealer who should have been in prison, and the mayor's deputy — a man who loves his boss and believes in the work — starts asking why the dealer was free. Every answer is a favour someone did for someone, and the chain of favours ends at the mentor he has organised his life around. The film is about the moment loyalty and knowing the truth stop being the same thing.

predicaments.situation: a favour granted in private kills a stranger
predicaments.basis: A suppressed probation report kept Tino Zapatti out of prison, so he was on a Brooklyn corner to shoot Detective Santos and a six-year-old boy.

predicaments.situation: someone learns what the man he trusted did
predicaments.basis: Deputy mayor Kevin Calhoun traces the bribed judgeship back to Mayor Pappas, who facilitated it, and tells the mentor he idolised that he has to resign.

predicaments.situation: justice is sold to the stronger side
predicaments.basis: Judge Walter Stern owed his seat to a bribe paid by Frank Anselmo on the Zapattis' behalf, in exchange for keeping Tino out of jail.

predicaments.situation: the dead are blamed to protect the living
predicaments.basis: Anselmo pressures Internal Affairs to paint the decorated, dead Santos as a dirty cop and plants money on him, leaving lawyer Marybeth Cogan to defend a man who cannot speak.

predicaments.situation: a man dies to keep his family safe
predicaments.basis: Implicated and likely to turn informant, Anselmo is instructed by Paul Zapatti to kill himself, and shoots himself to protect his family.

relatives.title: Z
relatives.shares: one death pulled at until it unravels the men running the place

relatives.title: Le Confessioni / Il Divo
relatives.shares: a political intimate discovering the arrangement he has been serving

relatives.title: Serpico
relatives.shares: an insider whose loyalty to the institution becomes incompatible with the truth

relatives.title: A Prophet
relatives.shares: a protégé who ends by removing the man who made him

relatives.title: Nayakan
relatives.shares: favours between a boss and a criminal family paid for by a bystander's death

films.title: Where Are You Going on Holiday?
films.engine: Three holidays in which people put themselves in the hands of others and come back diminished: a man near fifty tries to restart a love affair and finds himself in a house full of young people whose lives he cannot join; a guide with a false name lets rich clients buy him into their private business until it kills one of them and pays him nothing; and two shopkeepers let their educated sons decide what a holiday should be, then return to a home that has been redecorated to somebody else's taste.

predicaments.situation: the old chase what age has taken
predicaments.basis: Enrico, on the threshold of fifty, wins his ex-girlfriend Giuliana back only to find her villa full of young friends whose evenings he is alien to, and he fails in bed with her.

predicaments.situation: a man hides where he comes from
predicaments.basis: Arturo works as a tour guide under the name "Wilson" to conceal that he is Italian from the clients of a cheap travel agency.

predicaments.situation: a wife hires someone to kill her husband
predicaments.basis: Colombi's wife tries to talk Wilson into shooting her husband during the illegal lion hunt and dressing it as an accident, for a share of the insurance.

predicaments.situation: payment is refused after the work is done
predicaments.basis: Colombi dies as promised, but Wilson ends with neither the insurance share nor the bribe he had already been paid to arrange the hunt.

predicaments.situation: a man confesses to the wrong listener
predicaments.basis: Drunk, Wilson tells the whole story to a well-mannered gentleman who turns out to be the insurance agent investigating Colombi's death.

predicaments.situation: children decide what is good for their parents
predicaments.basis: Remo and Augusta's three sons send the greengrocers on a cultural tour of necropolises, museums and the Venice Biennale, none of which they want or understand.

predicaments.situation: they return to a home made strange
predicaments.basis: Fed up, Remo and Augusta go back to their old life and find their furniture replaced with modern pieces, and accept the loss.

relatives.title: Tokyo Story
relatives.shares: grown children arranging their parents' time in a way that excludes them

relatives.title: Death in Venice
relatives.shares: an aging man reaching toward a youth he cannot enter

relatives.title: The Servant
relatives.shares: a hired man drawn into his employers' private appetites and ruined by them

relatives.title: Le Salaire de la peur
relatives.shares: dangerous work done for rich strangers on a promise of payment that evaporates

relatives.title: Ali: Fear Eats the Soul
relatives.shares: a man working under a false identity to be acceptable to those he serves

films.title: Let's Hope It's a Girl
films.engine: A separated countess running a crumbling Tuscan villa refuses her indebted husband money for one more scheme; he drives off a cliff the same day, and her daughters hold her responsible. She resolves to sell the house and disperse the household — and then, one by one, every woman in it is failed by the man she had left for and comes back, so the house nobody wanted becomes the only thing that holds.

predicaments.situation: a refusal is blamed for a death
predicaments.basis: Elena refuses Leonardo the large sum he needs for his spa project because of his failed ventures; he backs his car off a cliff the next day, and Franca and Malvina blame her for it.

predicaments.situation: debts of the dead fall on the living
predicaments.basis: Leonardo dies riddled with debts, and Elena intends to sell the family villa to pay them, including what he owed his young mistress Lori Samuelli.

predicaments.situation: women return home after the men fail them
predicaments.basis: Fosca learns her emigrated husband has another family in Australia, Franca leaves Mario while pregnant, and Claudia ends her affair with the married Cesare — all of them coming back to the villa.

predicaments.situation: the old are put away by their families
predicaments.basis: Elena and Nardoni trick senile Uncle Gugo into a retirement home, and he escapes one night and walks back to the villa.

predicaments.situation: a man loves someone unwilling to have him
predicaments.basis: The farmer Nardoni, long in love with Elena, offers to buy the villa and marry her so she can stay; she takes the offer for the property only.

predicaments.situation: a wife takes in her husband's mistress
predicaments.basis: When Lori comes to the villa to collect what Leonardo owed her, Elena tells her she will not sell but will repay her, and invites her to stay.

relatives.title: The Cherry Orchard
relatives.shares: a family estate about to be sold to cover a man's debts

relatives.title: Volver
relatives.shares: a household of women closing around itself once the men are gone or dead

relatives.title: Fanny and Alexander
relatives.shares: a large decaying house holding a family that keeps returning to it

relatives.title: Tokyo Story
relatives.shares: an old relative quietly moved out of the way by the family

relatives.title: How to Make an American Quilt
relatives.shares: women coming back from failed men to the house that raised them

films.title: A Confucian Confusion
films.engine: A woman's fiancé hands her a company to run as a way of binding her to him, and when it fails he expects to collect both. Around that arrangement, every friendship in the circle turns out to be owned by someone — a job, a debt, a favour — so that nobody can tell whether the warmth being shown them is real, and the people accused of faking it are mostly the ones who are not.

predicaments.situation: a gift is given to create obligation
predicaments.basis: Akeem, prompted by his friend and auditor Larry, gives Molly a small entertainment company to manage as part of a plan to force her into marriage once it collapses.

predicaments.situation: someone is asked to choose between two loyalties
predicaments.basis: Ming pushes Qiqi to take the better-paid job his aunt found and leave Molly, then demands outright that she choose between him and her friend.

predicaments.situation: a trusted helper wants the thing he guards
predicaments.basis: Larry audits Akeem's company, manages his engagement and promises to find Molly's secret lover while pursuing Molly himself.

predicaments.situation: a person's kindness is read as pretence
predicaments.basis: Qiqi is told by both Ming and the author that her cheerfulness is a performance, and the author's own novel is about a sincere man taken for a charlatan.

predicaments.situation: a lover is shown false proof of betrayal
predicaments.basis: Larry names Birdy as Molly's secret lover; Akeem attacks him and only later, watching them argue in the street, realises they could not be having an affair.

predicaments.situation: someone is chosen as a replacement for another
predicaments.basis: Molly was betrothed to Akeem only after her sister, originally promised to him, fell in love with the author instead.

relatives.title: The Rules of the Game
relatives.shares: a closed circle whose loves and livelihoods are all owed to one another, so no declaration can be taken at face value

relatives.title: The Apartment
relatives.shares: a person whose job and whose love are both held by the same man

relatives.title: Early Summer
relatives.shares: a marriage arranged around family convenience, with one daughter standing in for the match another refused

relatives.title: Husbands and Wives
relatives.shares: a writer withdraws into darker work and the marriage decays around the withdrawal

relatives.title: Il Sorpasso
relatives.shares: a friend's help turns out to be a design on what the friend has

films.title: Days of Thunder
films.engine: A driver who is fast but cannot say what his car is doing is put together with a builder who quit the sport after a driver died, and neither can win until the younger admits he does not understand the machine and the older agrees to build for a man who might die in it. The team owner, meanwhile, treats drivers as interchangeable, and hires a fresh one the moment the first is hurt.

predicaments.situation: an elder teaches a young one his craft
predicaments.basis: Harry Hogge is brought out of retirement to build for Cole Trickle and puts him through rigorous training until he can read and talk about a stock car.

predicaments.situation: a man conceals how little he understands
predicaments.basis: Cole crashes and blows engines through four races before confessing to Harry that he does not know any of the terminology his crew uses.

predicaments.situation: rivals become friends after they are both hurt
predicaments.basis: Cole and Rowdy Burns, who have been wrecking each other all season, are seriously injured in the same crash and afterwards settle it over dinner and a demolition race on the beach.

predicaments.situation: someone is chosen as a replacement for another
predicaments.basis: While Cole recovers, Daland hires Russ Wheeler to fill his seat and then keeps both cars, defending the new man against the old one.

predicaments.situation: a backer abandons the one he raised up
predicaments.basis: Daland, who recruited Cole out of sprint cars, offers him no help against Russ and fires both him and Harry after the North Wilkesboro brawl — then supplies the engine that wins Daytona.

relatives.title: The Color of Money
relatives.shares: a man who left the game returns to school a fast young talent who has everything but understanding

relatives.title: Whiplash
relatives.shares: an older man's drilling is the only route to the younger one's craft

relatives.title: Ford v Ferrari
relatives.shares: a driver and a builder against an owner who treats men as interchangeable parts

relatives.title: Yojimbo
relatives.shares: two who have tried hardest to destroy each other end up the only pair who understand one another

relatives.title: Million Dollar Baby
relatives.shares: a trainer who quit after a fighter was hurt agrees to build another one anyway

films.title: Bad Company
films.engine: A man is blackmailed into informing on the firm that has just hired him, and the woman inside who takes him to bed is running the same play on her own boss — using him to commit her murder and then dropping him. Everyone in the arrangement makes everyone else sign or record something, so the whole thing is held together by mutual proof, and the only person left standing is the mistress nobody bothered to count.

predicaments.situation: someone is blackmailed into betraying his companions
predicaments.basis: Crowe's former agency boss Smitty threatens him with prison over a missing bribe unless he infiltrates the Toolshed so the CIA can take it over.

predicaments.situation: a trusted helper wants the thing he guards
predicaments.basis: Margaret Wells, Grimes' second in command, recruits Crowe into a plan to murder Grimes and take the firm for herself.

predicaments.situation: one takes a lover only to use them
predicaments.basis: Wells seduces Crowe to get him to pull the trigger on Grimes, then rebuffs him once they hold the firm together.

predicaments.situation: a purchased promise is not kept
predicaments.basis: Justice Beach takes the million-dollar bribe, signs a receipt for it, sends the money ahead with his mistress, then votes against Curl Industries and kills himself.

predicaments.situation: the one nobody counted outlives everyone
predicaments.basis: Julie, treated throughout as the judge's accessory, walks into the shootout that kills Wells and Crowe, leaves with the briefcase, burns her own receipt and mails the tape to the U.S. Attorney.

relatives.title: Double Indemnity
relatives.shares: a man is drawn into a killing by a woman who wanted it done and has no further use for him

relatives.title: Infernal Affairs
relatives.shares: a man forced to live inside an organisation while informing on it, with proof of his own status the thing that can kill him

relatives.title: The Bad Sleep Well
relatives.shares: a firm whose business is corruption, held together by who holds what evidence on whom

relatives.title: The Last Seduction
relatives.shares: a lover recruited for a crime and dropped the moment the crime pays

relatives.title: Sweet Smell of Success
relatives.shares: favours and debts traded until every person in the arrangement is owned by another

films.title: Krull
films.engine: A wedding meant to join two kingdoms is broken up by an invader who carries off the bride and then presses her to marry him instead, offering peace as the price. The groom crosses the country with strangers and an old man to reach her, and what finally kills the invader is the vow the two of them never got to finish saying.

predicaments.situation: a wedding is broken off by an attack
predicaments.basis: Slayers strike before Colwyn and Lyssa's ceremony is completed, destroying both armies, wounding him and carrying her away.

predicaments.situation: a captor courts the woman he has taken
predicaments.basis: The Beast holds Lyssa in the Black Fortress and presses her to marry him, offering to halt the Slayers' attacks in exchange.

predicaments.situation: a lover is shown false proof of betrayal
predicaments.basis: A changeling is sent to seduce Colwyn and the Beast gives Lyssa a vision of it, meaning to convince her he does not love her; he refuses and she affirms the opposite.

predicaments.situation: estranged lovers meet over the child they lost
predicaments.basis: Ynyr goes to the Widow of the Web, who loved him long ago and was exiled to the Crystal Spider's lair for murdering their only child, and asks her where the Fortress will appear.

predicaments.situation: the old give their lives for the young
predicaments.basis: Ynyr spends the last of the Widow's sand to reach the group with the location and dies as he speaks it; Rell holds the closing doors open long enough for the others to get inside.

predicaments.situation: strangers join a doomed errand not their own
predicaments.basis: A magician, nine thieves and fighters and a cyclops attach themselves to Colwyn's march on the Fortress, and most of them are killed on it.

relatives.title: Sita Sings the Blues
relatives.shares: a wife carried off by an inhuman king who courts her while her husband gathers strangers to cross the world for her

relatives.title: The Searchers
relatives.shares: a woman taken in a raid and a years-long march by the men who mean to get her back

relatives.title: Seven Samurai
relatives.shares: a band of strangers with nothing at stake attaches itself to someone else's fight and is spent doing it

relatives.title: Excalibur
relatives.shares: an old counsellor who knows the prophecy dies clearing the way, and a marriage carries the fate of the land

relatives.title: Star Wars
relatives.shares: the elder gives his life inside the enemy's fortress so the young can reach the person held there

films.title: The Goonies
films.engine: A handful of kids whose parents are days from losing their houses go after a pirate's treasure on what everyone has agreed is their last weekend as neighbours — a children's errand undertaken because the adults' version of it has already failed. Along the way the one they all treat as a liar is the one who tells the truth, and the boy who leaves the treasure on the scales is the reason there is any left.

predicaments.situation: children act to save what adults are losing
predicaments.basis: With foreclosure papers about to be signed on the Goon Docks, Mikey and his friends take the map from the attic and go after One-Eyed Willy's treasure as their last chance to keep their homes.

predicaments.situation: a captive befriends the one holding him
predicaments.basis: Chunk, abducted and interrogated by the Fratellis, is left chained up with their deformed brother Sloth, who frees them both and joins him.

predicaments.situation: the truth from a known liar is dismissed
predicaments.basis: Chunk reaches the sheriff with an accurate account of the Fratellis and the tunnels and is waved off as telling another of his tall tales.

predicaments.situation: taking more than the share costs everything
predicaments.basis: Mikey warns the others to leave the jewels on the scales as tribute; the Fratellis grab them anyway and trigger the last booby trap that collapses the grotto.

predicaments.situation: an outcast is taken in as family
predicaments.basis: The Goonies block the police from arresting Sloth, and Chunk invites him to come live with him.

relatives.title: Stand by Me
relatives.shares: a last stretch of boyhood spent on a trek nobody's parents know about

relatives.title: Treasure Island
relatives.shares: a boy after a dead pirate's hoard with grown criminals a step behind him

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a household about to lose its footing and a child bound into the search that might save it

relatives.title: Frankenstein
relatives.shares: the monstrous outcast is only ever gentle with the one person who does not run from him

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: children left to hold together what the adults have let go of

films.title: 1492 – Conquest of Paradise
films.engine: A man gets his voyage funded by promising a queen gold he cannot guarantee, and spends the rest of his life owing that promise to people who never sailed. Having arrived, he cannot govern men who resent taking orders from someone beneath their birth, cannot stop what they do to the people already living there, and is sent home in irons while the discovery ends up filed under another man's name.

predicaments.situation: a purchased promise is not kept
predicaments.basis: Isabella funds the voyage in exchange for Columbus's undertaking to bring back sufficient gold; he returns with a small amount and the council at dinner tells him so.

predicaments.situation: those led turn against the one leading them
predicaments.basis: Nine weeks out with no land the crew edges toward mutiny, and years later the settlers under Moxica burn Columbus's house and fight his faction openly.

predicaments.situation: the wellborn refuse to obey an upstart
predicaments.basis: The aristocrat Moxica will not accept Columbus's authority or his handing of posts to friends and family, leads a revolt and kills himself rather than be taken.

predicaments.situation: a leader cannot stop his own men's cruelty
predicaments.basis: Moxica cuts off the hand of a native who brings no gold; word spreads, the tribes vanish into the forest and the island goes to war.

predicaments.situation: a backer abandons the one he raised up
predicaments.basis: The crown strips Columbus of the governorship, replaces him with de Bobadilla, and grants a last voyage only on condition he take no brothers and never touch the colonies.

predicaments.situation: the work is remembered under another name
predicaments.basis: Columbus ends up forgotten in Spain with the New World credited to Amerigo Vespucci, dictating his own account to his son Ferdinand.

relatives.title: Aguirre, the Wrath of God
relatives.shares: an expedition sold on promised riches that turns on the man commanding it

relatives.title: Mutiny on the Bounty
relatives.shares: a long crossing where the crew stops obeying the man who told them what the voyage would cost

relatives.title: The Mission
relatives.shares: men who came with authority find they cannot stop what their own countrymen do to the people already there

relatives.title: Lawrence of Arabia
relatives.shares: a man who opens a country for others is taken off the work and watches the credit settle elsewhere

relatives.title: Barry Lyndon
relatives.shares: a man of low birth is never forgiven the position he was given, and the wellborn take it back

films.title: Tasmania Story
films.engine: A sixth-grade boy whose mother is dead sets out on his own to reach the father who left after the divorce, following him from one country to another until he finds a man who has quit his old career and remade himself somewhere wild. The film is about whether the boy can be admitted into the life his father built without him, and whether a father who behaves like a child can be a father to a son who has had to grow up.

predicaments.situation: a child travels far to find a parent
predicaments.basis: Shoichi uses his last spring break as a sixth grader to go looking for Eiji, flying to Sydney on the last address he had and then continuing to Tasmania when he learns his father has moved on.

predicaments.situation: a child faces a parent grown unfamiliar
predicaments.basis: When Shoichi finally reaches Eiji he cannot read his father's intentions, and only opens up to him after time spent together in the Tasmanian wilderness.

predicaments.situation: a parent's work competes with a returning child
predicaments.basis: Eiji has to weigh renewing his bond with his son against his conservation campaigning and his fixation on finding the Tasmanian tiger.

predicaments.situation: two children make their way without any adults
predicaments.basis: Shoichi meets Minoru, a runaway boy, in Sydney, and the two travel together to the southern island.

predicaments.situation: a man turns against those he once served
predicaments.basis: Eiji has broken with the Japanese trading company that employed him and now opposes its ecologically damaging practices from the island it operates on.

relatives.title: Central Station
relatives.shares: a child crosses a continent to reach the absent father he has never met

relatives.title: Kikujiro
relatives.shares: a child sets out alone to find the parent who is not there, and picks up an unlikely travelling companion

relatives.title: Alice in the Cities
relatives.shares: a child and a drifting adult travel together while a missing parent is searched for

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: children make their own way with no adult in charge of them

relatives.title: The Kid with a Bike
relatives.shares: a boy pursues a father who has quietly built a life without room for him

films.title: Trois places pour le 26
films.engine: A performer comes back to the city he grew up in to put his own life on a stage, and while rehearsing it goes looking for the woman he loved before he was anyone. The young admirer he lets into the show, and then into his bed, turns out to be the daughter that first love never told him she had — so the past he was staging turns out to have produced a living person standing in front of him.

predicaments.situation: old lovers meet again after many years apart
predicaments.basis: Yves telephones the baroness who left a card at his hotel, recognises Mylène's voice, and they meet tenderly in the bar where they first met decades earlier.

predicaments.situation: two people meet without knowing they are kin
predicaments.basis: Marion approaches Yves in his dressing room as a fan asking for three opening-night seats, and neither of them knows he is her father.

predicaments.situation: two lovers discover they are close kin
predicaments.basis: Yves and Marion spend the night together after the opening, and over breakfast his account of his lost love matches her own mother.

predicaments.situation: a child learns a parent kept something hidden
predicaments.basis: Marion works out that the mother she lives with never told her, or Yves, who her father was.

predicaments.situation: a newcomer is handed the place of another
predicaments.basis: When the leading lady leaves the cast because she is pregnant, Marion — trained in acting, song and dance but working in a perfume shop — volunteers and gets the part.

relatives.title: Secrets & Lies
relatives.shares: a parent and a grown child meet as strangers before either knows what they are to the other

relatives.title: Oldboy
relatives.shares: two people become lovers and then discover they are parent and child

relatives.title: Mamma Mia!
relatives.shares: a daughter's paternity, kept from her by her mother, is uncovered in the middle of a celebration

relatives.title: All About Eve
relatives.shares: an unknown admirer talks her way into a company and takes the leading part

relatives.title: Chinatown
relatives.shares: a woman's long-hidden parentage is the fact everything has been arranged around

films.title: Death of a Salesman
films.engine: A travelling salesman who staked his whole life on the belief that being liked pays off comes home unable to keep his memories separate from the room he is standing in, still waiting for his elder son to become the great man he promised. The son stopped believing in him years ago, in a hotel room where he found his father with another woman, and the film runs on a father who needs his son to be exceptional and a son begging to be accepted as ordinary.

predicaments.situation: a father cannot accept his son's ordinariness
predicaments.basis: Willy insists Biff is destined for something great and that he himself is "not a dime a dozen", while Biff tries to make him see that they are both nothing special.

predicaments.situation: a child learns a parent kept something hidden
predicaments.basis: Biff travels to Boston to ask his father for help after flunking maths and finds him in a hotel with Miss Francis, which ends his belief in Willy and in the plans Willy had for him.

predicaments.situation: a lifetime of service ends in dismissal
predicaments.basis: Willy asks Howard Wagner for work in his home city and is told he needs a rest and can no longer represent the company at all.

predicaments.situation: a plea is heard as its opposite
predicaments.basis: Biff weeps, embraces his father and asks him to let the dreams go, and Willy takes it as forgiveness and proof that Biff will go into business after all.

predicaments.situation: a man dies to provide for his son
predicaments.basis: Urged on by the brother he speaks to in his flashbacks, Willy crashes his car deliberately so Biff can start a business with the insurance money.

predicaments.situation: one sibling repeats the parent the other rejects
predicaments.basis: At the funeral Biff holds to knowing he does not want a businessman's life, while Happy commits himself to his father's road.

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a son watches his father's standing collapse in front of him and can never see him the same way

relatives.title: Tokyo Sonata
relatives.shares: a father hides the loss of his working life from a family whose respect depends on it

relatives.title: Umberto D.
relatives.shares: a man who gave his working life to an institution is discarded by it in old age

relatives.title: Long Day's Journey into Night
relatives.shares: a family circles the one thing everyone knows and no one will let be said plainly

relatives.title: Tokyo Story
relatives.shares: a parent's expectations of grown children meet the ordinary lives those children actually built

films.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
films.engine: A painter is hired to study a young woman in secret so her likeness can be sent to the man she is to be married to, a marriage she inherited from a dead sister. The two women use the few days the mother is away to have the thing they know they cannot keep. What the film turns on is the decision to hold onto the memory of it rather than fight for the person.

predicaments.situation: one is paid to observe another in secret
predicaments.basis: Marianne is engaged as a walking companion so she can memorize Héloïse's face and paint her without her consent, and later confesses it and destroys the portrait.

predicaments.situation: two people love inside a fixed deadline
predicaments.basis: The five days the Countess spends on the mainland are the whole span Marianne and Héloïse have before the portrait is approved and the marriage proceeds.

predicaments.situation: a daughter is given away to a stranger
predicaments.basis: Héloïse is betrothed to a Milanese nobleman she has never met, and her mother's only concern is that the portrait be finished so the match can go ahead.

predicaments.situation: looking back costs the lover the beloved
predicaments.basis: They argue over why Orpheus turns around, Héloïse proposing that Eurydice asked him to, and at the door Héloïse calls "turn around" so Marianne's last sight of her is the wedding dress.

predicaments.situation: a death in the family goes unexplained
predicaments.basis: The older sister's suicide is never accounted for and its only consequence is that Héloïse is recalled from the convent to take the marriage that was hers.

predicaments.situation: the powerless are helped in secret
predicaments.basis: Marianne and Héloïse take the housemaid Sophie to have an abortion and stay with her through it, then have her lie back down in the scene so it can be looked at.

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a person is paid to watch someone and falls in love with the image the watching produced

relatives.title: The Handmaiden
relatives.shares: a woman placed in a household to deceive its young mistress ends up bound to her

relatives.title: In the Mood for Love
relatives.shares: two people love inside a span they both know closes, and keep it afterwards as a secret deposited somewhere

relatives.title: Brief Encounter
relatives.shares: an affair with a fixed end that neither party tries to extend

relatives.title: The Age of Innocence
relatives.shares: a marriage arranged around obligation while the real attachment is lived only in looking

films.title: The Tree of Life
films.engine: Two parents raise three boys on opposite instructions — the world must be fought, the world must be received — in a house where one man's temper sets the weather each day. One son dies at nineteen and is never explained. The surviving brother spends decades unable to settle whose son he is, and the film ends by staging the handing back of the dead boy.

predicaments.situation: a household is ruled by one man's temper
predicaments.basis: Mr. O'Brien screams at his wife, blames her softness for the boys' disobedience, and the family visibly lightens the week he is away on business.

predicaments.situation: a death in the family goes unexplained
predicaments.basis: R.L. dies at nineteen, his mother asks God why in voiceover, and decades later the father still has not gotten over it and cannot talk to his surviving son.

predicaments.situation: a son becomes the parent he swore against
predicaments.basis: Jack resents his father's harshness but tells him at the end that he resembles him rather than his mother, and the father was himself driven by terror of ending up like his own failed father.

predicaments.situation: a father asks his son to forgive him
predicaments.basis: Leaving the house for the last time after the plant closes, Mr. O'Brien admits his harshness to Jack and tries to conciliate him.

predicaments.situation: one parent's gentleness leaves the children unprotected
predicaments.basis: Jack blames his mother for never standing up to his father, and she lives under her husband's thumb while presenting the world to the boys as wonder.

predicaments.situation: a child is sent away from the household
predicaments.basis: In the extended version, Mr. O'Brien recognizes his own failure as a father and sends the academically declining Jack to boarding school for a better chance.

relatives.title: Fanny and Alexander
relatives.shares: children under a man whose discipline governs the house while the mother does not intervene

relatives.title: Yi Yi
relatives.shares: a family measured across its generations, with a son carrying the father's unlived life

relatives.title: Ordinary People
relatives.shares: a household that cannot say anything true about the son who died

relatives.title: A Brighter Summer Day
relatives.shares: a boy growing up inside a father's disappointment and taking its shape

relatives.title: The 400 Blows
relatives.shares: a child sent out of the household once the adults decide he is beyond them

films.title: There Will Be Blood
films.engine: A prospector adopts the orphan of a dead worker so investors will see a family man, and spends thirty years trading public humiliations with a young preacher whose land and congregation he needs. Every attachment he has is an instrument — the boy, the brother who turns up, the church. When the boy grows up and asks to become his own man, he tells him exactly what he was for.

predicaments.situation: a child is taken in to be useful
predicaments.basis: Daniel adopts H.W. after the boy's father dies in a drilling accident, specifically to pass himself off as a family man to investors, and finally tells him he was only ever a useful face.

predicaments.situation: a child is sent away from the household
predicaments.basis: After the gas blowout deafens H.W. and the boy sets fire to their shack, Daniel restrains him and puts him on a train to a school for the deaf in San Francisco.

predicaments.situation: two rivals each need what the other holds
predicaments.basis: Daniel needs the Sunday land and the easement across Bandy's ranch, Eli needs Daniel's money for his church, and neither can get it without submitting to the other in public.

predicaments.situation: humiliation is repaid with humiliation
predicaments.basis: Daniel beats Eli in the mud over the money he is owed, Eli later forces him to confess abandoning his child at the baptism, and Daniel makes Eli denounce his faith before killing him.

predicaments.situation: a stranger claims kinship to be taken in
predicaments.basis: A man arrives calling himself Daniel's half-brother Henry, is exposed when he misses a childhood joke, admits he only knew the real Henry, and is shot and buried.

predicaments.situation: a grown child asks to be released
predicaments.basis: H.W. asks to dissolve the partnership and start his own company in Mexico with Mary, and Daniel answers by mocking his deafness and disowning him.

relatives.title: Citizen Kane
relatives.shares: a man who acquires everything and empties out every relationship that helped him do it

relatives.title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
relatives.shares: prospecting turns a man against the people he needs to work with

relatives.title: The Return of Martin Guerre
relatives.shares: a stranger claims to be family in order to be taken into a household

relatives.title: Elmer Gantry
relatives.shares: a huckster and a preacher feeding off each other's crowd until one destroys the other

relatives.title: Shoplifters
relatives.shares: a family assembled for use, and the child eventually told what he was assembled for

films.title: The White Ribbon
films.engine: In a village where a pastor, a doctor and a landowner discipline everyone beneath them, someone keeps maiming and humiliating the powerful and the children who cannot defend themselves. Nobody is ever caught; the adults reach for outsiders to blame, and the one man who says aloud that the punished children may be the ones punishing is threatened with jail. The film is about the transmission downward of what is done in the name of purity.

predicaments.situation: the harm has no author anyone can name
predicaments.basis: The wire that unhorses the doctor, the caning of the baron's son, the near-blinding of the midwife's handicapped boy and the barn fire are never solved, and the narrator leaves for the war with only rumours behind him.

predicaments.situation: those punished pass the punishment to the weaker
predicaments.basis: The children raised under the pastor's white ribbons and the steward's beatings are the ones the schoolteacher believes maimed the estate's son, the midwife's disabled boy and the pastor's bird.

roles.punishing above: the pastor, the doctor, the steward, the baron

predicaments.situation: the weak are made to confess by force
predicaments.basis: The pastor interrogates his son into admitting impure touching and has his hands tied to the bed frame each night, and the steward thrashes his son over a stolen flute.

predicaments.situation: a household is ruled by one man's temper
predicaments.basis: The pastor governs his children through guilt and ribbons, the baron dismisses Eva the moment his son is found injured, and the doctor's household lives on his contempt.

roles.ruling: the pastor, the doctor, the baron
roles.ruled: the women, the children, the farm workers

predicaments.situation: naming the suspicion gets the speaker silenced
predicaments.basis: When the schoolteacher tells the pastor in his own rectory that the children had prior knowledge of the attacks, the pastor threatens to have him jailed if he repeats it.

predicaments.situation: a father preys on his own daughter
predicaments.basis: The widowed doctor is kind to the village's children while sexually abusing his teenage daughter and humiliating the midwife he sleeps with, then vanishes with his family overnight.

relatives.title: L'Argent
relatives.shares: an injury handed down the chain until it lands on whoever has least power to refuse it

relatives.title: Lord of the Flies
relatives.shares: children reproduce among themselves the discipline they were raised under

relatives.title: The Crucible
relatives.shares: a pious community extracting confessions from the people least able to withstand the asking

relatives.title: Picnic at Hanging Rock
relatives.shares: a repressive household and a harm the film declines to assign an author to

relatives.title: Fanny and Alexander
relatives.shares: a clergyman's house where purity is enforced on children through confession and restraint

films.title: Memories of Murder
films.engine: Two detectives who cannot agree on what counts as knowing — one claims to read guilt in a man's eyes, the other reads reports and weather — work the same string of killings for years. The pressure to produce a culprit makes them break the people nearest to hand, including a handicapped boy who turns out to have witnessed one of the murders. By the end each has taken up the other's method, the man is still out there, and the only description of him is that he looks like anyone.

predicaments.situation: the harm has no author anyone can name
predicaments.basis: The killings go unsolved for seventeen years, the lab result neither confirms nor excludes the one suspect, and the last account of the man is that he was too ordinary to describe.

predicaments.situation: the weak are made to confess by force
predicaments.basis: Cho beats the mentally handicapped Baek into confessing, and the man caught at the crime scene improvises a confession that matches none of the details.

predicaments.situation: two men with opposite methods must work together
predicaments.basis: Park's eye-contact intuition and Seo's study of crime reports collide, they fight when the innocent man is released, and after the next killing they agree to work the case together.

predicaments.situation: a pursuer is changed by the one pursued
predicaments.basis: Seo, who arrived rejecting forced confessions, ends up trying to shoot an unproven suspect, while Park, who claimed to know a criminal by sight, is the one who stops him.

predicaments.situation: the only witness dies before he can speak
predicaments.basis: Once they realize Baek's confession describes a murder he actually saw, they chase him from the restaurant brawl and he stumbles in front of a train.

relatives.title: Zodiac
relatives.shares: a case that outlasts the men working it and never produces a name

relatives.title: Cure
relatives.shares: an investigator remade by the person he is chasing

relatives.title: In the Heat of the Night
relatives.shares: two detectives with incompatible methods forced onto one killing

relatives.title: In the Name of the Father
relatives.shares: a confession beaten out of someone chosen for being easy to break

relatives.title: Police, Adjective
relatives.shares: the collision between what a policeman feels certain of and what can actually be established

films.title: Tropical Malady
films.engine: A soldier posted to a rural town and a young man from the village fall into an easy courtship that ends when one of them wanders off into the dark mid-embrace. The film then begins again with a soldier alone in the forest, sent to destroy a spirit that wears that same man's face. The hunt strips him of gun, radio and upright walking, and finishes with him offering himself to be taken instead.

predicaments.situation: a lover appears again as something to hunt
predicaments.basis: Tong, the villager Keng courts in the first half, returns in the second as the tiger shaman a soldier is sent alone into the woods to kill.

predicaments.situation: a pursuer is changed by the one pursued
predicaments.basis: The soldier loses his radio, pack and gun, is told by a monkey he will be devoured and enter the ghost world if he does not kill first, ends up crawling on hands and knees, and says he gives his spirit, flesh and memories.

predicaments.situation: one walks away without saying why
predicaments.basis: After a romantic moment stopped at the roadside on the motorcycle, Tong abruptly wanders off into the dark, and the next day Keng's troops leave the village.

predicaments.situation: two people love inside a fixed deadline
predicaments.basis: Keng's attachment to Tong lasts only as long as his posting to investigate the cattle killings, and ends with the troop's departure.

relatives.title: Cat People
relatives.shares: the person desired is also the animal that must be hunted

relatives.title: La Belle et la Bête
relatives.shares: the beloved met in the form of the beast one is supposed to destroy

relatives.title: L'Avventura
relatives.shares: someone walks off and vanishes, and the film restarts as a different thing around the absence

relatives.title: Apocalypse Now
relatives.shares: a soldier sent alone to eliminate a man and ending by surrendering to him

relatives.title: Brokeback Mountain
relatives.shares: two men whose attachment lasts exactly as long as the posting that put them together

films.title: The Act of Killing
films.engine: Men who killed on a mass scale were never punished for it; they became powerful, and they tell the story of what they did as a story of heroism. A filmmaker invites them to stage their killings as scenes, and the staging — costumes, camera, one of them playing a prisoner — brings one man to feel from the inside what he spent decades describing from the outside.

predicaments.situation: killers are honoured instead of punished
predicaments.basis: Anwar Congo, Herman Koto and the Pancasila Youth boast on television about the 1965–66 massacres and hold office and income through the power those killings won them.

roles.unpunished: Anwar Congo, Adi Zulkadry, Herman Koto and the Pancasila Youth
roles.unavenged: the families of the million dead

predicaments.situation: a man is made to play his victim
predicaments.basis: Acting the tortured prisoner in his own re-enactment, Congo has a panic attack and afterwards retches at the rooftop where he strangled people.

predicaments.situation: no one acts on a crime everyone knows
predicaments.basis: Journalists from Medan Pos who covered the killings admit support while denying participation, high government figures endorse the perpetrators, and no investigation has ever followed.

predicaments.situation: the wronged still live under their tormentors
predicaments.basis: Ethnic Chinese who survived the massacres continue to have money extorted from them by the same gangsters, who speak openly of curbing "neocommunism" next.

roles.preying: the preman gangs and Pancasila Youth
roles.preyed upon: surviving ethnic Chinese and the victims' families

predicaments.situation: a companion refuses to share the remorse
predicaments.basis: Adi Zulkadry calls Congo's nightmares a nerve problem, denies any war crime by pointing to Iraq and the Native American genocide, and worries only that the re-enactments will damage their standing as heroes.

relatives.title: S21: The Khmer Rouge Killing Machine
relatives.shares: former guards re-perform their daily routine of killing for a camera and it cracks their account of it

relatives.title: The Missing Picture
relatives.shares: an atrocity that left no images is restaged in order to be looked at

relatives.title: Shoah
relatives.shares: perpetrators describe the killing calmly, decades on, having never been punished

relatives.title: Z
relatives.shares: the men who killed are protected by the state that used them

relatives.title: The Look of Silence
relatives.shares: the harmed still live under the ones who harmed them, who tell the official story

films.title: Grizzly Man
films.engine: A man spent five summers camping among wild bears, filming himself with them, convinced he had won their trust and was defending them; in his sixth autumn one killed him and his girlfriend. What survives him is a hundred hours of his own footage and the people who knew him — and a narrator — arguing over whether what they see in it is love, self-invention, or a fatal misreading.

predicaments.situation: a man treats a wild thing as kin
predicaments.basis: Timothy Treadwell approaches and pets bears he says have accepted him, and stays into October when the animals are feeding hard for hibernation; he and Amie Huguenard are killed.

predicaments.situation: someone endangers what he means to protect
predicaments.basis: Treadwell claims to be guarding the animals from poachers, but a researcher says poaching on Kodiak was rare and Sven Haakanson notes that habituating bears to human contact put them at risk.

predicaments.situation: a man's own account of himself is contested
predicaments.basis: Rangers, bear experts and Herzog dispute Treadwell's claims of trust and of poachers, and Herzog reads him as a failed actor with a sentimental view of nature.

predicaments.situation: someone is known only through what they left
predicaments.basis: He is assembled from more than a hundred hours of his own video, an arm with a wristwatch found by the pilot, and an audio track of the attack that Herzog listens to and refuses to include.

predicaments.situation: the living decide what the dead leave behind
predicaments.basis: Jewel Palovak inherits his belongings and the tape; Herzog first tells her to destroy it, later calls that advice stupid, praises her putting it in a bank vault, and around 2023 she destroys it anyway.

relatives.title: Into the Wild
relatives.shares: a man's romance with wilderness is the thing that kills him

relatives.title: Stories We Tell
relatives.shares: survivors argue over the account a dead person left of themselves

relatives.title: Dear Zachary
relatives.shares: a recording of the worst moment becomes something the living must decide what to do with

relatives.title: Aftersun
relatives.shares: someone is known only through the footage they left behind

relatives.title: Kes
relatives.shares: a person's love for an animal is also a misreading of what the animal is

films.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
films.engine: A warlord keeps women as breeding property and men as blood supply; his most trusted driver smuggles the women out on a supply run and the whole army comes after them. What they are running toward is a green homeland one of them remembers from childhood, and when that turns out to be a poisoned swamp, the survivors have to choose between open desert and going back to take the fortress they escaped.

predicaments.situation: a living being is owned then handed on
predicaments.basis: Immortan Joe keeps five "wives" as breeders and drains Max as a universal-donor blood bag strapped to a War Boy's car.

roles.owned: the five wives, Max, the War Boys

predicaments.situation: a subordinate turns against the one they served
predicaments.basis: Furiosa, sent out as Joe's lieutenant to trade for petrol and ammunition, uses the run to carry his wives away and finally kills him.

predicaments.situation: the place someone was running to is gone
predicaments.basis: The Vuvalini tell Furiosa the Green Place of her childhood is the uninhabitable swamp the group drove through the night before, and that seven of them are left.

predicaments.situation: a forced ally becomes a chosen one
predicaments.basis: Max, who first fights Furiosa for the Rig and only helps because her kill switch stops him stealing it, leaves at the salt flats and then rides back to argue them into returning, and gives her his blood.

predicaments.situation: a follower is turned by being shown kindness
predicaments.basis: Nux, raised to die for Joe and thrown off the Rig after failing him, is consoled by Capable, joins the group and wrecks the Rig to close the canyon behind them.

relatives.title: The Handmaid's Tale
relatives.shares: women held as breeding property run from the household that owns them

relatives.title: Spartacus
relatives.shares: the owned turn on the man who owns them and take his ground

relatives.title: The Grapes of Wrath
relatives.shares: a desperate journey toward a promised country that turns out not to exist

relatives.title: Battleship Potemkin
relatives.shares: the trusted subordinates turn against the master they were serving

relatives.title: EO
relatives.shares: a living creature owned, traded and moved between hands as freight

films.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
films.engine: Osage families grow rich from oil under their land, and a white rancher who plays their friend arranges for the money to pass to his own family by having them killed one at a time. His nephew marries into one such family, does the arranging, keeps the marriage and the children, and slowly poisons his wife while sitting at her bedside.

predicaments.situation: a man harms the person he loves
